title: Transportation Analyst, AMZL BR
descriptionHtml:
A equipe de planejamento de capacidade da AMZL fornece às operações soluções e planos para operações de estações de entrega e frota, durante todo o ano e durante os picos sazonais. O especialista em planejamento de capacidade apoia a execução diária das atividades de gerenciamento de capacidade, trabalhando na definição da capacidade operacional de cada estação de entrega, fazendo o trabalho analítico relacionado à execução e às métricas de capacidade “na estrada” e “sob o teto”. O(a) candidato(a) ideal é apaixonado(a) por usar dados para oferecer um plano prático que impacte os negócios. Ele/Ela têm um forte histórico de entrega de resultados e tem experiência na execução em um ambiente multifuncional, apoiado por análises e dados. Ele/Ela gosta de um ambiente acelerado, trabalhando com grandes quantidades de dados e resolvendo problemas altamente complexos e ambíguos.

Key job responsibilities
Como especialista em planejamento de capacidade, você trabalhará no monitoramento de volumes operacionais, trabalhando internamente com equipes da AMZL para garantir a capacidade operacional do plano semanal e diário, e também com outras equipes de transporte e FC para alinhar as configurações de capacidade das estações de entrega em todo o país. Você analisará as lacunas de capacidade versus plano e trabalhará para eliminá-las com as equipes de execução, otimizando o volume das estações de entrega. Você trabalhará em tarefas analíticas, investigando desvios nas premissas críticas de planejamento (pacotes por rota, tamanho médio de pacotes) e fazendo revisões para instruir as operações. Você trabalhará com as configurações de sistemas da Amazon, definindo a capacidade para cada tipo de operação e monitorando a utilização dessa capacidade definida.

O turno de trabalho para esta vaga funciona em escala 5x2, com folgas alternadas em dias de semana e fim de semana. A escala de trabalho é definida de forma o ocupante dessa vaga tenha folga aos domingos a cada 15 dias ou menos, tenha folga de 1 fim de semana inteiro por mês (sábado e domingo) e que não trabalhe mais do que 6 dias seguidos.

Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os "Amazonians" a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não só celebramos a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, mas também as diversas formas de trabalhar. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para o processo de entrevista ou integração, informe nossa equipe e nós o conectaremos à nossa equipe de acomodação.

A day in the life
- Trabalhar com equipes da Amazon para transformar inputs de previsão de volume em plano de execução operacional;
- Interagir com as partes interessadas em toda a malha AMZL para garantir que a execução do plano diário;
- Apoiar a liderança com análises de dados importantes para garantir uma tomada de decisão rápida e precisa.

About the team
O Amazon Logistics (AMZL) é o serviço de entrega “Last Mile” da Amazon, responsável por entregar pacotes (e sorrisos) para residências e empresas em todo o planeta. Na AMZL Brasil, a equipe de Planejamento e Expansão (P&E) supervisiona três áreas principais de apoio à operação e crescimento da AMZL: (1) Planejamento e gerenciamento da jurisdição, impulsionando o crescimento e a otimização de nossa cobertura e topologia de entrega/coleta; (2) Planejamento de capacidade, garantindo capacidade adequada em curto/médio/longo prazo para maximizar a obtenção de volume dentro da jurisdição da AMZL; e (3) Iniciativas de expansão, coordenando esforços locais em projetos “grandes” que permitem novos tipos de operações, novos canais de vendas e entrega (tipos de frota, micromobilidade) e coordenação programática de ponta a ponta da expansão da rede da AMZL.

title: Director of Engineering for Open Data Analytics Engines, Data Processing & Experience
descriptionHtml:
AWS Open Data Analytics Engines is a suite of fully managed, high-performance analytics services built on popular open-source frameworks, enabling customers to process, analyze, and derive insights from massive datasets with speed, flexibility, and cost efficiency. Open Data Analytics Engines make it easy for organizations to run petabyte-scale analytics using familiar open-source tools without the operational burden of managing infrastructure.

AWS Open Data Analytics Engines encompasses services purpose-built for large-scale data processing, interactive querying, real-time streaming, and machine learning workloads. The platform leverages open-source engines such as Apache Spark, Presto/Trino, Apache Flink, and Apache Hive, delivering seamless integration with the broader AWS ecosystem. Compute and storage are decoupled, enabling elastic scaling, fine-grained cost optimization, and support for diverse data lake architectures.

As Director of Engineering for Open Data Analytics Engines, you will lead a group of top talent in advancing the strategy and technical roadmap for innovations in engine efficiency, query planning and optimization, features, and performance. You'll drive the design, development, and operation of next-generation open-source analytics services on AWS, shaping the future of how customers run large-scale queries in the cloud.

Key job responsibilities
Grow and lead a software development organization responsible for building key AWS analytics services based on open-source engines.

Drive the design, implementation, testing, and deployment of managed analytics services spanning batch processing, interactive queries, and real-time streaming.

Own the strategy and technical roadmap for innovations in engine efficiency, query planning and optimization, and performance — setting the direction for how AWS advances the state of the art in open-source analytics.

Draw from your deep and broad technical and management expertise to mentor senior engineers and managers, complete hands-on technical work, and provide leadership on complex technical issues, design tradeoffs, and feature and schedule prioritization.

Work with senior executives to develop business targets and resource requirements, influence technical and business strategy, hire talented engineers and managers, and conceive innovative new solutions for customers.

A day in the life
Leading the Open Data Analytics Engines team gives you the opportunity to:

Work on industry-defining products in the rapidly evolving open-source data analytics space

Solve challenging problems in query planning and optimization, distributed query execution, stream processing, resource scheduling, and performance at cloud scale

Build products that deliver the power of open-source analytics with the reliability, security, and ease-of-use customers expect from AWS

Work for a company that is a recognized leader in cloud computing

Be involved in the fast-growing cloud analytics and data lake market

Develop and execute a strategic roadmap for the future of open-source analytics on AWS

Basic qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (or related field) or equivalent work experience

10+ years in the development of mission-critical system software, including work on distributed systems, large-scale data processing, or analytics platforms

5+ years managing engineering teams

Preferred qualifications

5+ years partnering with sales, marketing, and customer success teams

Experience developing and deploying cloud-based analytics technology, particularly services built on open-source frameworks (Spark, Presto/Trino, Flink, Hive)

Deep knowledge of query planning and optimization, whether gained through distributed query engines or relational databases along with resource scheduling, data lake architectures, and performance tuning at petabyte scale

Experience operating services at global scale with stringent latency, throughput, and availability requirements

Advanced degree: Masters or PhD in Computer Science or Engineering, or MBA or similar business qualification

title: Data Scientist II, AMZL, Central Learning Solutions Science
descriptionHtml:
The Central Learning Solutions (CLS) Science team in Amazon Operations builds state-of-the-art solutions for enhancing leadership and associate development across the organization. We develop technology and mechanisms for building personalized learning experiences based on the profiles of different learners and assess the post-training performance curves for different learner profiles.

As a Data Scientist on the team, you will be driving the data science roadmap for the CLS Science team. You will leverage your knowledge in statistics and econometrics, estimate the causal impact of training interventions, recommend the right interventions for a given learner profile, and measure the post-launch success of these interventions through A/B weblabs. You will collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams for solving business problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver successfully against high organizational standards.

- Implement new statistical, machine learning, or other mathematical methodologies to solve specific business problems.
- Present deep dives and analysis to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensure clarity, and influence the strategy of business partners.

title: Operations Lead, PSX Ops Excellence
descriptionHtml:
Esta é uma posição de tempo integral, permanente, presencial baseada em DBR9 - Osasco, BR e não oferece benefícios de realocação. Os candidatos devem estar localizados e legalmente autorizados a trabalhar em Brazil para serem elegíveis para consideração.

A operação de Last Mile da Amazon no Brasil está crescendo rapidamente, e estamos buscando um Especialista de Execução Operacional para se juntar ao nosso time de PSX Operations Excellence. Esse time leva profundidade de execução diretamente à nossa rede de estações de entrega — recuperando performance onde ela está caindo, padronizando rotinas operacionais e garantindo que operações novas e em transição rodem no standard desde o primeiro dia.

Nesta função, você será o boots on the ground da transformação operacional. Você estará embarcado diretamente nas estações de entrega para executar projetos de melhoria, diagnosticar gaps de performance via KPIs, cobrir posições-chave de liderança operacional durante transições e apoiar o launch de novas operações. Você não vai desenhar soluções à distância — vai implementá-las onde o trabalho acontece, lado a lado com os times das estações, e permanecer o tempo necessário para provar e sustentar a mudança.

Esta é uma função altamente móvel e voltada ao campo (aproximadamente 50% de viagem), com um Especialista de Execução Operacional alocado por região. Buscamos alguém com experiência operacional hands-on, viés para ação e um interesse genuíno em melhoria contínua, com bastante foco em entregar resultados escaláveis. Você trabalhará ao lado de um time pequeno e de alto impacto — aprendendo como a excelência operacional funciona na intersecção entre operações, padronização e experiência do parceiro de entrega em uma das redes de logística que mais crescem no mundo.

A Amazon está comprometida com um ambiente de trabalho diverso e inclusivo. A Amazon é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e não discrimina com base em raça, origem nacional, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, status de veterano protegido, deficiência, idade ou outro status legalmente protegido.

Key job responsibilities
-Execução de projetos: Executar projetos de melhoria operacional diretamente nas estações de entrega e rotas — implementando soluções, treinando os times das estações, validando resultados e sustentando as mudanças, em vez de apenas repassá-las;

-Recuperação de performance: Diagnosticar operações de baixa performance usando os principais KPIs de Last Mile, co-construir planos de ação com a liderança regional e conduzir tanto quick wins de curto prazo quanto a sustentabilidade de médio prazo;

-Padronização: Padronizar rotinas de turno nas operações, garantindo aderência consistente aos procedimentos padrão de abertura, execução, fechamento e handover em cada node operacional;

-Cobertura de posições-chave: Apoiar na cobertura de posições-chave de liderança em situações atípicas (ex.: transições, ausências), garantindo continuidade operacional e estabilidade da estação;

-Suporte a launch: Apoiar o launch de novas operações como parte do away team, em parceria com Learning, para que cada nova estação comece com o standard, a cultura e os KPIs corretos desde o primeiro dia;

A day in the life
Sua semana raramente começa em uma mesa. Você passará a maior parte do tempo no campo — embarcado em uma estação de entrega rodando um projeto de padronização, caminhando pelo chão durante a abertura do turno para ver onde o standard está quebrando e conferindo os defeitos de KPI do dia anterior contra o plano de ação que você co-construiu com o líder da estação. Você conduzirá sessões de trabalho curtas com os times de turno, orientando-os nas rotinas corrigidas e reforçando por que elas importam para métricas como TPH e OTD. Em alguns dias você estará imerso em um projeto de recuperação de performance em uma estação de baixo desempenho; em outros, apoiando uma estação que está com gap na liderança operacional, ou apoiando o launch de uma operação totalmente nova ao lado do time de Learning. Ao longo do tempo, você registrará resultados no seu tracker e se alinhará com a liderança de Ops Excellence sobre as próximas prioridades e para onde deve ser deslocado em seguida. Todo dia traz uma combinação de executar, orientar, diagnosticar e padronizar — a serviço de tornar as melhorias operacionais reais e duradouras nas estações que mais precisam.

About the team
A AMZL (Amazon Logistics), também chamada de Last Mile, é a movimentação de pacotes das estações de entrega destino final — nossos clientes. A AMZL BR foi lançada em Nov-20 com a visão de longo prazo de trazer uma experiência de entrega aprimorada ao custo certo.

PSX (Partner Strategy and Experience) é a área que suporta o crescimento e a performance dos parceiros de logística terceirizados que operam em todo o Brasil e que utilizam ferramentas e tecnologia da Amazon para expandir a cobertura de entrega de last mile.

Operations Excellence é um pilar estratégico do time, atuando como a força de execução da rede de entregas AMZL: recuperamos operações de baixa performance por meio de execução de projetos, padronizamos rotinas entre os tipos de estação e garantimos que operações rodem no standard. Trabalhamos em parceria próxima com os times de operações para fazer as melhorias operacionais acontecerem onde mais importam — na estação.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with Microsoft Office products & applications
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in operational logistics/supply chain, manufacturing, transportation, general management or an engineering role
- Can travel and relocate as appropriate
- Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma and Kaizen techniques
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in business, operations, logistics, supply chain or a related field
- Experience in communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal in Portuguese & English
- Experience with planning, performance metrics, and process improvement
- Experience in operational excellence, continuous improvement, or process improvement roles
- Driver's license

title: Electrical Design Engineer, Data Center Design Engineering, Data Center Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking an Electrical Engineer to become part of a global engineering team, responsible for the design and continuous innovation of our rapidly expanding data center foot print.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud and ML/AI models running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the best possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Engineers at Amazon work to design resilient, cost effective electrical distribution systems. As engineers at Amazon we are responsible for achieving a world class uptime for our customers. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make to Sr. Management and work hard to drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs. As an engineer at Amazon you have the ability to drive change and define/design the systems our customers rely on.

Amazon offers a fast paced, fun, and exciting work environment. We continue to grow at exponential rates and are looking for individuals that can support our speed to market, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning experiences. Amazon’s work environment is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate.

If you are a creative, smart and driven individual that enjoys working with complex problems we want YOU! At Amazon you will be responsible for working on multi-million dollar designs that support our array of businesses and wide variety of customers. Great ideas are encouraged and supported. Ingenuity is the main mechanism which supports our focus on quality, speed, and cost.

We are looking for engineers with hands on electrical design experience. If you can design an electrical system, have an understanding of the critical equipment needs for a data center, and understand the constructability of varying designs you may be a good fit. As we grow we are structuring our team to own more of our engineering in house. Engineers will be responsible for taking designs from concept to the permit and construction document set. You must be capable of defining critical equipment specifications and approving equipment submittals. Engineers will directly support construction and be a part of the process from site selection review through commissioning and ultimately turnover. You will be relied on as a subject matter expert in the electrical engineering field. At Amazon we highly support continued learning opportunities and focus on continued employee development.

At Amazon team work is absolutely necessary for us to accomplish our goals. You must be able to work within a team and depend on others to accomplish the required work. As an electrical engineer at Amazon you will be working with other internal groups as well as external groups including utilities, manufacturers, vendors, and contractors.

Amazon has a global presence. As this position is based out of Virginia, travel to our head office in Seattle will be required. Travel should be up to 20% of your time, majority throughout the Virginia-based data centers and in-person collaboration efforts not in your assigned office location. International support will be part of the job, and some international travel will be necessary. Support could consist of working on international teams and could require developing schematic and design document packages. title: Security Engineer, Amazon Photos
descriptionHtml:
In the world of cloud security, there's no such thing as a small vulnerability. Billions of photo uploads, AI processing requests, cross-device shares. Each one has to be perfect. Each one has to be secure. Behind every transaction is a family's memories, and those are worth protecting.

Amazon Photos is hiring a Security Engineer who understands that kind of responsibility. Not just someone who can code, but someone who sees the bigger picture: the architecture, the attack vectors, the human element. Because at the end of the day, we're not just securing data - we're securing trust.

The role demands technical mastery across multiple domains:

- Mobile security: iOS and Android apps that millions of customers depend on daily
- Smart device integration: Fire TV and Echo platforms where families share their memories
- Backend systems: Where AI helps customers rediscover moments they thought were lost
- Automation frameworks: Because at our scale, manual isn't an option

You'll work directly with senior leadership, but this isn't about following orders. It's about taking initiative, seeing the vulnerabilities before they become problems, building the solutions before they become urgent. You'll have the authority to make decisions and the autonomy to execute them.

The threats are real. They evolve daily. And unlike most security roles, the stakes here are personal - these aren't just business transactions we're protecting, they're first steps, graduations, weddings, last goodbyes.

We are seeking someone that understands that security isn't just about writing code - it's about understanding systems, anticipating attacks, and building defenses that scale. Someone who knows that the best security is invisible to users but impenetrable to attackers.

If you're passionate about both technical excellence and making a difference in people's lives, we'd love to talk with you about joining our team.

Key job responsibilities
1. Cross-Platform Security Leadership
- Drive security architecture and design for Amazon Photos services across backend, iOS, Android, Fire TV, and Echo app platforms
- Perform threat modeling and security reviews for new features and existing systems across all supported platforms
- Partner with development teams to implement security controls and best practices in mobile, TV, and voice-activated environments
- Lead security incident response efforts for assigned services and applications

2. Security Engineering & Implementation
- Design and implement security automation solutions to detect and prevent vulnerabilities across all Photos platforms
- Develop secure-by-default frameworks and reusable components for Photos services and apps
- Perform security code reviews and penetration testing of critical services and client applications
- Build and maintain security monitoring and alerting systems for backend services and client apps

3. Risk Management & Compliance
- Assess and document security risks for Photos services, apps, and customer data across all platforms
- Drive remediation of security findings within SLA requirements
- Ensure compliance with Amazon security standards, DigiSec campaigns, and relevant regulations
- Maintain security documentation and technical designs for all Photos platforms

4. Cross-team Collaboration and Communication
- Collaborate with DigiSec to understand and implement relevant security campaigns and initiatives
- Articulate the security state of Amazon Photos to stakeholders, including progress on DigiSec-driven initiatives
- Produce clear, concise reports on security posture and ongoing initiatives for both technical and non-technical audiences
- Participate in cross-team security reviews and provide expertise on Photos-specific security considerations

5. Continuous Improvement and Innovation
- Stay current with emerging security threats and best practices in mobile, TV, and voice-activated app security
- Propose and implement innovative security solutions that enhance user experience without compromising security
- Contribute to the development of long-term security strategy for Amazon Photos, considering evolving threats and technologies

6. Mentorship and Knowledge Sharing
- Provide technical mentorship to junior security engineers and developers on secure coding practices
- Contribute to security-related documentation and internal knowledge bases
- Participate in and potentially lead security training sessions for the broader Photos team

A day in the life
Morning:
- Start your day reviewing security alerts from overnight and sharing news and activity with Amazon Photos development teams
- Join the Photos mobile app team's design review for a new feature enabling secure photo sharing between Echo Show devices
- Conduct a threat modeling session with backend developers for an upcoming service launch
- Collaborate with one of the machine learning teams to validate security controls for a new photo recognition feature

Afternoon:
- Deep dive into analyzing an unusual pattern detected in our subscription activity
- Write and test automation scripts to detect potential privacy issues in photo sharing flows
- Partner with Android developers to implement secure-by-default patterns in their latest feature
- Review pull requests for security-critical changes
- Collaborate with DigiSec on ongoing security campaigns

Evening:
- Forget about work, knowing that we're secure, stable, and safe

About the team
We're a focused, high-impact security team being built from the ground up within Amazon Photos. Reporting directly to senior leadership, with technical direction from a Principal Engineer, team members have unprecedented access to guidance and support while maintaining the autonomy to shape our security future.

As one of our first dedicated security engineers, you'll help establish our team's culture and technical foundations. Our dedicated team is starting small, which means you'll have outsized influence on our direction and substantial ownership of our security landscape.

Our flat structure and direct senior leadership access means quick decision-making and minimal bureaucracy. If you enjoy building things from scratch and want to help define what security looks like for a service trusted by millions, this is your opportunity.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of non-internship background in troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating complex tasks using command line tools experience
- 5+ years of work in identifying security issues and risks, and developing mitigation plans experience
- 4+ years of (non-internship) scripting, programming, and security code review in common programming languages experience
- Knowledge of at least two of the following programming languages: Scala, Java, Python, C/C++, or Go
- Experience (non-internship) in scripting, programming, and security code reviewing in a common programming language
- Experience (non-internship) in troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating complex tasks using command line tools
- Experience working in identifying security issues and risks, and developing mitigation plans
- Experience (non-internship) in industry-based security vulnerabilities identification, attack patterns, and remediation techniques
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- Experience applying threat modeling or other risk identification techniques or equivalent
- Experience with security in service-oriented architectures/microservices and web services

descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Business Partner provides HR generalist support to a large population of hourly employees and business leaders, bringing expertise in leadership development, employee experience, and operational excellence.

In this role, you will partner with business leaders to deliver HR initiatives focused on talent management, employee engagement, and internal customer service. Success requires leveraging data-driven insights and understanding the importance of HR metrics to drive business impact. You may also lead a team of entry-level HR employees and own projects that enhance the employee experience.

The HR Business Partner balances strategic and tactical responsibilities, driving organizational success through partnership with leaders. They execute core PXT processes while providing guidance on talent processes, performance management, and cultural initiatives. By building trust and influence through sound business acumen, they manage increasingly complex issues and deliver solutions that enhance both employee experience and business outcomes.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility.

Key job responsibilities
- Improve site effectiveness by identifying systemic patterns, addressing root causes, and making high-judgment decisions that align with policy intent while minimizing risk. Establish and implement mechanisms that ensure consistent, fair application of policies while maintaining compliance with evolving regulations.

- Use data analytics to identify emerging trends, predict future challenges, and implement proactive solutions at the site level. Turn insights into practical initiatives that drive measurable improvements in employee experience and business performance.

- Execute and monitor employee engagement strategies and recognition programs. Maintain meaningful floor presence to gather insights, identify early signs of disengagement, and partner with leaders to drive targeted improvements.

- Coach Business Leaders on effective people management practices, including performance feedback, team development, and complex employee relations matters. Support leaders in building inclusive, high-performing teams.

Your day will be a dynamic blend of strategic thinking and data-driven decision-making. From coaching leadership teams on workforce and talent management to driving HR process excellence, you'll collaborate with business leaders to develop forward-looking strategies focused on operational objectives and team effectiveness. You'll build strong partnerships across all levels of the organization while contributing to meaningful workplace improvements.

Success in this role comes from your ability to navigate organizational dynamics, lead change initiatives, and make high-judgment decisions in ambiguous situations. Through a combination of business acumen, data-driven insights, and strategic partnerships, you'll help create a workplace culture where employees feel valued and empowered, while driving long-term organizational success and adaptability in a rapidly evolving business landscape.

title: Data Center Controls Engineer, Deployment
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.


Key job responsibilities
• Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.
• Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center. • Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.
• Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.
• Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.
• Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.
• Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers. • Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholder’s management.
• Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.
• Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.
• Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
• Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
• Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.
• Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
- Experience with power management and power monitoring systems

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure experience
- Knowledge of critical data center equipment
- Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
- Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA
- Experience in project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure
- Experience in Data Center Engineering Operations, with a deep understanding of electrical and mechanical data center infrastructure
- Experience reading and interpreting construction specifications and drawings for all domains

title: Embedded Software Manager, Mobile Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Robotics is seeking a Software Development Manager to lead an embedded software team building the safety-rated sensor processing firmware that lets one of the world's largest autonomous robot fleets operate safely alongside people. You will lead a team of embedded software engineers who own real-time safety applications, sensor processing pipelines, and system interfaces on heterogeneous multi-core MCU/CPU/GPU platforms: the firmware that enables robots in Amazon facilities worldwide to detect and respond to obstacles reliably. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set technical direction, grow and develop the team, and own delivery of firmware that meets the rigor of IEC 61508 functional safety certification.

We are looking for a manager who pairs people leadership with strong technical depth in embedded or safety-critical systems. This is a highly technical role, not a purely people-management one: you should be able to dive deep in design and safety-analysis discussions, review architecture and code with authority, make sound architectural trade-offs, and earn the technical trust of a team that writes code where correctness is not optional. You will coach engineers, hold a high bar on design and code quality, and partner effectively across electrical, mechanical, functional safety, navigation, and manufacturing teams.

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate is passionate about building the right solutions for our customers, developing great engineers, and raising the bar for associate safety at Amazon scale. As the manager of this team, you will:

- Hire, coach, and develop a high-judgment, bar-raising team of embedded software engineers.
- Own the technical roadmap, delivery, and operational excellence for your team's portfolio of safety-rated firmware.
- Set and uphold engineering standards across the sensor processing pipeline: from driver integration through point cloud generation to real-time collision detection.
- Partner with electrical, mechanical, functional safety, navigation, and manufacturing teams to close failure modes identified in failure mode analyses.
- Represent the team in safety certification, design reviews, and third-party witness testing, ensuring artifacts meet the rigor required for IEC 61508.
- Make transparent trade-offs between long-term architecture and near-term delivery, balancing safety, performance, and schedule.

A day in the life
No two days are the same. You might start in 1:1s and a design review, helping an engineer think through a black-channel diagnostic or a latency budget. Before lunch you negotiate scope for the next certification milestone with functional safety and navigation. In the afternoon you head to the test floor alongside your engineers and the electrical and QA teams: is it firmware, hardware, or a faulty sensor? In between, you unblock the team, give feedback on a design, and think ahead about hiring and architecture. Our managers own it all, from their engineers' growth to what ships to production robots.

About the team
The AR Firmware organization is the world-leading embedded software team behind many of the robotic systems Amazon Robotics deploys: fleets of over 1M drive units and safety-critical products that let associates work alongside robots safely. Within it, the Safety Perception team owns the safety-critical firmware in Proteus, Amazon's first robot that can safely share a work area with people. We specialize in the bandwidth and complexity of depth cameras, LiDARs, iTOFs, and dTOFs, and in proving under certification that those sensors meet requirements across all operating conditions. We keep safety software lean, prioritize test infrastructure early, and sweat the details so others do not have to.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 3+ years of providing technical leadership and project management for all aspects of the software development lifecycle experience
- 7+ years of Software Engineer, Software Developer, or related occupational experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Experience leading the development of embedded, real-time, or safety-critical systems

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
- Familiarity with functional safety standards such as IEC 61508 or ISO 26262
- Experience in robotics, sensor processing (cameras, LiDAR, RADAR, time-of-flight), or autonomous systems
- Track record of delivering complex programs across multiple engineering and hardware organizations
- Experience owning operational excellence for production systems at scale

descriptionHtml:

We endeavor to build our legacy as Earth's most customer-centric company and to continue to cultivate and nourish our innovative environment through our mission to hire the best. When working at Amazon, your ability to make a difference and take ownership of your career begins on day one. You can expect a collaborative, team-driven environment that encourages employees to learn, be curious, and have a bias for action. Part of this propensity for continuous learning shows itself in Amazon's strong encouragement of movement and growth within the Accounting department and within the company as a whole. We aim to hire and develop those who will raise the bar over the course of their career at Amazon (and not just in their first position).

Amazon's accounting group offers opportunities at the Senior Accountant level in Legal Entity & Intercompany, Accounting Policy & Reporting, Operations and Capital, Transportation, Payments & Merchant Services, Retail Operations, Digital, and AWS Accounting.

The Corporate Accountant supports Amazon's global accounting operations through financial reporting, technical accounting research, and cross-functional collaboration. This role may support corporate reporting functions such as external reporting, corporate functional accounting, intercompany accounting, transfer pricing, equity accounting, treasury/funding, or entity restructuring — partnering with business teams across AWS, Digital, Stores, Payments, Advertising, and International operations.

This role requires risk assessment, control considerations, and process improvement within a complex, high-growth environment. The successful candidate will operate independently in a fast-paced environment while partnering effectively across teams including Tax, Legal, Treasury, Finance, and Statutory Accounting.

Key job responsibilities
• Perform and/or manage monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities including reconciliations, journal entries, and financial statement preparation
• Support the preparation, review, and filing of SEC reports (10-Q, 8-K, 10-K) and other external filings as applicable
• End-to-end process ownership to support finance and business partners; Lead delivery of accounting tasks and projects
• Execute judgments to keep projects moving and ensure the right decisions are reached to close the books each month
• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders including Finance, Legal, Tax, Treasury, Technology, and Statutory Accounting teams to understand business initiatives and assess accounting implications
• Assess the effectiveness of controls in your area and participate in the design of new controls for emerging and growing business activities
• Identify and implement process improvement and automation opportunities; drive impactful global projects that enhance efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
• Proactively identify, research, and document technical accounting positions and memorandums on significant transactions
• Assess risks, evaluate internal control considerations, and escalate issues to leadership with appropriate context and recommendations
• Analyze complex processes and systems data to identify root causes and surface insights


About the team
The Global Transfer Pricing Close and Reporting team is responsible for the worldwide accounting of Amazon's intercompany transfer pricing transactions — ensuring charges are accurate, compliant with the arm's length principle, and booked on time across Amazon's global entity structure.

We are an agile, high-ownership team that moves fast and takes pride in getting the details right. We partner closely with tax and finance teams across the business. If you're looking for a place to build deep technical expertise while working on problems that matter at a global scale, this is it.

- Bachelor's degree in accounting or related field

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of Fortune 500 operational accounting experience
- CPA
- Knowledge of internal control framework (specifically COSO) to assess control design and operational efficiency
- Knowledge of GAAP research tools and the FASB codification
- Experience in accounting management in Big Four with Fortune 500 clients

descriptionHtml:

title: Electrical Engineer, Fauna
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Electrical Engineer to lead the design and development of our power and motion control systems for our robotic systems. This role is an opportunity to lead the long-term architecture of our robotics platform and help build the technical foundation for robots and humans working together.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the design, layout, and validation of PCBs for power distribution, motor drivers, embedded systems, and sensor integration

- Architect and optimize power distribution and battery system to support a robot with high-performance actuators and real-time compute workloads

- Develop and refine our lithium-ion battery system

- Develop high-efficiency system power architecture and power monitoring circuitry to support our robotics platform

- Ensure EMI/EMC compliance, signal integrity, and thermal design best practices for high-reliability electronics in a compact mobile system

- Collaborate with firmware engineers on real-time control strategies for smooth, compliant motion

- Work with mechanical engineers to integrate thermal management solutions for batteries, high-power electronics, and motors

- Define the electrical architecture for real-time control, networking, and system diagnostics, ensuring high-speed, low-latency communication between actuators, sensors, and compute nodes

- Support bring-up, debugging, and testing of prototype robots, working closely with firmware and mechanical teams

- Work with vendors and contract manufacturers to source high-quality components and oversee the production of key electronics subsystems

- Mentor junior engineers, drive design reviews, and define electrical engineering best practices

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of electrical theory, robotics, controls components, and automated equipment experience
- 4+ years of motor controls (motor starts, variable frequency drives, DC drives, and standard electrical components) experience
- Experience developing products for large volume production
- Experience working effectively across cross-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization
- Strong PCB design and layout skills (Altium, KiCad, or similar) with an understanding of high-power circuits, signal integrity, and thermal constraints
- Experience with lithium-ion battery systems, BMS hardware/software, and power distribution architectures
- Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, including experience with oscilloscopes, power analyzers, and motor test benches
- Proficiency with embedded system interfaces (FDCAN, SPI, I2C, RS485, USB) and experience working with STM32 microcontrollers
- Knowledge of EMI/EMC mitigation techniques and compliance standards for industrial or robotics systems
- Experience working in robotics, automotive, aerospace, or other real-time electromechanical systems

Preferred qualifications

- Previous experience in robotics or control systems

title: Duales Studium - BWL
descriptionHtml:
Ein Job im Operations-Bereich bei Amazon versetzt dich ins Zentrum dessen, wie Dinge vom Klick bis zur Haustür gelangen. Du hilfst dabei, Systeme zu entwerfen, zu verbessern und zu betreiben, die Menschen, Produkte und Orte miteinander verbinden – und das in großem Maßstab. Du übernimmst früh Verantwortung, arbeitest eng mit Teams zusammen, um reale Herausforderungen zu lösen, und siehst die direkten Ergebnisse deiner Entscheidungen, wenn sie täglich bei den Kunden ankommen. Hier ist die Wirkung dessen, was du aufbaust, nicht abstrakt – sie ist sichtbar, unmittelbar und bedeutsam – und hält eine der komplexesten Betriebsorganisationen der Welt am Laufen. Hier nimmt deine Reise Gestalt an – durch Handeln, Verantwortung und die Möglichkeit, in viele Richtungen zu wachsen Dein Einstieg in die Führung - Das Duale Studium bei Amazon
- Studiengang: BWL / Logistikmanagement (B.A.)
- Studienpartner: IU Internationale Hochschule (30+ Standorte deutschlandweit)
- Programmbeginn: 1. August 2027
- Dauer: 3,5 Jahre
- Einsatzorte: mehr als 20 Amazon-Standorte in Deutschland (Fulfillment Center und Sort Center)
Das duale Studium bei Amazon ist ein strukturiertes Führungsentwicklungsprogramm, das dich Schritt für Schritt auf eine operative Führungsrolle vorbereitet. Wer das Programm erfolgreich abschließt, hat die Chance direkt eine Position als Area Manager:in in unserem Netzwerk zu bekommen - ohne weiteres Bewerbungsverfahren.
________________________________________
Drei Phasen auf dem Weg zur Führungskraft
Das Programm ist in drei aufeinander aufbauende Phasen gegliedert, die deinen Verantwortungsbereich kontinuierlich erweitern.
Phase 1 - Operative Grundlagen: Zunächst lernst du die operativen Abläufe im Fulfillment Center von Grund auf kennen, analysierst Kennzahlen und setzt eigenständig Projekte zur Prozessverbesserung um.
Phase 2 - Rotation & Führungsentwicklung: Anschließend rotierst du durch verschiedene operative Bereiche, übernimmst schrittweise Führungsaufgaben - von der Begleitung der Team Leads über Schichtplanung bis hin zur Personalsteuerung - und entwickelst ein Verständnis für bereichsübergreifende Zusammenhänge.
Phase 3 - Area-Manager-Niveau: In der Abschlussphase arbeitest du auf Area-Manager-Niveau: Du steuerst operative Kennzahlen, führst Teams eigenständig und trägst echte Verantwortung für deinen Bereich.

Das bieten wir dir
• Karriereperspektive: Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Programms wechselst du direkt in eine Area Manager Position im Amazon-Netzwerk - ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren
• Studienfinanzierung: Amazon übernimmt die Studiengebühren an der IU
• Mentoring: Strukturierte Begleitung durch Learning Manager:in und operative Führungskräfte
• Netzwerk: Zugang zu einem europaweiten Operations-Netzwerk
• Mobilität: Kostenloses Deutschlandticket
• Verpflegung: Bezuschusste Mahlzeiten am Standort
• Mitarbeitervorteile: Vielfältige Vorteile, wie ein Amazon Mitarbeiterrabatt
• Technologie: Arbeite täglich mit modernster Automatisierungs- und Robotiktechnologie

Key job responsibilities
• Analyse und Optimierung operativer Prozesse in Fulfillment- und Sortierbereichen
• Eigenständige Durchführung von Continuous Improvement Projekten mit messbaren Ergebnissen
• Übernahme von Führungsaufgaben im Rahmen von Lead-Rotationen (Schichtverantwortung, Teamsteuerung, KPI-Management)
• Mitarbeit an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten in den Bereichen Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Personalwesen und Technik
• Vorbereitung auf die eigenständige Steuerung eines operativen Bereichs als Area Manager:in
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einem internationalen Team innerhalb des europäischen Amazon-Netzwerks

A day in the life
Deine Betreuung im Programm
Du bist nicht allein. Während des gesamten Programms wirst du von zwei Seiten unterstützt:
• Dein:e Learning Manager:in am Standort begleitet dich durch alle drei Phasen, ist deine zentrale Ansprechperson und koordiniert deine Entwicklung
• Operative Führungskräfte mentoren dich während deiner Rotationen und geben dir direktes Feedback aus der Praxis
Zusätzlich bist du Teil einer deutschlandweiten Community dualer Student:innen - ein Netzwerk, das mit dir wächst.

________________________________________
Dein Alltag: Theorie und Praxis im Wochentakt
Das Studium läuft parallel zur Praxis - keine langen Blockphasen, sondern ein wöchentlicher Rhythmus:

title: Content Marketing Manager, Prime Video
descriptionHtml:
Join the Prime Video Content Marketing team as a Content Marketing Manager supporting title campaigns across Australia and New Zealand — from global tentpoles to locally relevant content. Based in Mumbai and working AUNZ time-zone hours, you'll be the operational backbone of AUNZ campaign delivery, coordinating closely with creative, media, social, and PR teams to ensure campaigns launch on time and on brief.

This is the first India-based role dedicated to AUNZ content marketing. You'll sit with the India team locally while embedding into the AUNZ marketing squad day-to-day.

Key job responsibilities
What you'll do:

- Support the planning and execution of title marketing campaigns for AUNZ, including global tentpoles and local originals
- Coordinate day-to-day with creative, media, social, and PR teams to keep campaigns on track — managing timelines, asset deliveries, feedback loops, and approvals
- Track and report on campaign performance, pulling together post-campaign recaps and actionable insights to inform future strategy
- Manage operational workflows — briefing agencies, routing assets, maintaining campaign trackers, and ensuring stakeholder alignment
- Contribute to measurement frameworks, compiling data and surfacing trends that help the team optimise campaigns over time
- Support always-on marketing activity alongside tentpole moments

What makes this role exciting:

- High-visibility campaigns — you'll work to support Prime Video's biggest global launches and locally resonant content in AUNZ
- Cross-functional hub — you'll build strong working relationships with creative, media, social, PR, and regional stakeholders
- Performance lens — you'll develop analytical skills that directly influence how the team allocates effort and investment
- First of its kind — you'll shape what this India-based AUNZ marketing role looks like as it grows
- Global company, regional impact — you'll be part of a lean, fast-moving team where your contributions are felt immediately

This is an individual contributor role based in Mumbai, India. This role requires working AUNZ time-zone hours.

A day in the life
Your day starts on AUNZ time, syncing with the Australia and New Zealand teams as their day kicks off:

Morning (AUNZ hours): Check-in on campaign trackers and flag any blockers ahead of the week's title launches. Jump on a stand-up with the AUNZ creative agency to review asset deliveries . Follow up with the media team on paid placement timelines.

Mid-morning: Join the weekly campaign sync with the PR team to align on press outreach and talent moments tied to an upcoming global tentpole launch. Where necessary, update the campaign timeline and circulate next steps to stakeholders.

Afternoon: Pull together performance data from last week's local title launch — compile viewership, social engagement, and media metrics into a recap. Surface key insights and draft recommendations for the next campaign cycle. Share the recap with your manager and the wider AUNZ marketing squad.

Late afternoon: Connect with the social team on an upcoming title's content calendar, ensuring visibility across teams against the paid media plan. End the day reviewing media delivery trackers queued for the next tentpole to ensure all details required are on-track.

You'll spend your time across:

Campaign coordination and operational delivery (creative, media, social, PR)
Performance reporting and campaign measurement
Stakeholder communication and cross-functional alignment
You'll regularly collaborate with: Creative producers, media partners, social teams, PR, and the Sr. Content Marketing Manager.

About the team
The Prime Video Content Marketing team for AUNZ is responsible for bringing Prime Video's content slate to life for audiences across Australia and New Zealand. We develop and execute marketing campaigns that drive awareness, engagement, and viewership — spanning global tentpole originals, local titles, and licensed content.

- Experience delivering paid media campaigns spanning TV, print ads and digital/social channels

title: SDE- MES, Amazon Leo, Manufacturing Execution Systems
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we've designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

The MES team is seeking a Software Development Engineer to design, develop, and deploy Manufacturing Execution System software that drives satellite production operations. You will build and maintain the core MES platform capabilities that manage work orders, process routing, data collection, traceability, and production analytics across Leo's manufacturing facilities.

You will work directly within the MES team to solve complex challenges related to production orchestration, shop floor system integrations, and real-time manufacturing data management. This is a hands-on development role focused on building the software systems that enable repeatable, controlled, and scalable manufacturing execution.

Export Control: This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and develop MES application features including work order management, process routing, recipe management, data collection, and product traceability.
- Build and maintain integrations between the MES platform and shop floor control systems (e.g., Ignition), enabling real-time production monitoring and machine-level data exchange.
- Develop integrations between MES and enterprise systems including ERP, PLM, and quality management platforms.
- Implement manufacturing process enforcement logic within MES to ensure production steps are executed in the correct sequence with proper validations.
- Build data pipelines and reporting capabilities within the MES ecosystem to support production analytics, yield tracking, and KPI dashboards.
- Develop and maintain MES APIs and services that enable production teams to manage and monitor manufacturing operations.
- Write clean, well-tested, production-quality code following MES team coding standards and best practices.
- Implement system monitoring, alerting, and observability for MES services to ensure uptime and rapid issue detection.
- Troubleshoot and resolve MES application issues in production environments, performing root cause analysis and implementing permanent fixes.
- Support MES system upgrades, version migrations, and configuration changes across production environments.
- Develop automated testing frameworks for MES features to ensure reliability during deployments and upgrades.
- Participate in MES design reviews, code reviews, and sprint planning to deliver capabilities on schedule and with high quality.
- Contribute to MES system documentation including architecture diagrams, runbooks, and operational procedures.
- Support UAT activities with manufacturing end-users and incorporate feedback into MES application improvements.
- Participate in on-call rotations to maintain MES system availability and respond to production incidents.

A day in the life
As a member of the MES team, your day revolves around building and supporting the software that production teams rely on daily to manufacture satellites. You will write code for MES features, review pull requests from teammates, and work with manufacturing engineers who use the system to understand their pain points and requirements.

A typical day involves developing new MES capabilities (e.g., a new process routing workflow or integration endpoint), debugging production issues that affect manufacturing operations, participating in team standups and sprint ceremonies, and collaborating with MES TPMs and manufacturing stakeholders on upcoming feature priorities.

You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment where system availability directly impacts production output, and where requirements evolve as production processes mature and scale.

About the team
The MES team builds and maintains the Manufacturing Execution System that powers Leo's satellite production operations. The team is responsible for the core MES platform — including work order management, process routing, data collection, traceability, and production reporting — as well as all integrations between MES and shop floor control systems like Ignition, ERP, PLM, and quality management systems.

The team's mission is to deliver a reliable, scalable MES platform that enables manufacturing teams to execute controlled, repeatable production processes while maintaining rigorous data integrity and compliance standards across Leo's internal facilities and contract manufacturing sites.

The MES team operates in Bellevue, WA, and works closely with manufacturing operations teams in Redmond and Kirkland, WA.

- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key job responsibilities
* Support, mentor, and motivate your hourly workforce
* Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
* Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 20+ employees
- Experience with process improvements (Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma)
- Excellent customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills
- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
- Industry experience in: retail, F&B, military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production or distribution environments.

title: APAC Warehouse Manager, AWS Cloud Logistics
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure — the people who keep the cloud running. Supporting all AWS data centers and the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure customers have continual access to innovation.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS Cloud Logistics (ACL) is looking for an experienced Warehouse Operations Manager to support day-to-day operations at a Regional Distribution Centre (RDC). As part of the local Taiwan entity's service delivery team, this role provides operational coordination services under the direction of regional management, monitoring and facilitating smooth warehouse operations delivered by external warehouse service providers to ensure quality performance and operational excellence with service levels met in a fast-paced environment supporting local ODM partners and regional supply chain nodes.

This is a high-impact, on-the-ground role demanding equal parts operational rigor and the ability to support strategic initiatives. Operating as the primary point of contact for the RDC facility — supporting the Warehouse Service Provider (WSP) relationship, coordinating with ODMs and suppliers, and monitoring inbound/outbound flows run seamlessly.

The ideal candidate has deep experience in VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory) warehouse operations, strong knowledge of local regulatory environments (customs, transportation, bonded warehousing, and Free Trade Zone requirements), and the ability to operate independently in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment. Comfortable working with high-value inventory at scale, navigating regulatory complexity, and supporting the implementation of operational frameworks where none exist today.


Key job responsibilities
- Coordinate day-to-day RDC warehouse operations, including inbound/outbound coordination, inventory levels monitoring, cycle counts, and exception handling
- Monitor WSP performance against contractual SLAs through structured business reviews and escalation of performance issue to regional management for desicion
- Coordinate with local ODMs and suppliers on scheduling, inventory, and shipment planning
- Maintain and optimize KPIs and operational metrics (WBR/MBR) to track performance and drive continuous improvement
- Coordinate escalation processes through Root Cause Corrective Action (RCCA) and effective stakeholder communication
- Navigate local regulations relating to transportation, customs, bonded warehousing, and Free Trade Zone (FTZ) requirements
- Support new site launch activities including racking, layout planning, system go-live, and LSP onboarding
- Coordinate cross-border shipment logistics with customs brokers and freight forwarders
- Support the development and review of SOPs to streamline workflow and drive inventory accuracy
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams — procurement, supply management, transportation, and customs brokerage
- Support mitigation of operational risk and develop Business Continuity Planning (BCP) for the facility


A day in the life
- Assess warehouse operational health — triaging inbound delays, escalating WSP performance issues, and re-prioritizing work based on delivery schedules and business urgency
- Coordinate across procurement, transportation, and customs teams to unblock shipment flows
- Pull data from internal systems (WMS, inventory platforms, shipment databases) to build consolidated performance views and report progress in WBR/MBR formats
- Support stakeholder meetings with WSP, ODMs, and internal teams — setting expectations, tracking commitments, and driving accountability
- Identify patterns in cycle times, inventory accuracy, and vendor compliance data to propose process improvements
- Collaborate with regional counterparts to support the process standardization and share best practices across the RDC network


About the team
AWS Cloud Logistics manages a continuously evolving portfolio of shipments and warehousing operations through a worldwide supply chain — delivering the right product at the right time, cost, and place. The APAC warehousing function is critical to growth: every new site, supplier, and program depends on this team to enable operational excellence from day one.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of related industry experience
- Experience in data analysis using tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, SQL, Tableau, or equivalent
- Experience with Continuous Improvement and Six Sigma methodologies

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field
- Experience in data centers, infrastructure service providers, or related technology companies
- Experience in negotiations with global suppliers with a proven track record in cost reduction
- Experience in program, project or product management, or leading product implementation

title: System Development Engineer, STRADA
descriptionHtml:
The Service Transformation and Deployment Automation team aims to remove all manual touchpoints from service operations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Networking, one of the world’s largest and most complex networks. Systems Development Engineers are instrumental in discovering innovative ways to automate and scale services. They drive stability, consistency, and sustainability of the network while never losing sight of the high security bar our customer’s demand. We own a container compute platform in the border network, network device access and locality software, and a business intelligence platform for providing insights into service maturity. This position is located in Minneapolis, USA and working in the heart of AWS global network.This position is located in Minneapolis, USA and working in the heart of AWS global network.

Millions of customers rely on Amazon’s network for using our retail websites, accessing content on their Kindles, and building applications and businesses on top of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud. Our goal is to become The Infrastructure Platform for the world – achieving this goal requires automated and massively scalable software services. Success depends on our world-class network infrastructure, and our network depends on our automation.

This position involves on-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. We don’t like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new team members. Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior engineers truly enjoy mentoring more junior engineers and engineers from non-traditional backgrounds through one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth. We try to assign projects and tasks based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

We’re looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we’ve been building.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. We not only celebrate the diversity of our workforce, we celebrate the diverse ways we work. You may also reach them directly by visiting https://www.amazon.jobs/en/disability/us.

Mentorship and Career growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Key job responsibilities
You will be responsible for the design, implementation and quality of services you deliver. Your experience working in a systems development or in an enterprise environment will help us implement automated solutions across a variety of applications and systems.
You’ll also:
• Design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative solutions to transform service performance, durability, cost, and security.
• Write high quality distributed system software.
• Work in an agile, startup-like development environment, where you are always working on the most important stuff.
• Work closely with our Network/Systems/Software Engineering teams to ensure fast and smooth roll-out of new designs and products, as well as assist with deployment and sustaining of networking software tools.
• Use data to measure success and take responsibility for the quality of your service and, regardless of their source, strive to prevent faults from impacting your customers.
• Use your strong problem-solving skills, ability to understand and scope solutions, work across teams to drive solutions.
• Contribute to documentation of process and procedures.
• Learn from others and help grow those in your team to achieve their best.
• Take ownership, consider tradeoffs and lean on your expertise to ensure the job gets done.
• Participate in an on-call rotation with your team.


A day in the life
Engineers in the Backbone Enterprise and Regional Engineering (BERE) organization have a wide range
of responsibilities; we work with internal partners to develop and implement the next-generation platforms along with the tooling ecosystems to support these platforms driving efficiency and scalability through the automation of builds, configuration deployment, and the scaling of capacity. As our network is one of the largest in the world, there is no blueprint allowing our engineers to develop solutions to complex challenges that we face daily. We encourage durable solutions that
look around corners while taking into consideration our customer needs from a cost, performance, and
reliability perspective. Our team develops tooling that provides the required visibility and control of
traffic across the network, while prioritizing the automatic mitigation of events to minimize the impact
to our customers during events.
In this role you:
• Work in a 24x7 team on-call rotation, with ability to drive into workplace for critical events/needs.
• Manage customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure.
• Sit at the computer during scheduled work hours with appropriate breaks while maintaining a high level of alertness and attention to detail.
• Travel to data center/network sites and Amazon/customer offices as needed.


About the team
Within AWS Networking, the Backbone Enterprise, and Regional Engineering (BERE) organization is
responsible for the design, implementation, and operations of a wide array of networking infrastructure
that provide global connectivity between all AWS Regions and edge locations.
BERE provides the massive scale required to support our AWS customers and internal services, via a
network that experiences 70% growth annually. In addition, they have teams that are responsible for the design and operation of our global corporate office and Data Center network, allowing tens of thousands of Amazonians to perform their daily tasks in support of our customers.

- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
