title: Senior Manager, Risk, Law Enforcement Engagement, Security Operations Group
descriptionHtml:
This position can be based at any Amazon Corporate Hub in EMEA.

You'll help build a global law enforcement engagement capability from scratch — designing the architecture that connects Amazon's security operations with policing agencies globally to disrupt organised crime at scale and create lasting purposeful symbiotic law enforcement relationships. As a Law Enforcement Engagement Leader for Rest of World, you will own the end-to-end law enforcement engagement strategy across EMEA, APAC, and MEA. You are accountable for building the relationship architecture, engagement frameworks, and intelligence-sharing models that turn connections into a structured, institutionally-owned network. You'll be part of a team securing cross-functional dependencies with Legal, Finance, and Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), and represent Amazon at the highest levels of international law enforcement.

There is no existing playbook and no inherited structure. You will help define the operating model, and you enable field teams to execute, maintaining local relationships, acting as the bridge to support.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the Law Enforcement Engagement strategy and operating model across EMEA, APAC, and MEA. Design and implement the three-tier relationship model (strategic, regional, local) across 30+ international jurisdictions, and build the Geographic Targeting Model to direct resources where loss, risk, and relationship gaps intersect. Deliver the priority-market heat map.
- Design the LE Partnership Registry, converting personal relationships into institutional, company-owned assets. Develop standardised engagement playbooks, Memorandum of Understanding frameworks, and SLA-driven inbound request processes tailored to civil-law and common-law jurisdictions. Build legally compliant information-sharing models co-designed with Legal, and establish bidirectional intelligence protocols with GSOC.
- Secure and maintain cross-functional dependencies across Legal, Finance, GSOC, Investigations, Public Policy, and ACS. Ensure formal deconfliction with Investigations across international markets.
- Help onboard and develop regional STLs across EMEA, APAC, and MEA. Set the operating rhythm from weekly stand-ups to quarterly business reviews. Mentor team members ensuring role clarity and career progression.
- Represent Amazon at the highest levels of international law enforcement — building executive relationships with INTERPOL, Europol, and national agencies, and leading engagement with industry bodies including TAPA, OPAL, and ASIS. Own governance oversight for ROW, ensuring alignment with WWOS-wide frameworks.


About the team
The LEE team sits within Amazon's Security Operations Group, building the institutional architecture that connects Amazon's security operations with law enforcement agencies across ROW 30+ international markets to disrupt organised crime targeting global logistics.

We believe relationships built in peacetime pay dividends in crisis. We deploy resources where data shows the greatest exposure, measure ourselves on outcomes — disrupted Mo's, asset recovery, threat disruption — not activity.

This is a team for builders. We are early-stage, high-ambition, and outcome-obsessed. You'll write the playbook, not inherit one.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in risk management, audit, legal, compliance or a related field including engaging with external stakeholders
- Experience in team management with 5 or more direct reports
- Experience implementing lean principles and process improvement in an operational environment
- Experience working within a global company, with multi-country responsibilities
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in security service, loss prevention, asset protection, audit, investigations, law enforcement, risk management, data analytics, inventory control, quality assurance or a related field
- Experience creating and delivering written and oral communications for technical and non-technical audiences
- Experience leading the design, development and/or implementation of new business processes or programs
- Deep experience with public-private partnerships and information-sharing programmes across multiple jurisdictions
- Experience operating across international boundaries with an understanding of civil-law vs. common-law jurisdiction differences

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of International Organization for Standardization (ISO), International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC), or regulatory requirements or standards
- Experience with audit or risk program design, control environment process documentation, and control mapping
- Master's degree or equivalent

title: Regional Commercial Manager, Data Center Delivery, EMEA Construction Cost Control
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center Construction Cost Control (CCC) team is part of a larger, highly creative and passionate team dedicated to deploying our continuously evolving Amazon data center facilities.

As a Regional Commercial Manager you will be responsible for providing cost support, guidance and recommendations to the Data Centre project delivery team to ensure cost management across a portfolio of fast paced construction projects.

You will be involved in the full life cycle of construction projects while working with motivated experts from design, construction, procurement, finance and legal teams to deliver efficient and innovative data centers.

You will help drive multimillion dollar projects utilizing Amazon's key values including frugality and insist on the highest standards across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. This role is located in Dublin, Ireland or London, United Kingdom, Or Berlin, Germany Or Zaragoza, Spain.

At Amazon, we are diverse, creative, team oriented professionals who leverage unique opportunities presented to us on a daily basis to develop data centers that are changing the face of data facilities.

Key job responsibilities
- Engaging and managing third party Quantity Surveyors.
- Validating construction cost estimates at various stages of design.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Advertiser Growth Engine
descriptionHtml:
The Advertiser Growth Engine (AGE) team owns and builds services and applications across Amazon Advertising that make advertising across countries as easy as flipping on a switch. Our mission is to accelerate the path for millions of our Advertising clients in becoming global advertisers and brands.


We are currently recruiting Mid-Level Software Engineers who enjoy solving technical challenges at a global scale, simplifying and eliminating complexity as well as demonstrating a high sense of ownership and the ability to drive solutions from inception to delivery.


We have a strong culture of innovation, solving problems in creative ways and our track record of accomplishment’s speaks for itself. Over the past 2 years we have successfully:
- Built world-class text, video, and image localization services leveraging experienced human linguists and machine translation to produce high quality Advertising content.
- Leveraged ML and NLP to build a highly scalable service which intelligently routes translation content to human linguist by quality and SLA metrics.


Our current and future goals include:
- Integrate video, text, and image localization services into workflows to improve our customer's experience both on and off Ad Console.
- Build an agentic platform that powers all Ads agent to communicate with advertisers in 20+ languages.


You will be joining a high-performing team at the core of the Amazon Ad’s ecosystem. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle, from feature ideation to deployment to operational excellence. The individual in this role will have responsibility through the full product life cycle, from product strategy, prioritization and development to adoption and iteration. We will be counting on you to have strong technical skills - you should be able to design and build high-availability, low-latency distributed systems that will service millions of users. You will be expected to mentor junior engineers and foster a culture of innovation and high standards in the team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement software solutions across the full development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, architecture, coding, testing, deployment, and operational support.
- Write high-quality, maintainable code and actively participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback that raises the bar for the entire team.
- Identify root causes of operational issues and drive permanent fixes, continuously improving system reliability and performance.
- Collaborate with cross-functional partners — including product managers, stakeholders, and peer engineers — to understand customer needs and deliver the right solutions.
- Mentor and coach team members on software best practices, system design tradeoffs, and effective use of generative AI tools to improve productivity and code quality.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing deployment metrics and addressing any operational signals from overnight. By mid-morning, you are deep in a design discussion with teammates, weighing tradeoffs around scalability and maintainability for a new feature. After lunch, you spend time writing and reviewing code, pairing with a teammate who is ramping up on the codebase. You wrap up the afternoon by documenting your design decisions and preparing a brief update for your team's planning session.

About the team

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Preferred qualifications

title: Senior Partner Development Manager（シニア パートナー ディベロップメント マネージャー）, AWS Partner Management, JAPAN
descriptionHtml:
主要なグローバル・システム・インテグレーター（GSI）、アドバイザリー／コンサルティング企業との戦略的関係をオーナーとして担い、AIとクラウドによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションを通じて業界のイノベーションを推進ませんか？またはビジネスアドバイザリーの経験、ビジネスセンス、技術的知見、そしてシニアエグゼクティブレベルでの存在感を活かし、AIとクラウド活用における戦略的ビジネスイネーブラーとしてのAWSの成長を加速させたいと考えていますか？

Amazon Web Services（AWS）は、日本市場におけるGSIおよびアドバイザリーパートナーシップを構築・成長させるシニア パートナー ディベロップメント マネージャーを募集しています。

本ロールでは、GSIおよびアドバイザリー企業とそのクライアント基盤との間で、深いビジネス・戦略・技術的関係を構築し、AI・モダナイゼーション・クラウドによって加速される大規模なデジタルトランスフォーメーション案件を創出します。AWSのセールスリーダーシップ、スペシャリストチーム、ソリューションアーキテクチャ、プロフェッショナルサービスと緊密に連携し、日本のエンタープライズ顧客の変革を推進するデジタル案件を特定・形成・遂行します。

また、シニアエグゼクティブとの関係を活かし、パートナーとAWSのフィールドチーム双方から信頼されるアドバイザーとなり、イノベーション、ビジネス成果、業界変革をリードします。

具体的な責務には、顧客のデジタルトランスフォーメーションのアジェンダを実現し、AIとクラウドサービスの採用を加速し、パートナー主導の取り組みを通じてAWSの売上を拡大する共同Go-To-Market（GTM）戦略の策定と実行が含まれます。

GSIおよびアドバイザリーパートナーとの大型案件の形成、セールスサイクル全体にわたるパイプライン目標、共同GTMプレイの設計、そしてAI・エージェンティックAI、移行・モダナイゼーション、データ、業界特化型ワークロードにわたる顧客成果をオーナーとして担います。さらに、これらの成果を達成するためのパートナーのAWSケイパビリティを、セールスおよびデリバリーの両面からオーナーとして担い、認定・コンピテンシー取得、プラクティス開発、AWSパートナーネットワークのプログラム要件への準拠を含め、商業的成果とパートナープログラムの健全性の双方に対する相互の責任を負います。

理想的な候補者は、CxO/VPレベルでのエンゲージメントを可能にするビジネスバックグラウンド（アドバイザリー企業での経験が望ましい）に加え、ソリューションアーキテクトやプロフェッショナルサービスチームと協働できる技術的な深さを備えています。ビジネス・プロダクト・技術的課題について戦略的かつ分析的に考え、説得力のある価値提案を策定し、組織横断で合意形成できる能力が求められます。強いオーナーシップ、推進力、実行力が必須です。


Key job responsibilities
・顧客のAI・モダナイゼーションにおけるビジネス成果変革のアジェンダから逆算して、大型の変革案件を創出する。AGSアカウントディレクター、GSIおよびアドバイザリー企業のパートナー、クライアントアカウントリードと協働し、アイデア創出から案件推進、クロージングまで戦略的エンゲージメントを引き上げる。

・包括的なパートナービジネスプラン（PBP）を策定し実行する。共同GTM戦略、売上・パイプライン目標、認定目標、顧客成果を含み、社内ステークホルダー（セールス、スペシャリストチーム、ソリューションアーキテクチャ、マーケティング、プロフェッショナルサービス）と連携してブロッカーを取り除き、成果を実現する。

・パートナー組織、特にパートナーおよび主要アカウントのビジネスリーダーとのエグゼクティブ関係を構築・深化させる。戦略的な変革案件のアラインメント、ビジネスレビュー、投資判断、AWSセールスリーダーシップとのコセル（協業販売）を主導する。

・特定のパートナーおよび見込み顧客に合わせたビジネス価値提案を策定する。日本の顧客ニーズに応える優先ワークロード（移行、モダナイゼーション、GenAI、データ＆アナリティクス、セキュリティ）にわたり、再現性のあるソリューションとIPをパートナーが構築できるよう支援する。

・パートナー主導の取り組みを通じて、測定可能なパイプラインと売上の成長を推進する。

・進捗、ブロッカー、パートナープログラムの健全性について、パートナーおよびAWSジャパンのリーダーシップにビジネスレビューを準備・提供する。


A day in the life
・パートナーとのビジネスプランニング、ケイパビリティ開発、GTM実行に取り組む。

・パートナー戦略、ファンドメカニズム、共同販売の取り組みについて、クロスファンクショナルチームをイネーブルする。

・社内リーダーシップおよび社外パートナーエグゼクティブ向けに、データドリブンなビジネスレビューを準備する。

・AWSアカウントマネージャーとパートナーセールスチームの緊密なアラインメントを確保する。

・AWSの戦略とパートナーの戦略を整合させる。

・次世代のパートナーパイプラインを形成するため、新興のAIネイティブ企業を発掘・評価する。

・パートナーおよび／またはアカウントチームのエスカレーションをクローズする。

・パートナー案件へのAWS投資を促進する。

About the team
多様な経験 – AWSは多様な経験を尊重します。職務記述書に記載された歓迎要件やスキルのすべてを満たしていなくても、応募をお勧めします。キャリアが始まったばかりの方、従来とは異なる道を歩んできた方、代替的な経験をお持ちの方も、応募をためらわないでください。

Why AWS? – Amazon Web Services（AWS）は、世界で最も包括的かつ広く採用されているクラウドプラットフォームです。私たちはクラウドコンピューティングの先駆者であり、イノベーションを止めることはありません。だからこそ、成功しているスタートアップからGlobal 500企業まで、あらゆる顧客が自社のビジネスを支える堅牢な製品・サービス群を信頼しています。

インクルーシブなチーム文化 – AWSは好奇心とつながりを大切にします。従業員主導・会社支援のアフィニティグループがインクルージョンを促進し、私たち一人ひとりが自分らしさに誇りを持てるよう後押しします。インクルージョンイベントは、より強く協働的なチームを育みます。私たちの継続的なイノベーションは、チームがもたらす大胆なアイデア、新鮮な視点、情熱ある声に支えられています。
メンターシップとキャリア成長 – 私たちは「地球最高の雇用主（Earth's Best Employer）」を目指し、常にパフォーマンスの基準を引き上げています。だからこそ、知識共有、メンターシップ、その他のキャリア形成のためのリソースが豊富に用意されており、より多面的なプロフェッショナルへの成長を支援します。

ワークライフバランス – 私たちはワークライフハーモニーを大切にします。仕事での成功が家庭での犠牲の上に成り立つべきではありません。だからこそ、柔軟性を働き方の文化の一部として追求しています。職場でも家庭でも支えられていると感じられるとき、達成できないことは何もありません。

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of business development, partnership management, or sourcing new business experience
- Broad-based understanding of cloud technologies
- Experience working in Japan, with Japan local customers and partners, as well as global partners who serve Japan customers
- Japanese (Native) and English (Conversational)
- Experience managing programs across cross-functional teams

Preferred qualifications

- AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Associate's degree or above
- Experience working with System Integrators, consulting firms, or technology services organizations
- Experience working in a global Advisory firm in Japan
- 3+ years of working with Core Cloud & AI related technologies, including but not limited to Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
- Experience with Salesforce.com, Excel, and other business tools
- Culturally aware with good interpersonal skills; able to collaborate across different functional teams and internal stakeholders

title: Responsable des Ressources Humaines Junior
descriptionHtml:
Dans notre quête d'être le Meilleur Employeur au Monde, nos équipes mondiales des Ressources Humaines, connues sous le nom de People eXperience and Technology (PXT), contribuent au succès de l'entreprise en favorisant une culture fondée sur la sécurité, l’inclusivité et l’innovation. Le poste de HR Partner représente une opportunité exceptionnelle de construire votre carrière dans les ressources humaines, en vous concentrant sur l'expérience collaborateur, l'engagement, le développement du leadership et l'excellence opérationnelle RH.

En tant que HR Partner au sein de l'équipe One PXT, vous soutiendrez les opérations PXT à travers une exécution rigoureuse des processus standardisés, le développement de relations solides et une résolution rapide des problèmes. Grâce à une présence visible sur le terrain, vous contribuerez à façonner la culture d'équipe, à soutenir l'engagement des collaborateurs et à accompagner les managers dans les pratiques PXT. Vous créerez des expériences collaborateur positives tout en développant vos compétences dans la gestion de situations de plus en plus complexes en toute autonomie. Le succès dans ce rôle repose sur la construction de partenariats forts, la démonstration d'un jugement éclairé et le maintien d'une approche centrée sur l’expérience client. Vous apprendrez à exploiter les analyses de données et les technologies RH pour améliorer l’expérience des employés, tout en développant des compétences RH fondamentales qui constitueront la base de votre progression professionnelle. Ce poste constitue également un terrain d’apprentissage : les nouveaux HR Generalists sont encouragés à poser des questions, à solliciter des retours et à considérer chaque expérience comme une opportunité de développement.

Vous serez amené(e) à travailler sur site dans un établissement Amazon, avec une mobilité possible pour soutenir plusieurs sites au sein du campus assigné selon les besoins.

Key job responsibilities
Contribuer à une expérience collaborateur positive en déployant les programmes clés, en renforçant les standards de travail et en collaborant avec les équipes PXT et Opérations pour créer une culture où chaque collaborateur se sent valorisé, écouté et soutenu.

Exécuter les processus standardisés avec rigueur et dans les délais impartis, en respectant les accords de niveau de service (SLA) établis et en maintenant une documentation précise des processus RH et des interactions collaborateurs.

Assurer un soutien direct aux collaborateurs en répondant aux demandes, en les traitant et en garantissant une résolution ou une remontée appropriée des situations complexes. Gérer les informations sensibles avec discrétion et professionnalisme.

Contribuer au fonctionnement et au suivi des dispositifs de feedback tels que les tables rondes, les visites de terrain et les activités d'engagement collaborateur. Assurer le suivi des problématiques identifiées et collaborer avec les membres seniors de l'équipe PXT pour conduire des résolutions et des améliorations de l'expérience collaborateur.

Accompagner les managers de proximité sur les comportements qui influencent l'engagement et la fidélisation des collaborateurs. Renforcer les attentes et guider les managers dans la sélection et l'utilisation efficace des outils disponibles pour améliorer la communication d'équipe, la valorisation des collaborateurs et les échanges sur la performance.

Soutenir les managers dans la gestion de la performance en les accompagnant sur la définition d'attentes claires, la délivrance de feedbacks réguliers et la documentation des échanges sur la performance. Aider les managers à identifier les causes racines des problèmes de performance et à renforcer l'utilisation cohérente des outils et processus PXT.

Participer aux enquêtes internes, notamment dans la collecte des faits, l'analyse des documents et la compréhension des causes profondes. Apprendre auprès des partenaires PXT seniors à garantir l’équité, la confidentialité et la conformité tout au long du processus.


A day in the life
Une journée type consiste à trouver l'équilibre entre l'exécution des processus standardisés et le soutien réactif aux collaborateurs. Vous maintiendrez une présence opérationnel régulière sur le terrain, en échangeant directement avec les collaborateurs et en soutenant les managers pour traiter les diverses demandes et piloter les initiatives d'engagement. Avec l’accompagnement des membres seniors de l'équipe, vous exécuterez les processus RH fondamentaux tout en garantissant une qualité de service.

Grâce aux outils de données et aux technologies RH, vous contribuerez à suivre les indicateurs et à identifier les tendances, tout en développant votre capacité à instaurer la confiance par l’interaction directe. Vous soutiendrez les activités d'engagement collaborateur, contribuerez à la coordination des dispositifs de feedback et participerez à l'accompagnement et au développement des autres. Face aux situations complexes, vous solliciterez l'expertise des membres seniors de l'équipe, en apprenant à naviguer des situations délicates tout en développant votre jugement professionnel.

Le succès dans ce rôle repose sur le maintien de routines organisées, une capacité démontrée à aller au bout des choses et la construction de partenariats efficaces avec l'équipe PXT et les managers opérationnels. Ce poste requiert d'excellentes compétences organisationnelles et la capacité à évoluer dans un environnement dynamique où chaque journée est différente.

Basic qualifications

- Licence ou équivalent dans un domaine pertinent
- Maîtrise courante de l’anglais et du français à l'oral et à l'écrit
- Maîtrise de base de la suite Microsoft Office (ex. : création de documents Word, utilisation des fonctions de base d'Excel, gestion des calendriers et des e-mails sur Outlook)
- Capacité à maintenir la confidentialité dans le traitement d’informations sensibles
- Expérience dans la communication efficace avec des publics variés (ex. : explication des processus, traitement des préoccupations, apport de conseils)

Preferred qualifications

- Diplôme en Ressources Humaines, Management, Gestion, Relations du Travail, Psychologie ou dans un domaine similaire
- Expérience dans des fonctions orientées service client ou relation humaine, avec des compétences démontrées en communication orale et écrite
- Capacité avérée à analyser des informations, résoudre des problèmes et prendre des décisions basées sur les données
- Compétences intermédiaires sur Microsoft Excel (ex. : tableaux croisés dynamiques, recherches verticales et formules)
- Maîtrise des outils assistés par l'IA, des plateformes d'analyse RH et des technologies émergentes pour extraire des insights et conduire des améliorations de processus
- Capacité à former, guider et accompagner efficacement les autres dans l'utilisation des technologies RH et des plateformes numériques, avec un focus sur l'adoption et l'amélioration de l'expérience utilisateur
- Solides compétences organisationnelles avec une capacité démontrée à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément, à respecter les délais et à produire des résultats dans des environnements dynamiques et exigeants
- Expérience dans la construction de partenariats et de collaboration transversale, avec une capacité d'adaptation et d'autonomie démontrées
- Capacité à exercer un jugement éclairé et à naviguer dans des situations ambiguës avec peu de directives
- Connaissance de base des processus et politiques RH

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. title: Senior Software Engineer, AWS Metering
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to be a part of one of Amazon's largest big-data processing teams? Computing AWS bills, at its core, is a large-scale distributed systems problem that requires processing trillions of usage records every hour for millions of customers, with a 100% accuracy promise.

As a senior software engineer, you will develop and improve large-scale distributed systems on top of AWS services, learn new technologies, and build new applications on big-data platforms. AWS Metering is on the critical path of billing, and you can expect your work to be used by hundreds of AWS teams, impact millions of external customers, and save millions of dollars.

Work/Life Balance
Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn't about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it's about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to lifelong happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our experienced members enjoy providing one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Key job responsibilities
Design high-quality, efficient, and testable code in Java and other object-oriented languages.
Build large-scale, highly available distributed systems that can grow tenfold every three years.
Develop new anomaly detection algorithms to detect and eliminate billing inaccuracies, helping customers control costs.
Collaborate with AWS teams to build software and services that simplify their growing billing needs.
Own and operate the systems you build, holding a high bar for data quality, correctness, and operational rigor.
Contribute to planning, design, implementation, testing, operations, and process improvement as a member of a Scrum team.
Partner with product managers and engineers across Commerce Platform teams to deliver features and drive the adoption of best practices.

About the team
At AWS Metering, we build billing services and features that enable event-metering, storage-metering, and derived metering. We enable cost allocation through tags and generate cost alerts for AWS customers. We also build and operate one of the largest big-data processing pipelines at Amazon, continuously improving its scale and efficiency.

In addition, we are developing new anomaly detection algorithms to minimize billing errors and designing new services aimed at reducing metering processing latencies from hours to minutes.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. title: Senior Product Manager, CFX - Brazil
descriptionHtml:
Product Managers are the builders in Amazon. They own developing new features, tools, processes, and businesses for our customers, and scaling them to serve hundreds of millions of customers. PMs are focused on understanding the needs (stated or unstated) of customers, sellers, and our business and coming up with creative and often solutions to serve these needs. Think of any feature on Amazon that you like e.g. ‘Secured Delivery’, ‘Prime’, 'Easy Returns' - all these were built by product managers.


Key job responsibilities
As a Regionalization Product Manager, you will own the end-to-end strategy and execution of network regionalization to optimize cost-to-serve while protecting customer experience. You will:

Define and drive the regionalization roadmap — identify opportunities to reduce long-zone shipments, optimize fulfillment placement, and improve network efficiency across fulfillment channels (Retail, FBA, EF)
Own the P&L trade-offs — quantify CTS impact of regionalization decisions (ship COGS, split rates, UPB), model scenarios, and make data-driven recommendations balancing cost, speed, and selection availability
Work cross-functionally with Operations, Supply Chain, Transportation, CX, and Tech teams to design and launch regionalization initiatives — from ASIN-level placement rules to zone-reduction programs
Develop and manage mechanisms to track regionalization performance (CPU, split rates, long-zone share, leakage), identify root causes of deviation, and drive corrective actions
Influence senior leadership — present business cases, trade-off analyses, and program updates to L8+ stakeholders with clear metrics, risks, and asks
Lead through ambiguity — navigate complex dependencies across multiple teams, define the problem space, and drive alignment where no playbook exists.

title: Area Manager, Early Career - (2027) - Illinois
descriptionHtml:
Power that runs the world | Discover careers in Operations
Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep. You'll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places, at scale. You'll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day. Here, the impact of what you build isn't abstract, it's visible, immediate, and meaningful - keeping one of the world's most complex operations moving forward. This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

This is not a corporate, remote or office-based position. This is a full-time, early career position located within one of Amazon’s fulfillment centers, sort centers, delivery stations or other operations buildings. Amazon is seeking customer focused individuals to lead a team of hourly employees across our Operations network! Our warehouses are fast-paced environments where standing, walking, and having on-the-production floor conversations are common as a supply chain leader.

As an Area Manager, you will be responsible for engaging, leading and developing your team in a warehouse environment. Your main focus will be motivating, mentoring, and managing your team to meet goals. Amazon provides extensive training and development to become an exceptional people leader. As a people manager, you will ensure that your team has all the tools needed to succeed and maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance and performance at work.

Visit this page to find more information on each of our building types. https://www.aboutamazon.com/workplace/facilities

Please note we are not able to provide sponsorship now or in the future for these positions. Eligible candidates must have work authorization without employer intervention to be considered.

This posting encompasses all openings in the country. Site placement is matched by aligning your location preferences with location availability after your interview. Relocation benefits are offered at time of offer to eligible candidates.

Benefits: Medical, financial, and/or other benefits. Visit this page to learn more about the benefits Amazon offers.
https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/benefits


Key job responsibilities
• Support, mentor and motivate 50-100 direct report Amazon Associates.
• Work independently and operate in an autonomous environment.
• Stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours.
• Willing and able to regularly work shift patterns that include nights, weekends, and/or holidays based on business needs. While shifts vary site to site, most follow a fixed 4-day work week with 3 days off.
• Oversee truck deliveries, handle and sort packages using pallet jacks, operate PIT. equipment (at applicable facilities) and step in as needed.
• Work in an environment where the noise level varies.
• Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach.
• Climb and descend stairs (when applicable).


A day in the life
As an Area Manager, no two days look exactly the same, but every shift gives you the chance to lead a team, solve real problems, and directly impact how millions of customers receive their orders.
Start of Shift: Set the Tone
• Get a handoff from the outgoing manager and review what's carrying over so nothing falls through the cracks.
• Lead a team huddle to kick off the shift. Huddles are used to align on goals, safety priorities, and key focus areas.
• Confirm your team is in place, positioned for success, and ready to go before operations begin.
Middle of Shift: Lead from the Floor
• Walk the floor regularly to stay connected to your team, spot issues early, and keep things running smoothly.
• Drive results across safety, quality, and productivity — balancing all three in real time.
• Adjust staffing and resources as volume and priorities shift throughout the day.
• Coach and develop your team members, respond to challenges as they come up, and partner with support teams to remove roadblocks.
• Keep peers and leadership informed on how the shift is tracking and flag risks before they become problems.
End of Shift: Close Strong
• Do a final walkthrough to make sure your area is clean, organized, and set up for the next team's success.
• Review your shift's performance data and capture what went well and what to improve
• Hand off to the incoming manager with a clear picture of priorities, open items, and next steps.
• Wrap up any remaining administrative tasks so you leave the shift with a clean slate.
• Every shift, you'll see the direct results of your leadership: from the energy of your team to the packages that reach customers' doorsteps. This is where your decisions have real, visible impact.

- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a bachelor’s or master’s degree. (You must have all degree requirements met before your first day).

- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
- Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills.

title: Praktikum im Bereich Logistik - Raunheim bei Frankfurt - 2027
descriptionHtml:
Bitte beachte: Wir haben verschiedene Möglichkeiten in ganz Deutschland und benötigen Flexibilität bezüglich der Standorte. Wenn du dich für die Stelle bewirbst, gib bitte alle deine bevorzugten Standorte in Deutschland an.
Alle unsere Praktika finden vollständig vor Ort statt.
Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. Mit über 50 Logistikzentren, hunderten von Zustellstationen und zehntausenden von Versandmitarbeiter:innen arbeitet das Team zusammen, um Artikel effizient an Kund:innen zu liefern. In den Logistikzentren werden jährlich Millionen von Artikeln kommissioniert und verpackt, während die Zustellteams daran arbeiten, Bestellungen pünktlich an die Kund:innen zu bringen. Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität, und die Betriebskultur ist geprägt von Teamwork, Vielfalt und einer gemeinsamen Arbeitsethik, die das Geschäft reibungslos am Laufen hält. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.

Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.


Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:
• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.


A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.
Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.
Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.


About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:
• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.

title: Data Center Technician, DCC Communities
descriptionHtml:
This is an exciting opportunity to be part of the launch team for our new Fredericksburg, VA site! You'll be based primarily in Fredericksburg as we scale operations. During the initial phase, which could be several months, travel to Stafford, Louisa, and Manassas may be required to support operational needs and training while the Fredericksburg sites ramp up to full capacity. All candidates must be available to work any of our day or evening shifts throughout the week. Join us as we build a strong team culture and create an exceptional workplace from the ground up!

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for Data Center Technicians to join our rapidly expanding team. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of data center operations. This position involves in-depth hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair as well as participating in an on-call rotation.



Key job responsibilities
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in on-call rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
- Some regional travel may be required


About the team

Key job responsibilities
Account Team Leadership
• Lead and develop a pod of 2-3 account executives covering multiple business units within a large managed care enterprise. Set priorities, remove blockers, and ensure consistent execution across the team.
• Serve as the single-threaded leader accountable for revenue, consumption growth, and customer satisfaction across the full portfolio.
• Establish team operating rhythm: pipeline reviews, deal strategy sessions, forecast calls, and weekly syncs to maintain accountability and momentum.
• Coach and mentor AEs on executive engagement, deal strategy, and career development. Build a succession-ready team.
• Serve as the single-threaded leader accountable for revenue, consumption growth, and customer satisfaction across the full account portfolio.
Strategic Account Management

title: Software Development Engineer II — Ads Reporting, Programmatic Reporting Interfaces
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Advertising's Measurement and Data Science (MADS) organization delivers campaign measurement and reporting across the advertising business and serves as the scientific center of excellence for measurement algorithm development. Within MADS, the Programmatic Reporting (PREP) team builds the interfaces and engines that turn measurement data into consistent, accurate, and efficient reporting for advertisers and partners — through programmatic interfaces rather than dashboards. Other companies' systems talk to ours to measure and grow their Amazon advertising investment.

We operate at scale. Billions of ad impressions, clicks, and conversion events are processed and summarized every day across petabyte-scale data with millions of transactions per second. Delivering this reliably requires invention ahead of common technologies and event-driven architectures built on AWS.

This SDE II role spans two of our three tier-1 reporting surfaces and the engines behind them:

- Reporting API — the pull surface: an asynchronous API for occasional, experimental, and analytical queries, and the back end to the Unified Report Builder.
- Amazon Marketing Stream — the push surface for recurring, high-volume reporting data.
- The processing engines — including the Offline Engine (Iceberg + Spark on EMR) that computes the data those surfaces deliver.

You will own projects end to end — requirements, system design, implementation, testing, and production support — on systems built with Spark and EMR alongside AWS services including Lambda, S3, SQS, Step Functions, Kinesis, and DynamoDB. The work is high-ownership and collaborative: you will partner with senior and principal engineers on architecture, and with product managers and technical account managers to translate customer pain points into features. You will also help deliver Unified Reporting as Amazon's single programmatic reporting solution and shift high-volume, recurring consumption from repeated API polling toward Amazon Marketing Stream.

Amazon is investing heavily in a world-class advertising business, and this team is at the forefront of that growth. We are highly motivated, collaborative, and direct, with a strong bias for action and a broad mandate to experiment. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do. If you want to build the next generation of large-scale reporting systems on modern data and AWS technologies, we would like to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
1. Design and build scalable, secure, and reliable features and data solutions across the Reporting API, Amazon Marketing Stream, and the processing engines — from requirements and system design through implementation, testing, and production support.
2. Deep-dive into client and server systems to optimize performance, scalability, maintainability, and extensibility, integrating data across a large number of services.
3. Collaborate with senior and principal engineers on architecture and system design for high-impact, strategic projects, and navigate ambiguity to deliver results.
4. Write clean, maintainable code and raise the bar through peer code reviews and engineering standards.
5. Propose tools, frameworks, and automation adopted across the team, and drive operational excellence through monitoring and continuous improvement.
6. Partner with product managers, technical account managers, technical program managers, and mentees to understand customer needs, elevate the team, and promote engineering excellence.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Today, we offer special daily deals and other limited-time offers across seven categories on the Woot website. We also sell a bunch of stuff on the Amazon Marketplace platform too.

We are looking for an Associate Vendor Manager who is a passionate customer and category advocate with proven ability to organize a significant amount of data and product information for customer-facing merchandising events. You will assist in sourcing inventory from key stakeholders and evaluating this inventory to run exciting deals on Woot.com.

You will also be responsible for the deal content and listings on Woot, ensuring we provide the best customer experience. This role will involve being very hands-on and having extreme attention to detail to deliver a seamless buying experience for the customer.

Key job responsibilities
A successful Associate Vendor Manager must:

· Be customer obsessed! We start with the customer and work backwards
· Effectively prioritize workload, identifying and then focusing on the most urgent tasks
· Excel in a working culture where accountability, transparency, and collaboration are the norm and where rapid deep dives into data and financial performance is a standard operating practice
· Drive actionable insights from large data sets and be comfortable taking swift and decisive action on a daily basis
· Demonstrate intense bias for action. In the deals business, every minute counts!
. Excel at collaborating with different stakeholders to understand their requirements and execute accordingly

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of account management, project or program management or buying experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience using Excel and other business analytic tools

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with software and editing tools (including HTML, Excel and SQL)
- Experience in online retail
- Experience using analytical specific tools such as Google Analytics, SQL or HTML

title: Sr. Technical Infrastructure Program Manager, QC Construction, North America Quick Commerce
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 17, 2026

The Quick Commerce (QC) Construction team is looking for a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager III (TIPM III) to own the construction delivery strategy and technical construction standards for QC’s rapidly scaling North America network.
QC deploys multiple physical infrastructure formats, including Stand Alone and Co-Located sites, where technical requirements vary by site type, existing building conditions, infrastructure capacity, and deployment scenario.

This role operates at the intersection of engineering design and field execution, defining how new and evolving QC infrastructure is built, determining whether technical designs and construction approaches are appropriate for specific deployment scenarios, and creating repeatable deployment standards where established processes do not yet exist.

The TIPM III will develop and maintain construction specifications, technical execution standards, GC performance requirements, and change-management mechanisms that govern QC construction delivery. You will use technical domain knowledge across mechanical, electrical, refrigeration, fire protection, and building infrastructure to identify constructability and integration risks, challenge technical assumptions, evaluate deployment alternatives, and provide field-based feedback to upstream teams for product and specification improvement.

This role goes beyond executing an approved construction plan. You will define and continuously improve the technical deployment process itself, translating lessons from active builds into scalable infrastructure standards that improve speed, quality, cost, and constructability across the QC portfolio.


Key job responsibilities
• Own and continuously improve QC construction infrastructure deployment standards across formats.
• Develop construction execution standards, specifications, technical scopes, GC performance requirements, and quality standards.
• Define new infrastructure deployment processes where established construction methods or standards do not yet exist.
• Evaluate technical designs, materials, sequencing, and construction approaches for specific deployment scenarios, considering constructability, infrastructure constraints, cost, and operational requirements.
• Partner with Design Engineering, Pre-Construction, SUEX, WHS, Operations, and external partners to resolve complex infrastructure build issues.
• Lead technical development of new delivery models, including design-build, establishing scalable governance and performance mechanisms.
• Root-cause recurring field issues and translate findings into upstream engineering, specification, and deployment-process improvements.
• Drive value engineering and technical cost optimization across the construction portfolio.
• Establish change-management mechanisms ensuring technical changes and field learnings are consistently incorporated into future deployments.
• Develop mechanisms to benchmark construction quality, GC technical performance, and recurring infrastructure failure modes.
• Serve as the technical escalation point for complex construction issues, determining whether failures stem from execution, design, specification, or deployment methodology.


A day in the life
You start by reviewing shortlisted sites, assessing infrastructure capacity, existing building conditions, and technical constraints to inform site selection and determine fit for QC deployment. You partner with internal teams to evaluate constructability, infrastructure requirements, cost, and technical risk before sites move forward. Later, you pressure-test the design-build model and identify opportunities to improve technical standards. When a Construction Manager escalates a complex field issue, you evaluate whether the root cause is design, specification, or execution and determine the appropriate path forward. Your work turns site and construction learnings into repeatable improvements for future QC deployments.

About the team
The QC Construction team builds and retrofit multiple site formats across varying building conditions, jurisdictions, and infrastructure configurations supporting Amazon’s Quick Commerce across North America. TIPMs work alongside Construction Managers, Pre-Construction, Design Engineering, SUEX, WHS, Finance, Operations, and external partners to develop scalable construction solutions. While Construction Managers lead day-to-day construction execution, TIPMs define and improve the technical standards that guide how sites are built: developing specifications, solving infrastructure challenges, evaluating construction approaches, and translating field findings into repeatable standards that improve speed, quality, cost, and constructability across the QC network.

Basic qualifications

- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Structural, Civil, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline.
- 4+ years of construction, infrastructure, engineering, or technical program/project management experience, or 10+ years of relevant discipline experience.
- Experience managing general contractors, A&E consultants, or technical vendors, including RFPs, bidding, change orders, RFIs, submittals, quality control, and technical issue resolution.
- Experience developing or implementing construction specifications, technical standards, scopes of work, deployment requirements, or construction quality systems.
- Experience evaluating technical designs and infrastructure constraints to determine fit for specific deployment scenarios.
- Experience identifying and resolving infrastructure build issues across mechanical, electrical, refrigeration, fire protection, or related building systems.
- Experience defining or improving technical deployment processes and translating field findings into scalable standards.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience developing new infrastructure deployment processes or technical standards where established solutions did not previously exist.
- Experience with design-build delivery models, infrastructure standardization, value engineering, or technical construction governance.
- Experience reading, interpreting, and developing construction drawings, specifications, technical scopes, and submittal documentation.
- Experience defining KPIs and SLAs for large-scale infrastructure or construction programs and communicating performance to senior leadership.
- Experience leveraging data and technology to identify systemic infrastructure issues and drive process improvement across a portfolio.
- Experience working across multiple site types, building conditions, jurisdictions, or infrastructure configurations.
- PE, CCM, PMP, General Contractor license, or similar technical/professional certification.

title: Praktikum im Bereich Logistik - Nuetzen - Start 2027
descriptionHtml:
Bitte beachte: Wir haben verschiedene Möglichkeiten in ganz Deutschland und benötigen Flexibilität bezüglich der Standorte. Wenn du dich für die Stelle bewirbst, gib bitte alle deine bevorzugten Standorte in Deutschland an.
Alle unsere Praktika finden vollständig vor Ort statt.
Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. Mit über 50 Logistikzentren, hunderten von Zustellstationen und zehntausenden von Versandmitarbeiter:innen arbeitet das Team zusammen, um Artikel effizient an Kund:innen zu liefern. In den Logistikzentren werden jährlich Millionen von Artikeln kommissioniert und verpackt, während die Zustellteams daran arbeiten, Bestellungen pünktlich an die Kund:innen zu bringen. Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität, und die Betriebskultur ist geprägt von Teamwork, Vielfalt und einer gemeinsamen Arbeitsethik, die das Geschäft reibungslos am Laufen hält. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.

Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.


Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:
• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.


A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.
Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.
Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.


About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:
• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.
Möglichkeiten:
• Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Praktikums kannst du für eine Absolvent:innen-Stelle oder ein zweites Praktikum in Betracht gezogen werden, was es dir ermöglicht, deine Reise mit Amazon fortzusetzen. Zusätzlich erhältst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Monatsgehalt, Umzugsunterstützung und Zugang zu einer Reihe von Mitarbeitervorteilen.
Praktikums-Starttermine über das Jahr:
• Wir stellen Praktikant:innen ein, die jederzeit von Januar bis Juli 2027 anfangen können. Jeden Monat führen wir 1-2 Onboarding-Tage für neue Mitarbeiter:innen durch.
Internal job description

Basic qualifications

- Derzeit im vorletzten oder letzten Jahr und auf dem Weg zu einem Universitätsabschluss in Supply Chain, Business/Management, Ingenieurwesen oder einem anderen verwandten Bereich.
- Berechtigt, ein Vollzeit-Praktikum von 3-6 Monaten zu absolvieren.
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in gesprochenem und geschriebenem Englisch und der Landessprache des Landes, für das du dich bewirbst (Gemeinsamer Europäischer Referenzrahmen C1).

Preferred qualifications

- Starke Problemlösungs- und Analysefähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Prozessverbesserungen und innovative Lösungen zu identifizieren.
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten, fähig zur effektiven Zusammenarbeit mit anderen.
- Bewiesene Neugier, Proaktivität und Bereitschaft, Herausforderungen in einem unklaren, schnelllebigen Umfeld anzunehmen.

title: Software Development Manager, AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about building highly scalable distributed systems that protect millions of customers? Do you want to work at the intersection of big data, real-time intelligence, and fraud prevention? The AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention team is looking for a talented software development manager to help us stay one step ahead of bad actors.

You'll be leading the data ingestion and intelligence team that design and build systems that process millions of events per second, develop machine learning-powered fraud detection processes, and directly contribute to keeping AWS safe. Whether it's architecting a new real-time detection engine, optimizing our graph-based fraud network analysis, or hardening our registration fraud defenses — your work will have immediate, measurable impact at AWS scale.

Key job responsibilities
* Own and operate a large-scale data ingestion platform processing 18+ billion events per day, ensuring data is ingested, enriched, and transformed in near real-time to power fraud detection and prevention across the organization.

* Lead the design, development, and maintenance of real-time intelligence pipelines using Apache Flink for data aggregation, anomaly detection, and usage pattern analysis.

* Drive the development of a graph database of millions of nodes and edges to model account relationships and surface fraud signals.

* Ensure high availability, reliability, and scalability of all platform services, including data vending APIs operating at 4,500+ TPS, as business demands and the AWS customer base grow.

* Own day-to-day team operations, including sprint planning, technical design reviews, operational excellence, and on-call management.

* Plan and execute the team's multi-year technical strategy, aligning platform capabilities with evolving business and security needs.

* Collaborate closely with Applied Scientists to identify and deliver the data products they need to detect and prevent fraud and account compromise faster.

* Serve as a technical leader with hands-on depth, diving deep with SDEs to review architectures, and resolve platform issues.

* Ensure platform services meet the needs of all downstream engineering and data science teams across the organization who depend on this team's products.

About the team
The AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention team protects AWS and its customers from fraud, abuse, and account compromise at global scale. We build highly scalable, real-time systems that ingest billions of signals daily, process petabytes of data, and make split-second decisions to stop bad actors — from account registration through the entire customer lifecycle. Our stack includes Apache Flink for stream processing, AWS Neptune for graph-based intelligence, and machine learning models for adaptive detection. We're a team of builders who care deeply about customer trust and love solving complex problems at massive scale.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Applied AI Solutions, Applied AI Solutions Acceleration Solutions Architecture
descriptionHtml:
The Applied AI Acceleration Solutions Architecture (AAA-SA) team is transforming how specialist expertise is delivered at scale across AWS. We are building agentic solutions that operationalize deep domain knowledge — enabling on-demand, consultative guidance that traditionally required engagement across multiple specialist roles. Our mission is to ensure every customer has on-demand access to trusted, specialized knowledge through personalized engagements that accelerate their business outcomes.

We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own the end-to-end technical program management of our agentic AI platform development, enablement/badging programs, and demo experience initiatives. In this role, you will drive execution across multiple engineering workstreams, coordinate cross-organizationally with Go-to-Market (GTM) teams, Solutions Architects, and service team engineering, and establish the mechanisms that keep this fast-moving, high-ambiguity program on track. You will operate with complete independence, advise VP-level leadership, and bring clarity to significantly complex, cross-functional initiatives at the intersection of AI, customer engagement, and enterprise knowledge management.

This is a strategic role that requires both deep technical program management acumen and the ability to navigate a landscape where the business and architectural strategy is still being defined. You will shape how we measure success, how we communicate progress, and how we scale our solutions from internal specialist teams to AWS field teams, partners, and ultimately customers.

Key job responsibilities
Engineering & Delivery Management

- Agentic AI Platform: Own end-to-end program management for the agentic AI solutions, driving the integrated roadmap and milestones from concept through production across all engineering workstreams.
- Engineering Coordination: Drive engineering coordination across engineering teams that co-develop production-grade AI solutions, and manage sprint cadences, dependency tracking, and releases.
- Risk Management: Proactively identify and mitigate risks across engineering capacity, agentic platform readiness, knowledge accuracy, and change management. Establish escalation paths and drive resolution before blockers materialize.

Business Reviews & Reporting

- Business Reviews: Own and run business reviews with comprehensive metrics on adoption, user satisfaction, knowledge coverage, and engineering velocity. Define the mechanisms that surface the right data to the right audience at the right time. Author monthly business roll-ups for VP-level audiences that synthesize engineering progress, business impact metrics, adoption trends, and strategic recommendations into a compelling narrative.
- Program Flashes: Produce and deliver program flashes providing leadership with crisp, data-driven status updates across all active workstreams — highlighting progress, risks, blockers, and key decisions needed.

Cross-Organizational Coordination

- Multi-org Alignment: Serve as the connective tissue between the Applied AI SA team, dedicated engineering teams, and service team engineering leadership. Align priorities, negotiate resources, and ensure joint accountability across organizations.

- GTM Partnership: Partner with GTM teams, solution architects, sales specialists, and customer success managers to ensure product development is informed by field feedback and aligned to revenue acceleration objectives.

- Ecosystem Integration: Coordinate with broader AWS initiatives (e.g., WWSO agentic programs, enterprise tools) to ensure interoperability, avoid duplication, and maximize the reach of composable knowledge agents.

Enablement & Badging Programs

- Badging Program: Own the program management for AI enablement and badging/certification programs that upskill AWS specialist and field teams. Define learning paths, track completion metrics, and drive adoption targets.
- Knowledge Champion Network: Coordinate the knowledge champion network — ensuring domain experts across specialist roles contribute to and govern AI-ready knowledge assets on a structured cadence.
- Enablement Execution: Manage enablement session planning, asset development tracking, and feedback loop mechanisms that continuously improve solution quality and user satisfaction.

Demo Experience Program

- Demo Development: Coordinate demo development across industry-specific demos, live demo environments, and deployable assets that empower SAs and sellers across all deal stages.
- Platform Evolution: Manage the portal’s transition to next-generation demo infrastructure, including partner onboarding workflows, content publishing processes, and cross-team integration requirements.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing adoption metrics and preparing a concise update for a VP-level review on Applied AI Solutions Acceleration program. Mid-morning, you lead a working session with solution architects and engineering leads to align on a technical approach for transforming business outcomes using agentic solutions. After lunch, you partner with go-to-market team members to validate that the solution meets field team needs, then join a design review where you surface hidden risks and push toward a simpler path forward.

About the team
The Applied AI Acceleration Solutions Architecture team sits within Applied AI Solutions and was chartered to address the challenge of scaling specialist expertise to meet customer demand.

Our approach is phased and deliberate: we deploy with specialist teams for rapid testing and learning, expand to broader AWS field teams for scale validation, and ultimately launch to partners and customers as proven solutions. We are customer zero for Applied AI, and the insights we capture at scale directly inform our external customer solutions.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
- Experience with AI/ML technologies
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in software development
- Can show strong verbal and written communication skills

Preferred qualifications

- 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
- MBA, or 2+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
- Experience working with customers, technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs
