title: Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) Manager, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Based at our Redmond, Washington campus, the Amazon Leo EHS Manager will develop, communicate, train, drive, manage, audit, improve, and measure Amazon Leo's EHS performance. This role will include developing and enhancing EHS compliance and risk management processes. Driving understanding, engagement to provide EHS performance improvement, for the Leo portfolio, influence business units leadership, and further integrate EHS into daily operations.

Key job responsibilities
• Conducts investigations of working conditions in places of employment for the prevention of occupational disease and industrial health hazards, with specific references to chemicals, noise, lasers, and other potential worker health hazards.
• Collaborate with colleagues across multiple disciplines within the company to assure effective program implementation and cohesiveness.
• Promote the successful integration of safety and health risk management into key business operations, processes, and audits.
• Perform data analytics on company and industry EHS information to drive improvement initiatives.
• Promote EHS awareness throughout the organization through effective employee communications, participation, and programming.
• Prepare and execute sampling plans to include determination of appropriate analytic methods, equipment selection, calibration, laboratory analysis, and results interpretations.

title: (Physical) Security Specialist Intern - 2027 Internship, DUB West
descriptionHtml:
Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.

Amazon's data centers house the infrastructure that powers the world's largest cloud. Protecting them is mission-critical — and as a Security Specialist Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will help ensure the physical security of these facilities from the inside.

You will drive operational security excellence, write reports, create presentations, and communicate with management on the status of physical security operations. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Security Specialist position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Technical/Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Business Administration, Security Management, or a related field who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

About the Role

As a Security Specialist Intern, you will work within the Data Center Security team and play a hands-on role in the day-to-day physical security operations of Amazon's data centers. You will collaborate with security vendors, analyze operational data, and help identify improvements to surveillance systems, access controls, and security procedures.

This is not a desk-only role. You will engage directly with the people, systems, and processes that keep Amazon's most critical infrastructure safe.

What You Will Do
- Coordinate with vendors involved in new security construction, repairs, daily security operations and patrols, and planning.
- Analyze security metrics and data to identify trends and recommend improvements
- Make suggestions on improving electronic surveillance systems and access controls
- Help develop and deliver guidance to data center occupants on reducing false alarms
- Write reports and create presentations on the status of physical security operations for management
- Assist with planning and coordinating security-related projects
- Support incident documentation and follow-up processes

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday through Friday.

Please note that a full-time Security Specialist position could involve day, evening, or weekend shifts and on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will help protect the infrastructure that keeps AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

- Impact. Your work protects the physical infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. The security operations you support keep Amazon's most critical facilities safe and running.
- Action. You will move fast, analyze real security data, and make recommendations that get implemented. Your ideas do not stay theoretical — they get tested and put into practice.
- Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will learn how physical security operates at world-class scale and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.
- Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills

Preferred qualifications

title: Transportation Representative
descriptionHtml:
Network Operations Center (NOC) – Overview

The Network Operations Center (NOC) serves as the central command and control hub for Transportation Execution across Amazon's Supply Chain network, spanning multiple geographies including North America, India, and the EU.

NOC is responsible for ensuring the seamless, on-time movement of freight — from vendor pick-ups to Amazon Fulfillment Centers (FCs), and from FCs to carrier hubs. When exceptions arise, NOC takes swift ownership of resolution while keeping all relevant stakeholders informed throughout the process.

Beyond tactical problem-solving, NOC is also entrusted with a strategic mandate: identifying trends in network exceptions, driving process automation, and recommending operational improvements to streamline transportation workflows. This requires continuous network monitoring and in-depth analysis of network data.

In essence, NOC plays a pivotal role in the smooth functioning of Amazon's transportation network — directly influencing Amazon's ability to deliver on its promise to customers.

Role of a Trans Ops Representative

A Trans Ops Representative at NOC acts as a critical link between key stakeholders — including Transportation Carriers, Hubs, and Warehouses — facilitating the flow of information and resolving issues that could impact customer experience or business continuity. The role spans two core verticals:

Inbound Operations – Manages the Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring freight is picked up on time and delivered to FCs as per scheduled appointments. The Trans Ops Representative addresses any issues arising during the pick-up to delivery lifecycle.
Outbound Operations – Manages the FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring trucks depart FCs on schedule to fulfill customer delivery promises. The Trans Ops Representative addresses any issues from the point freight leaves the FC through to last-mile delivery.
Trans Ops Representatives drive real-time resolutions by leveraging internal tools, querying relevant data, and making informed, time-sensitive decisions. The ideal candidate brings a solid understanding of logistics operations, a sharp eye for data trends, and the ability to communicate effectively — both verbally and in writing.

Key job responsibilities
Trans Ops Representatives are expected to proactively identify opportunities for process improvement and drive them to completion. Core responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Serving as the communication bridge between external stakeholders (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal stakeholders (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
Systematically escalating issues or data variances to the appropriate owners and teams, and following through to ensure timely resolution
Preparing and presenting weekly narratives that outline key findings and variances against goals in review forums
Delivering real-time customer experience support within a 24×7 operating environment

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in any discipline
- 12–24 months of relevant work experience
- Strong communication skills — both verbal and written — with the ability to facilitate seamless information flow between external and internal stakeholders
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables and VLOOKUPs
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively within a team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree with strong academic foundation
- Sound logical and analytical thinking skills
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to coordinate across multiple cross-functional teams

descriptionHtml:
Il team Operations è il cuore pulsante di Amazon. Svolge un ruolo fondamentale per il nostro business, perché ci permette di evadere e spedire gli ordini in modo efficiente, così che i nostri clienti li ricevano nei tempi previsti. Nel ruolo di Area Manager, dovrai garantire la regolare operatività del tuo sito logistico, per riuscire a soddisfare le richieste dei clienti. Sarai a capo di un team che contribuisce a garantire la sicurezza, l’efficienza e l’alta qualità dei nostri processi e ti occuperai di una serie di progetti su tutta la nostra rete con lo scopo di incrementare la produttività.

Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è Logistica, Trasporto Merci e Spedizione. La posizione è inquadrata al Livello 1 o superiore, in base alle competenze, capacità ed esperienza del/della candidato/a.

title: Senior Software Engineer- ML Network Stack, ML Network Stack - Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced engineer to join our team that owns the network stack for EC2 distributed AI/ML systems. The team develops support for a variety of frameworks and communication libraries including NCCL, NVSHMEM, NIXL, NCCL GIN, and Perplexity kernels. Solid knowledge of Linux, networking, and performant coding is important. Experience with embedded systems is valued, and experience with high-speed networking or HPC/RDMA interconnects is highly valued.

If you like solving hard problems, want to work with HPC and ML customers, iterate fast and deliver meaningful solutions at scale, then come join us! This truly is a role at the forefront of AI/ML—you'll be working on features for the largest clusters, with the largest customers, for the largest AI models. .

The organization you would be joining is Annapurna Labs, an integral part of Amazon that develops hardware and software components that are critical building blocks for EC2 infrastructure. Every instance in EC2 is running some type of hardware designed by Annapurna Labs. We specialize in designing software, systems, and chips that optimize the AWS customer experience.

Key job responsibilities
Be a senior engineer on a team that builds and maintains the infrastructure that monitors and reports on functionality and performance of massive testing workloads run at scale. Use internal Amazon CI/CD tools, Linux, and public AWS products to automate the delivery of our software to customers, saving developer time. Write Python code that effortlessly spools up large clusters and runs benchmarks and applications for ML and HPC workloads. Use AWS Managed Grafana and Athena to digest the massive amount of performance data generated by these workloads and create dashboards for developers and stakeholders. Invent automatic mechanisms to alert developers to functional and performance regressions so they never reach reach customers. Manage the complexity of infrastructure that covers many instance types, software stacks, Linux operating systems, cutting-edge releases and make it easy to evolve.

A day in the life
As a Senior SDE III on the Elastic Compute team at Annapurna Labs, you work where silicon meets software — your decisions ripple across millions of EC2 instances and shape the performance, security, and cost efficiency of the AWS compute platform. A day might start by root-causing a fleet-wide latency anomaly across the full stack, from the hypervisor and Nitro offload path down to firmware; move into owning the architecture for a multi-year initiative and leading the design review where the hard questions about scale, failure domains, and safe fleet-wide rollout get asked — often co-designed directly with silicon and hardware partners; and end deep in a low-level C/C++ or Rust change, a down-to-the-instruction performance investigation, or twenty minutes pairing with a newer engineer because raising the bar around you is part of the job, not a distraction from it. The systems you build run continuously, at massive scale, with little tolerance for error — so a great day ends with something shipped or a hard problem genuinely understood, knowing your work will be quietly running in data centers around the world tomorrow.

About the team
The organization you would be joining is Annapurna Labs, an integral part of AWS that develops hardware and software components that are critical building blocks for EC2 infrastructure. Every instance in EC2 is running some type of hardware designed by Annapurna Labs. We specialize in designing software, systems, and chips that optimize the AWS customer experience.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 8+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 8+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- 3+ years as a mentor, tech lead or leading engineering teams
- 3+years experience in SW/HW Co-Design

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience creating automated dashboards and visualization (such as Grafana)

title: Sr. Electrical Engineer, Sustainability Engineering
descriptionHtml:
The Sustainability Engineering team is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to drive the definition, development, and continuous improvement of electrical infrastructure standards across Amazon facilities in Europe.

You will join a team which:
• Enables EV charging infrastructure implementation through electrical design definition and review
• Develops grid infrastructure standards spanning high-voltage up to 24 kV (HV) and low-voltage (LV) systems, ensuring a coordinated and resilient approach to grid design
• Explores emerging technologies to address evolving sustainability needs, with emphasis on smart grid integration, efficiency, and resilience
• Drives end-to-end deployment of EV chargers and other sustainability technologies across European sites
• Defines processes for procurement and maintenance of electrical and sustainability infrastructure
• Owns cost budgeting, forecasting, and tracking across sustainability programmes

Possible locations for this role: Luxembourg, London, Munich, Milan, Madrid, and Barcelona

Amazon is committed to building a sustainable future for our customers, local communities, and the planet. Under The Climate Pledge, we committed to achieving net-zero carbon across our business by 2040, ten years ahead of the Paris Agreement. To get there, we need driven people who are dedicated to making a meaningful impact through sustainable energy technologies and scalable infrastructure design.

Key job responsibilities
• Own and develop electrical equipment standards, including standard designs for core electrical infrastructure in partnership with manufacturers and internal stakeholders
• Perform design validation and review to ensure compliance with established electrical standards during installation and commissioning of infrastructure
• Act as subject matter expert (SME) for LV and HV (up to 24kV) electrical systems
• Align stakeholder expectations and define technical requirements for EV charging network infrastructure and smart grid deployments
• Drive the technology roadmap for electrical infrastructure, including EV chargers, substations, energy efficiency solutions, and IoT technologies (e.g. smart metres)
• Develop business cases and present recommendations to leadership to secure approval for programme scoping and investment decisions
• Coordinate with programme managers to ensure quality and standards compliance across large-scale installations
• Drive process improvement across commissioning, audit, value engineering, and cost control activities


A day in the life
Your day could include engagement with all levels of the organisation and multiple stakeholder groups to drive short-, mid-, and long-term technical decisions with large-scale impact across the Amazon network. You will also work with partners from Operations, Reliability & Maintenance, Health and Safety, Global Fleet Product, Finance, Procurement, and external vendors to design and deploy electrical infrastructure across Amazon’s operational sites in Europe.

About the team
The Sustainability Engineering team drives the execution and deployment of EV charging infrastructure, grid connections, and smart grid solutions across Amazon’s European sites. We manage supply chain, procurement, and maintenance activities, and define the processes that ensure consistent, scalable delivery. To enable this, the team develops and continuously improves electrical standards and technologies that underpin reliable, compliant deployment at pace. We power Amazon’s sustainable growth through operational excellence and continuous innovation.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in content writing
- Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field, with experience in electrical infrastructure design, standards development, or large-scale electrical systems implementation
- Demonstrated knowledge of HV and/or LV electrical distribution systems (up to 24kV) and applicable standards

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in technical program and product management, technical development or related roles in the industrial EV charging solutions sector
- Proficiency in one or more European languages (in addition to English)
- Experience working with public grid operators or Distribution System Operators (DSOs)
- Working knowledge of national grid codes and DSO requirements in one or more EU/UK markets
- Experience with protection coordination, fault level analysis, or power systems modelling
- Chartered Electrical Engineer (CEng) or equivalent professional registration

title: Technical Program Manager III, Amazon Leo Partner Services (ALPS)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access. With 38 signed distribution partners globally and service launch approaching, now is an exciting time to join a team that is actively shaping how satellite broadband reaches the world.

As a Technical Program Manager on the Amazon Leo Partner Services team, you will own and drive complex, externally facing technical integration programs with Amazon Leo's global distribution partners, including some of the largest internet service providers in the world. You will serve as the primary program leader responsible for ensuring partners successfully integrate, validate, and launch satellite internet service in their contracted territories and channels. This role sits at the center of partner-facing execution and internal product coordination, spanning API onboarding, BSS/OSS integration, network readiness, operational enablement, and launch milestones. You will work cross-functionally with Amazon Leo engineering, product, solutions architecture, and operations teams to ensure partner-facing deliverables are defined, prioritized, and delivered on time.

This position may require access to export-controlled information (ECI) subject to EAR and ITAR. Final employment decision is contingent upon satisfactory completion of export control screenings and obtaining any necessary export licenses or approvals, based on nationality, citizenship, and other factors considered by applicable export control regulations.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end partner technical integration programs from discovery through launch readiness, defining integration scope, success criteria, milestones, and deliverables across partner and Amazon Leo teams while identifying risks, dependencies, and critical path items early to drive mitigation plans.
- Lead recurring program reviews, executive checkpoints, and milestone tracking sessions with strategic distribution partners, translating partner integration requirements into clear internal execution plans and managing blockers through timely escalation.
- Coordinate delivery across multiple internal workstreams — including API releases, backend services, hardware readiness, and operational tooling — partnering with Product, Engineering, Solutions Architects, and Operations teams to align roadmaps with partner launch commitments.
- Develop and maintain standardized program artifacts such as integration plans, dependency maps, and executive status reporting, and implement repeatable frameworks for global partner onboarding and launch readiness.
- Analyze program data, track integration maturity metrics, and report launch risk to senior leadership, using insights to drive continuous improvement of the ALPS launch model and influence prioritization of partner-critical capabilities.

A day in the life
You will operate in a regional context, supporting distribution partners across your assigned region in coordination with central ALPS teammates and other regional Technical Program Managers. Your day may include leading a partner integration review in the morning, aligning with engineering on API readiness in the afternoon, and preparing an executive launch risk update for leadership. Beyond your regional portfolio, you will also own at least one global-scope initiative aimed at improving the partner experience across all ALPS regions, giving you visibility and impact well beyond your immediate territory.

About the team
The Amazon Leo Partner Services (ALPS) team is responsible for the onboarding, integration, and enablement of Amazon Leo's distribution partners worldwide. We work with telecom operators and regional service providers to deliver satellite internet service in inclusive regulatory and operational environments. With a rapidly growing partner network and service launch on the horizon, the team is scaling quickly to meet demand from some of the largest internet service providers in the world.

Our mission is to make Amazon Leo partnerships predictable, scalable, and launch-ready through technical rigor and disciplined program execution. Every team member owns a regional partner portfolio while also driving at least one global project that raises the bar on the partner experience across all markets. This combination of regional depth and global reach means you will build expertise in local market dynamics while shaping how ALPS operates at scale.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 3+ years of software development experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

descriptionHtml:

You’ll stay ahead of market trends, pricing dynamics, and technological advancements to refine sourcing strategies, ensuring Amazon remains competitive. Cross-functional leadership is key, as you partner with legal, NPI operations, and planning teams to assess future sourcing needs and develop risk mitigation plans. You’ll also lead supplier evaluations, conduct business reviews to ensure performance meets expectations, and report progress to senior leadership, demonstrating how your strategies drive the success of Amazon Devices.

- Solid working background in the display touch and supporting subcomponent industries, with the competence to cooperate with engineering team daily to carry out core work covering, for example Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Failure Analysis (FA).

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field
- Experience in negotiations with global suppliers with a proven track record in cost reduction

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Search Navigation AI
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Search Navigation AI team helps customers go from a broad search intent to the few products that fit their needs, so they can make a confident purchase decision. We generate highly relevant, context-aware, and personalized search refinements. We also decide the order they appear in across Amazon's Search Navigation experiences, guiding customers to the most relevant results. The team owns Search Navigation's P0 metrics and defect guardrails, which keep performance and reliability high for hundreds of millions of customers.


We are reinventing search refinement with generative AI. Our recently launched Smart Refinement experience uses large language models (LLMs) served online to turn product specifications into natural-language suggestions that match how customers think, such as "for colder weather" or "lightweight for travel." Each suggestion is personalized to the customer's context. Next, we are building multi-turn, conversational refinement, where each interaction builds on the last and helps customers narrow their intent in fewer steps.

We build and run the engineering systems behind this work, including the Navigation Experience Service (NES). NES connects to Amazon's core search systems, serves more than 3 billion queries worldwide every day, and runs real-time LLM inference at global scale under strict latency and cost limits. Our platform supports launches of new navigation content and UIs, and it makes fast offline and online experimentation possible.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer who is a pragmatic problem solver, comfortable with ambiguity, and curious about applied science. You will build and improve the Search Navigation platform, including the systems that serve LLMs in real time, and work closely with Applied Scientists to take new models from research into production.

Key job responsibilities
1. Design, build, and operate large-scale, distributed, low-latency services that power Amazon Search Navigation experiences worldwide
2. Build and optimize online LLM serving for Smart Refinement and multi-turn conversational refinement, with a focus on latency, reliability, and cost
3. Work with Applied Scientists, Product Managers, and Program Managers to define requirements and integrate models into production systems
4. Build scalable data pipelines that process large volumes of search and behavioral data for feature generation, model training, and evaluation
5. Design, run, and analyze online A/B experiments to measure the impact of new models and features
6. Contribute to operational excellence for critical services, including monitoring, on-call, and P0 metrics and defect guardrails
7. Write high-quality, well-tested code and take part in design and code reviews

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 3+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 3+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 3+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 3+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware
- Experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
- Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution

title: Chief Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.

The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response. The CE serves as an expert technical resource interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support AWS.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).

NOTE: Relocation assistance will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Act as the primary escalation point for all facilities-related issues. Oversee operation and management of routine and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.

Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures and troubleshooting of facility within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).

Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians and are responsible for working with Facility Manager (FM) to set team culture.

Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams

May assist in the building out of new facilities and assist in projects to increase current facility efficiency

Working outside of normal business hours for routine maintenance as required, including responding to out-of-hours emergency calls.

Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience.

Work with IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability and efficiency

Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff

Establish building performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility of operations and maintenance.

Utilize Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook and other basic administrative tools to perform day-to-day tasks



Physical Requirements:

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodation:

Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection



Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment that supports servers that must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. Equipment will include but is not limited to stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

The CE directs, trains and supports technicians in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. They manage projects from conception to completion. These projects involve independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities.

title: Sports Business Lead, Prime Video Mexico
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video is building the future of how fans in Mexico watch live sports. We are looking for an experienced Sports Business Lead to own the in-life business performance, programming and local relationships for our growing live sports portfolio in Mexico, reporting into the LATAM Sports Business Lead.

You will join Amazon's industry-leading global sports team, which is transforming the delivery and experience of watching live sports via streaming. In this role, you will take the lead on Prime Video's Mexican sports properties (including the NBA, Chivas Guadalajara and Federación Mexicana de Fútbol-related rights) owning their in-life performance, shaping their programming, and building Prime Video's credibility as a sports destination with local clubs, federations, broadcasters and talent. You will operate both strategically and tactically, delivering independently while partnering closely with the broader LATAM, EU and US sports teams.

You will bring credible, hands-on experience in live sports (on the business, rights, programming and production sides) and apply it quickly in working with Amazon's existing local teams and partners. You will have a deep understanding of the Mexican sports-media landscape and an established network across clubs, federations and broadcasters that you can activate from day one. You will show high standards of professionalism and an obsession with the customer experience in order to continually improve Prime Video's live sports proposition in Mexico.

Key job responsibilities
• Take the lead on the in-life performance of Prime Video's sports properties in Mexico (NBA, Chivas, FMF and future local rights), including business-case goals, course correction and post-event reviews, in collaboration with local and international teams.
• Define programming, scheduling and match-picking for Mexican properties in collaboration with local teams and the global production function, ensuring integrated sports and content delivery.
• Build and manage ongoing external relationships with Mexican sports federations, clubs, broadcasters and major talent/ambassadors, acting as Prime Video's in-market spokesperson for the properties.
• Partner with the Amazon global production function and the LATAM Sports Business Lead to select, manage and get the best from local production partners, and support talent selection in collaboration with local teams.
• Drive ancillary and commercial value for the Mexican portfolio (including advertising revenues with Amazon Ads, social media, and news/content access) in coordination with the relevant teams.
• Represent Prime Video sports in local-market discussions, developing new club, federation and broadcaster relationships that strengthen Prime Video's position in Mexico.
• Ensure best practice and consistency in how Mexican properties are operated, working in alignment with sports leads across LATAM, EU and US, and trading best practices across territories.

About the team
The PV Sports International team leads Amazon's live sports offerings on Prime Video worldwide outside the US and Canada. This team defines the strategy, acquires the rights, and executes the delivery of tentpole sports on Prime Video, with properties including the UEFA Champions League (UK, Germany, Italy), the English Premier League (UK, Sweden, Denmark), Roland-Garros (France), Wimbledon (Germany, Austria), Copa do Brasil and Serie A (Brazil), Chivas (Mexico), ICC cricket (Australia), and boxing and baseball (Japan). This role reports into the LATAM Sports Business Lead and will be the dedicated in-market owner for Mexico.

Basic qualifications

- Experience managing teams
- Experience developing, negotiating and executing business agreements
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience
- 8+ years of experience in sports media, live sports business, rights, programming, account management or business development.
- Deep knowledge of the Mexican sports-media landscape, including its clubs, federations, broadcasters and live-rights dynamics.
- An established local network of relationships across Mexican clubs, federations and/or broadcasters.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working directly with or within Mexican sports properties such as the NBA in Mexico, Liga MX clubs, or the FMF.
- Knowledge of the digital video and streaming landscape, including an understanding of digital video distribution.
- Experience driving commercial and advertising value around live sports properties.
- Experience operating across multiple markets or coordinating with international teams across time zones.
- Portuguese language skills (written and verbal).

title: WW Tech Leader, Games TFC, AWS for Games
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about the games industry and ready to shape how game studios and publishers build on the cloud? AWS is looking for a Worldwide Technical Leader to own the global technical direction for the Games sub-industry within the Media, Entertainment, Games, and Sports (MEGS) organization. In this role, you will operate as the industry domain technical strategist, coordinating with business leadership to translate strategy into community action across a global Technical Field Community (TFC).

This is a dedicated individual contributor leadership role with no direct reports. You will lead through influence, earning the trust of community members across organizations and mobilizing them toward shared priorities. Your work will include prioritizing the use cases that matter most to games customers, organizing builders to create reusable solutions, resolving industry-specific technical requests at scale, incubating technical content, representing AWS at major games industry events, and growing the next generation of games specialists across the field. Success in this role means games customers get the right solutions faster, account teams are equipped to win, and AWS strengthens its position as the platform of choice for the games industry.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the global technical direction for the Games community, partnering with business leadership to align field insights to strategy, prioritizing use cases and customer needs that guide the technical field community outputs.
- Serve as the technical voice of the games market to AWS service teams, product managers, and go-to-market leaders, gathering customer pain points, emerging trends, and competitive intelligence from field engagements and translating them into structured product and roadmap input.
- Drive the creation and scaling of reusable technical artifacts — solutions, workshops, reference architectures, and guidance packages — aligned to prioritized games use cases, and set the quality bar for all games-related technical content published by the community.
- Lead AWS technical presence at major games industry events such as GDC, Gamescom, and re:Invent, owning session strategy, delivering keynotes, and engaging executive-level stakeholders at strategic games customers and partners.
- Grow and scale games industry expertise across the field by packaging successful customer engagements into repeatable solution architectures, sponsoring onboarding pathways, and mentoring generalist solutions architects into credible games practitioners.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing account plans with a regional lead to identify where games customers need deeper technical engagement, then join a sync with service leadership to share field feedback on a product roadmap. After lunch, you could be reviewing a reference architecture that a community member built for a game backend use case, providing guidance before it gets published. Later, you are preparing keynote content for an upcoming industry conference and connecting with an account team to help shape a technical win strategy for a strategic customer evaluation.

About the team
The MEGS team operates four industry-aligned Technical Field Communities (Media & Entertainment, Games, Advertising & Marketing Technology, and Betting & Gaming). These communities are the connective tissue between deep domain expertise and field execution at scale. Leadership for the Games Technical Field Community sits within MEGS and brings together the builders from cross cutting technical organizations across AWS who share a passion for the games industry and converge around shared industry challenges to solve customer challenges with field scalable solutions. Our closest partners include the Games sub-industry business leader, AWS service teams, product marketing, go-to-market and account teams worldwide. If you want to combine deep games industry knowledge with the reach and resources of AWS to help customers build what is next, we would love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences and at C-level, including training, workshops, publications
- Experience with Unity, Unreal, CryEngine, Lumberyard or proprietary 3D game engine, or industry-equivalent technology (3D animation, simulation, etc), or experience in Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops)
- Experience in Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops), or experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of distributed systems design and implementation or equivalent
- Knowledge of large scale automation and workflow management or equivalent
- Knowledge of database design and implementation or equivalent
- Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers
- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
- Knowledge of game infrastructure, backend services and Game Servers (including the GameLift family of services).
- Knowledge of cloud game development like game engines, build pipelines, and cloud-native development workflows for games.

title: Commissioning Engineer, AWS Commissioning, AMER-West
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Are you experienced in Critical Infrastructure Commissioning and looking for a fast paced environment to work in? As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of Amazon owned data centers. The Amazon Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements. The CxE is responsible for supporting vendors, contractors, and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:

-Medium and low voltage power systems
-Generators
-UPS
-HVAC (Air Handlers / Exhaust Fans / VFD)
-Chilled Water Systems
-Building Management systems (BMS)
-Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)
-Testing and balancing
-Pumps and Hydronic systems

Physical Requirements
Walk job sites in uneven terrain
Work at heights and from ladders
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
Lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration with potential for night and weekends
Perform physical tasks throughout the day without becoming overly tired
Ability to manipulate small wires and objects easily
Work in a noisy environment
Work in environments that are colder or hotter than a normal office environment

Additional Job Requirements
· Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 80% of the year.
· Required to provide personal transportation for meetings and job visits away from the office; reimbursed.

U.S Citizenship Required

Key job responsibilities
The Commissioning Engineer (CxE) provides testing and validation oversight of AWS data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure. CxEs review design documents, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), and manage third-party commissioning vendors in the performance of onsite pre-functional, functional, and integrated systems testing. They take Ownership of their projects’ successes by Diving Deep to resolve technical issues and having Bias for Action to address everchanging schedule and coordination demands onsite. Additionally, CxEs communicate lessons learned and continuously collaborate on program improvements.

On a typical project, the CxE works across AWS engineering, capacity delivery, operations, and contractor teams to coordinate site activities, prioritize tasks, and ensure each issue has clear path to resolution. The CxE manages the project commissioning vendor whose primary scope is to identify issues, determine criticality, propose solutions, and document their findings. title: Senior SDE, VPC Lattice
descriptionHtml:
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS's services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you'll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (IoT), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS.

EC2 Networking is one of the foundational services that enabled customers to move to the cloud. We manage the traffic flowing through one of the largest networks in the industry, handling billions of requests. VPC Lattice is how we are re-inventing application networking — giving customers a fully managed way to connect, secure, and observe services across accounts and VPCs without the undifferentiated heavy lifting of building their own networking layer.

We are seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to help scale the next generation of our networking architecture and control plane. As Lattice adoption accelerates, the hard problems are increasingly about scale, elasticity, and reliability: how the control plane provisions and propagates configuration across tens of thousands of endpoints, how it stays consistent and fast as the fleet grows by orders of magnitude, and how we evolve the data path without disrupting live customer traffic. This is a senior role for an engineer who wants to own ambiguous, large-scale technical problems end to end and raise the bar for the engineers and teams around them.

A successful candidate is a technical leader who can decompose a hard, loosely-defined problem into a sequence of deliverable milestones, drive the design across team and service boundaries, and bring other engineers along. You are comfortable going deep on distributed-systems fundamentals — consistency, throughput, failure modes, operational safety — and equally comfortable zooming out to influence multi-year architecture. You raise the operational and quality bar for the whole team, not just your own code.

Key job responsibilities
Own the architecture and implementation of control-plane-scaling systems that keep VPC Lattice fast, consistent, and reliable as the fleet grows by orders of magnitude.
Lead the design of ambiguous, large-scale technical problems end to end — from a loosely-defined goal to a sequence of shippable milestones with clear tradeoffs documented.
Drive technical decisions that span team and service boundaries, building alignment with partner teams across EC2 Networking, PrivateLink, and the broader UC organization.
Set and enforce the bar for operational excellence — observability, failure isolation, safe deployment, and the ability to evolve the data path without disrupting live customer traffic.
Identify and remove whole classes of operational and scaling risk rather than one-off defects, and leave the team's software measurably better and easier to maintain.
Mentor and grow engineers on the team: raise the quality of designs and reviews, develop others' judgment on distributed-systems tradeoffs, and multiply your impact through the people around you.
Invent on customers' behalf, turning high-demand internal and external requirements into durable, well-engineered capabilities.

About the team
We are scaling the next generation of VPC Lattice and PrivateLink — a very successful, fast-growing product with a strong multi-year vision, a great team, and genuinely interesting distributed-systems and networking problems to solve. The work unlocks features in high demand from both internal and external customers while hardening the control plane for the scale that growth demands. Please reach out to me (Ehren Graber) for more information, or click Request Informational through the posted job. Thank you!

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, GTM Lead, Fashion & Fitness Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Go-to-Market Lead, Category Marketing This role is responsible for developing and leading the category marketing strategy for an assigned F2 business area, including Fashion, Sports & Outdoors, or Licensed Sports. Serving as the single-threaded marketing partner to category leadership, this leader translates business priorities, customer insights, assortment strategies, and commercial goals into annual and seasonal go-to-market plans that drive traffic, engagement, and growth.

The Go-to-Market Lead owns the category's integrated marketing roadmap, including campaign calendaring, investment prioritization, Tier B targeted activations, Tier C foundational programs, and category contributions to Tier A tentpole moments. They develop a clear point of view on where marketing can most effectively support category growth, align cross-functional teams around prioritized customer moments, and ensure plans are grounded in measurable category objectives.

This role partners closely with Business, Creative, Product, BI, and Traffic & Targeting teams. The Go-to-Market Lead provides the category inputs required to inform NASM and channel planning, including assortment priorities, deal calendars, customer audiences, launch milestones, and business goals.

Key job responsibilities
Category Marketing Strategy & Planning
• Develop the annual and quarterly marketing strategy for an assigned category, translating business goals into clear customer, campaign, and investment priorities.
• Establish the category's marketing narrative, strategic pillars, target audiences, and role within the broader F2 Integrated Marketing portfolio.
• Identify the customer missions, seasonal shifts, cultural moments, launches, and category-specific opportunities where marketing can generate incremental business impact.
• Build integrated plans that connect category priorities across campaigns, customer experiences, content, creative, and traffic-driving channels.
• Identify emerging category trends, customer shifts, and growth opportunities that inform marketing strategy and investment recommendations.

GTM Ownership & Campaign Prioritization
• Own the category's annual and seasonal GTM calendar, balancing business priorities, customer relevance, operational readiness, and available marketing capacity.
• Lead Tier B targeted and Tier C foundational GTM activations from initial business intake through strategy, executional alignment, launch, and performance review.
• Represent the category's priorities and customer needs within Tier A tentpole planning, including major shopping events, seasonal campaigns, and cross-F2 initiatives.
• Develop clear GTM briefs that define the customer problem, business opportunity, audience, value proposition, success metrics, dependencies, and activation approach.
• Establish prioritization recommendations when category requests exceed available marketing, creative, or channel capacity.
• Ensure campaigns have clear launch criteria, accountable owners, measurable objectives, and documented decisions.

Category Partnership & Business Leadership
• Serve as the primary marketing partner to category leadership and maintain a comprehensive understanding of the category's financial goals, assortment strategy, deal calendar, customer dynamics, and operational roadmap.
• Translate category inputs into actionable marketing recommendations rather than functioning solely as an intake or execution partner.
• Partner with category leaders to identify where marketing can meaningfully accelerate growth and flag areas where business, selection, pricing, or operational readiness may impact campaign effectiveness.
• Lead annual and quarterly planning discussions that align category stakeholders around the highest-impact marketing priorities.
• Provide category leadership and Directors with visibility into upcoming campaigns, investment recommendations, dependencies, risks, and expected outcomes.

Cross-Functional GTM Leadership
• Partner with Creative and Stores teams to ensure customer experiences and traffic-driving assets reflect a consistent category strategy and value proposition.
• Work with Product and Technology teams to identify customer experience requirements, launch dependencies, merchandising needs, automation opportunities, and readiness risks.
• Partner with Finance and category teams to recommend category marketing budget allocation across campaigns, programs, and customer moments.
• Provide the Traffic & Targeting Lead with category goals, priority audiences, assortment inputs, deal details, timing, and campaign requirements to inform channel and NASM planning.
• Partner with BI and channel teams to define measurement plans and interpret performance across campaigns and customer touchpoints.
• Drive timely decisions, escalate unresolved dependencies, and maintain alignment across teams throughout the GTM lifecycle.

Performance Management & Leadership Narratives
• Own category-level marketing performance reporting, including campaign results, customer insights, business impact, lessons learned, and recommended actions.
• Develop the marketing sections of category MBR and QBR narratives for senior leadership.
• Connect individual campaign results to broader category trends, strategic priorities, and investment decisions.
• Establish repeatable mechanisms for tracking category plans, launch health, marketing contribution, and progress against annual goals.
• Use performance insights to refine future campaign strategy, audience priorities, activation criteria, and budget allocation.

A day in the life
• Meet with category leadership to review business performance, assortment priorities, upcoming launches, and areas where marketing support could accelerate growth.
• Translate annual or seasonal business goals into an integrated GTM strategy and prioritized category marketing calendar.
• Lead a cross-functional campaign working session to align Product, Stores, Creative, Traffic & Targeting, and Analytics partners on launch readiness and success metrics.
• Review a proposed category activation and determine whether it has a clear customer insight, differentiated value proposition, sufficient selection, and measurable business opportunity.
• Provide the Traffic & Targeting Lead with category inputs for NASM and channel planning while maintaining accountability for the overall category strategy.
• Develop an MBR or QBR narrative that explains performance, identifies key drivers and headwinds, and recommends actions for the next planning period.
• Advise senior leaders on campaign prioritization, investment tradeoffs, launch risks, and the category’s forward-looking marketing roadmap.
About the team

About the team
F2 Integrated Marketing (F2M) owns the Go-to-Market process for time-bound, business-backed moments across Fashion, Sports & Outdoors, Premium, Licensed Sports, and Luxury. We translate business priorities into customer-facing marketing activations that drive traffic, conversion, and engagement across shopping events, holidays, cultural moments, sports and entertainment, launches, and mission-based customer needs.
The Category GTM team serves as the strategic marketing interface to each F2 business. We develop category-level marketing strategies, establish annual and seasonal priorities, lead targeted and foundational GTM programs, and ensure category goals are represented within larger F2 tentpole moments. We work in close partnership with Traffic & Targeting, Creative, Stores, Product, Analytics, Finance, and central marketing teams to turn business opportunities into cohesive and measurable customer activations.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience presenting metrics and progress to goal to senior leadership
- Experience communicating results to stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience leading go-to-market for consumer software or hardware product launches
- Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
- Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting
- Usage of generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency, with a willingness to learn effective prompting and evaluation practices
- Ability to recognize opportunities where generative AI could enhance products, workflows, or customer experiences

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Neptune is a fast, scalable, fully-managed graph database service that makes it easy to build and run applications that work with highly connected datasets. The core of Amazon Neptune is a purpose-built, high-performance graph database engine optimized for storing hundreds of billions of relationships and querying with milliseconds latency, allowing you to easily build queries that efficiently navigate highly connected datasets. title: Head, Linehaul Procurement, Amazon India Operations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Freight India is seeking an experienced Linehaul Procurement Head to own the end-to-end procurement strategy for our linehaul transportation network across India. This is a high-impact leadership role where-in leader will own trucking/rail supply cost for countries one of the largest express parcel network. The incumbent will serve as the single-threaded leader for carrier sourcing, rate negotiation, vendor management, and capacity planning — ensuring Amazon’s linehaul network is cost-efficient, reliable, and scalable.
This role requires a seasoned procurement leader who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, navigate complex internal and external stakeholder landscapes, and drive measurable business outcomes. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in transportation procurement, a strong commercial orientation, and a proven track record of leading large teams and managing large-scale vendor relationships in a fast-paced environment.


Key job responsibilities
• Procurement Strategy: Define and execute the end-to-end linehaul procurement strategy across all lanes, modes, and contract types. Develop strategies aligned with network design, cost targets, and capacity requirements.
• Carrier Sourcing & Rate Negotiations: Lead large-scale carrier sourcing events (RFQs, reverse auctions, spot negotiations) and negotiate multi-year and seasonal contracts. Drive competitive rate structures while ensuring service quality and reliability.
• Team Leadership & Development: Build, lead, and mentor team of procurement professionals. Set clear goals, drive a high-performance culture, and invest in the career development of team members. Raise the bar on talent through structured hiring.
• Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary procurement interface for internal stakeholders (Operations, Finance, Legal, Network Planning) and external stakeholders (carriers, fleet owners, OEMs, industry bodies). Build trust and alignment across a complex stakeholder matrix.
• Cost Optimization & Should-Cost Modeling: Develop and maintain should-cost models incorporating fuel indices, toll structures, driver costs, fleet utilization, and market dynamics. Identify and execute cost reduction initiatives beyond rate negotiation (e.g., payload optimization, backhaul utilization, fleet mix optimization).
• Capacity Planning & Assurance: Partner with Operations and Network Planning to forecast capacity requirements. Build a resilient carrier base that can absorb demand variability during peak events (e.g., Prime Day, Diwali) and seasonal surges.
• Contract Governance & Compliance: Own the contract lifecycle — from drafting and negotiation through execution and renewal. Ensure all contracts are compliant with Amazon policies, Indian transportation regulations, and GST/E-way bill requirements.
• Market Intelligence: Maintain deep awareness of the Indian trucking and freight market — rate trends, diesel price movements, regulatory changes, competitive benchmarks, and emerging disruptors. Translate market insights into procurement strategies.
• Technology & Automation: Champion the adoption of procurement technology, automation, and data-driven decision-making. Partner with Tech teams to build tools for rate benchmarking, carrier scoring, and contract management. Leverage AI/GenAI tools to improve procurement workflows and negotiation outcomes.
• Executive Reporting & Communication: Author strategic procurement narratives, business reviews, and leadership updates. Present recommendations to senior leadership (Director+) and drive consensus on sourcing strategies.


About the team
The Linehaul Procurement team sits within Amazon India and is responsible for sourcing, contracting, and managing one of the largest transportation spend categories in the India supply chain. The team partners closely with Operations, Network Planning, Finance, Legal, and external carrier partners to ensure that Amazon’s middle-mile linehaul network delivers the right capacity at the right cost, every day.
We move thousands of loads daily across India’s highway network, working with a diverse ecosystem of fleet owners, transport aggregators, and OEM-backed carriers. Our mission is to build a world-class procurement function that drives cost leadership, operational resilience, and carrier partnership excellence — all at a scale that directly impacts Amazon’s ability to deliver for customers.

- Bachelor's degree, or MBA in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
- 5+ years of procurement, supply chain, inventory management, contract management, lease administration or operations experience
- Experience with high-level negotiation and successful internal and external relationship management
- 4+ years of business or financial analysis, product costing, procurement, or a quantitative role experience
- Experience working with cross-functional teams across business development, marketing, operations, product development, legal, etc.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in transportation operations and industry knowledge
- Knowledge of analytics & statistical tools such as SAS, PowerBI, SQL & ETL DW concepts
