title: Space Threat Specialist , Leo Launch Security
locations: Kennedy Space Center, FL, United States
descriptionHtml:
This role is essential to deliver consistent, mission-aligned security postures at every launch site; eliminating operational variance, ensuring traceability, and maintaining compliance throughout the mission lifecycle.
The ideal candidate will bring expertise in infrastructure security assessments, aerospace operations security, and stakeholder engagement with launch providers. This is a field-facing, technically oriented role responsible for conducting standardized security evaluations of new or unfamiliar facilities, developing mission-specific security requirements, and working directly with launch providers to establish Amazon-controlled expectations rather than relying on provider-defined standards.
With Amazon's expanding launch operations currently spanning multiple launch providers with additional contracts and locations under evaluation; this role provides the scalability needed to ensure security grows in pace with the program's increasing footprint and launch cadence.
Must be able to pass and maintain a Federal Kennedy Space Center badge


Key job responsibilities
• Provide tailored analysis that combines deep space-domain knowledge — orbital environment, launch and range operations, ground segment, and the commercial and national-security space ecosystem — with open-source data to forecast how threats translate into business impact for Amazon’s space program.
• Identify, analyze, and mitigate security threats to the satellite constellation, launch sites, payload processing, and ground infrastructure, keeping the emphasis on measurable security outcomes and risk reduction.
• Set strategy where it is undefined: define the business problem, set objectives, analyze data, and influence resource allocation and trade-offs across Leo and partner organizations using threat-driven, business-impact justification.
• Translate specialized space-threat analysis into forward-looking security posture, mechanisms, and standards that partner teams adopt, and embed space-threat considerations into system design, site security assessments, and mission planning.
• Develop per-campaign and per-mission threat profiles assessing site-specific, regional, and geopolitical risk to launch operations, and integrate them into site security assessments, evaluation frameworks, and mission security plans in partnership with Launch Operations and Program Management.
• Track the evolving space-threat landscape — counter-space developments, threats to orbital and ground systems, commercial espionage, and supply-chain risk across the space supply base — and forecast how they translate into business and operational impact over time.
• Build repeatable mechanisms and processes that mitigate risk for partner organizations, decouple dependencies, eliminate duplicate effort, and increase the speed and quality of security delivery in the space domain.
• Advise senior leadership through clear written narratives and verbal briefings that drive business and technical decisions, communicating to internal, cross-org, and leadership teams.
• Conduct competitive and commercial analysis of the space sector to anticipate risks to Amazon’s position, including adversary targeting of peer space operators and the broader space supply base.
• Partner with export-control and industrial-security teams to ensure analytical activities and products align with ITAR/EAR and related requirements, and interpret their impact on space programs and cross-border technology flows.
• Hold the team and partners to a high standard for both solutions and practices; mentor and develop others in space-threat analysis and tradecraft.
• Develop and maintain relationships with industry peers, government agencies, space operators, and space-security communities to strengthen Amazon’s space-threat awareness and represent Amazon in external engagements.


A day in the life
No two days look the same, and that is the nature of the role. You might start the morning reviewing open-source developments across the space sector and assessing what a competitor’s launch anomaly, a new counter-space capability, or a shift in the geopolitical picture means for Amazon’s upcoming campaigns. By mid-morning you could be partnering with Launch Operations to shape the threat profile for an upcoming mission, then joining an engineering discussion where you help the team weigh a security trade-off for a upcoming launch. In the afternoon you might brief a Director on how an emerging risk could affect a launch window, build a mechanism that lets partner teams act on space-threat considerations without you in the room, and mentor a teammate through their first mission threat assessment. Throughout, your work stays anchored to a single question: what reduces real risk to the mission, and how do you move the organization to act on it before a threat becomes a problem.

About the team
Leo's Launch Security Team protects Amazon's intellectual property, hardware assets, and launch operations across production and production sites worldwide. The Launch Security pillar delivers governance, intelligence, risk management, and compliance assurance; including infrastructure security assessments, risk treatment planning, audit management, guard force oversight, access control validation, incident response readiness, and new-site security baselining. We work with internal engineering, operations, legal, and corporate security teams as well as external auditors, regulatory bodies, and vendors to ensure Leo's production facilities maintain a robust and continuously improving security posture at every stage, from site activation through operational maturity.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program management, project management or product management experience
- 7+ years of experience in threat analysis, security analysis, or risk assessment within a government, critical-infrastructure, or highly-regulated sector, with direct experience in space, aerospace, defense, or national security.
- Demonstrated deep domain expertise in the space-security threat landscape — counter-space capabilities, threats to orbital and ground systems, and adversary targeting of commercial space operators.
- Demonstrated ability to provide tailored analysis combining space-domain knowledge with open-source data to forecast business and operational impacts.
- Experience working across an organization to define strategy, influence resource allocation, and lead execution on complex, cross-functional security programs.
- Experience distilling complex analysis into clear written narratives and briefings for senior leadership and executive audiences.
- Ability to travel up to 20% to support launch campaigns, site evaluations, and partner engagements at domestic and international locations.
- Bachelor’s degree in security management, homeland security, risk assessment, or related field.

Preferred qualifications

- Possess an active TS/SCI clearance or have held a TS/SCI clearance within the last 2 years.
- Experience overseeing security protocols in aerospace environments with complex regulatory and operational risk landscapes.
- Experience in industrial security design implementation within high-security technology or manufacturing environments.
- Familiarity with security industry standards (CPTED, ASIS standards, tiered classification frameworks).
- Experience working with contract security providers (guard force, monitoring services, system integrators).
- Knowledge of access control, intrusion detection, video surveillance, and alarm monitoring systems.
- Professional certifications such as CPP, PSP, PCI, or equivalent security industry credentials.
- Experience with export control compliance (ITAR/EAR) in a manufacturing or lab environment.
- Experience managing capital and operational security budgets across multiple facilities.
- Experience building launch playbooks or repeatable processes for new site security standup.
- Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, drive programs to completion, and influence without authority

title: Data Center Technician, DCC Communities
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

Data Center Technicians should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to success. In addition to hardware and network repair, candidates will install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix problems within the data center space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, and responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, escalating to senior technicians and management as needed/required
- Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
- Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
- Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
- Helping to train and onboard new team members
Physical requirements:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
- Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
- Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
- Work in a noisy environment
- Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).
This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Technician professional, you have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while you:
- Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
- Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
- Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting

You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. Traveling within and outside of regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of computer/server hardware troubleshooting or related IT experience
- High school or equivalent diploma
- Ability to work on a flexible schedule including days, nights, and/or weekends.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in data center
- Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
- An Associate’s degree, technical certification, or equivalent professional or military experience in a relevant field (e.g., computer science, networking engineering, etc.)
- Understanding of network design, protocols and layer 1/2 troubleshooting

title: Applied Scientist II, Selling Partner Selection Success
descriptionHtml:
Join us in the evolution of Amazon’s Seller business! The Selling Partner Selection Success organization is the growth and development engine for our Store. Partnering with business, product, and engineering, we catalyze SP selection growth with comprehensive and accurate data, unique insights, and actionable recommendations and collaborate with WW SP facing teams to drive adoption and create feedback loops. We strongly believe that any motivated SP should be able to grow their businesses and reach their full potential supported by Amazon tools and resources.

We are looking for a Applied Scientist II to work on our growth agent vision on seller recommendation to improve our SP growth strategy and drive new seller success. As a successful Applied Scientist on our talented team of applied scientists and economists, you will leverage the latest scientific methods, including statistics, machine learning, deep learning and GenAI technology to solve complex problems, and collaborate with engineering, research, and business teams to deliver optimized experience (AI infused products, agentic experiences) on behalf of our sellers. You need to have deep understanding on the business domain and have the ability to connect business with science. You are also strong in AI/ML/GenAI technology and scientific foundation with the ability to collaborate with engineering to put models in production to answer specific business questions. You are an expert at synthesizing and communicating insights and recommendations to audiences of varying levels of technical sophistication. You will continue to contribute to the research community, by working with scientists across Amazon, as well as collaborating with academic researchers and publishing papers (www.aboutamazon.com/research).

Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist II in the team, you will:
- Identify opportunities to improve SP growth and translate those opportunities into science problems via principled GenAI solutions .
- Design and execute roadmaps for complex science projects to help SP have a delightful selling experience while creating long term value for our shoppers.
- Work with our engineering partners and draw upon your experience to meet latency and other system constraints.
- Be responsible for communicating our science innovations to the broader internal & external scientific community.

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Unix/Linux
- Experience in professional software development
- Demonstrated experience leveraging generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency and productivity, with the ability to craft effective prompts and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs in a professional setting
- Experience identifying opportunities to integrate AI solutions into products and services to drive business value

title: Data Engineer II, GMAC FP&A
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Media and Entertainment (GME) organization encompasses Prime Video, Amazon Music, Twitch, Audible, and Amazon Games businesses. The GME Finance team is establishing a Fintech team to build and operate systems that provide both financial reporting and operational analytic capabilities to GME Finance teams. We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to drive the team’s data strategy and vision. The data engineer will be responsible for design and build of the data infrastructure for automated and scalable platforms to support the reporting and forecasting requirements of GME finance teams. The data engineer will also lead and execute projects that build scalable data and visualization frameworks from multiple operational and financial datasets. The GME Finance team currently has a multi-year roadmap that aim to deliver automated reporting solutions, accelerate predictive forecasting, and interactive analytic tools for our finance analysts.

This role requires an individual with excellent data modeling, data architecture design, analytic visualization, ML modeling, and software development skills. A successful candidate will have the flexibility to execute on business intelligence projects while considering optimal and efficient data architecture. The candidate must have the ability to quickly build internal contacts and work across multiple finance, technology, product, and business teams to drive the overall strategy. This person will have the ability to Think Big about opportunities and challenges facing the business and the ability to influence the data and BI strategy through effective verbal and written communication, logical reasoning, and the presentation of alternatives.


Key job responsibilities
• Architect and develop end to end scalable data applications and data pipelines
• Design and build data reporting solutions across different visualization platforms (e.g. Quicksight)
• Establish scalable, efficient, automated processes for reporting, dashboards, data analyses and ML model development
• Ability to query, program, and perform analysis on large datasets using SQL languages and Python
• Build data infrastructure and manage other AWS resources including EC2, RDS, Redshift, EMR, etc.
• Collaborate with other teams to extract, transform, and load data from a wide variety of data sources using SQL and AWS big data technologies
• Participate in data strategy and road map exercises, data warehouse design and implementation


Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of data engineering experience
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or NodeJS

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
- Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)

title: Sr. Customer Solutions Manager, EC2 Capacity
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform, and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) is its largest and most consequential service. As customers accelerate workloads spanning generative AI training and inference, large-scale analytics, and mission-critical production systems, AWS’s ability to plan, commit, and deliver compute capacity at scale is a defining competitive advantage.

We are seeking a Senior Customer Solutions Manager (CSM) to join the EC2 Capacity Customer Experience organization. In this highly visible role, you will help guide AWS’s customers through the capacity dimension of their cloud journey, planning and delivering the compute capacity solutions that power customers across our global base. You will own the end-to-end capacity and scaling plans for a portfolio of internal and external customers consuming compute (CPU and GPU) and foundational services, translating their growth trajectories into executable commitments and then driving action across AWS teams to deliver against those commitments with clarity on who owns what by when.

You will be a critical partner to your customers, leveraging your technical background and your understanding of large-scale compute and capacity dynamics to shepherd them through planning, delivery, and governance of their capacity needs. You will interface with customer and AWS leadership, driving collaboration between the core account groups (Sales, Support, Solutions Architecture, and Professional Services), product and engineering teams, supply chain, and finance. You will translate strategic initiatives in the account and capacity plan into executable actions, working backwards from customer milestones, and you will manage the cadence by leading the reporting and tracking functions along the way.

You are encouraged to think big, invent, and take ownership of customer capacity challenges. Successful candidates have a strong technical background, are familiar with cloud infrastructure and increasingly with AI/GenAI workloads, are aware of the details that matter, have excellent problem-solving abilities, and are exemplary communicators at both the executive and project-team level. You will be a peer leader able to gain stakeholder buy-in, negotiate trade-offs, and lead virtual teams. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by planning and delivering capacity, driving innovation, and contributing to the day-to-day management of customers’ successful consumption of AWS.


Key job responsibilities
You will establish a deep understanding of each customer’s business vision, growth plans, and consumption patterns, and influence them to adopt the right capacity solution at the right time. The Capacity CSM-T is responsible for four focus areas:
• Accelerating adoption through capacity delivery and execution. Own and drive the capacity and scaling plans that translate customer growth forecasts into concrete, time-bound infrastructure commitments, and drive the “last mile” between an approved plan and physical capacity in the right place at the right time.
• Identifying and aligning on strategic capacity opportunities. Work with the account team to work backwards from the customer and pursue opportunities including large-scale workload migrations and modernizations, GenAI/ML scaling, platform generation migrations, regionalization, and cost-optimizing demand shaping.
• Customer enablement. Serve as the customer’s capacity coach and the voice of the customer within AWS, evangelizing their capacity needs to AWS leadership, product, engineering, and supply chain teams.
• Governance. Implement governance structures, review cadences, and escalation paths that govern both the partnership with the customer and the health of their capacity commitments.
Across these focus areas you will also:
• Drive action and accountability across partner organizations (EC2, Supply Chain, Networking, Storage, Finance, Sales) to deliver against committed capacity plans, identifying and escalating blockers with urgency.
• Organize complex demand signals into supportability scenarios that enable leaders to make informed capital allocation decisions, partnering with Finance and Supply Chain to quantify trade-offs (cost of over-provisioning versus risk of under-delivery).
• Leverage large data sets to tell the story on the customer experience, define KPIs that measure delivery fidelity and forecast accuracy, and own the metrics and the narrative.
• Build repeatable mechanisms and automation that reduce manual steps and scale the capacity engagement model across a growing queue of customers.
• Maintain working fluency across EC2 instance families (CPU: Graviton, Intel, AMD; GPU: NVIDIA, Trainium, Inferentia) and the networking and storage dependencies that influence capacity requirements.


About the team
You start your morning reviewing commitment and delivery dashboards for your portfolio of customers, flagging a delivery risk in an upcoming GPU buildout. Mid-morning you lead a capacity review with one of your largest customers, walking through next quarter’s scaling plan and pressure-testing their forecast assumptions. You then join EC2 Supply Chain and Finance partners to present supportability scenarios for a customer requesting a significant expansion, driving alignment on which to fund. After lunch you work tickets and demand signals through internal tooling, update your customer tables, and write the narrative for a weekly review that synthesizes demand across your customers into a clear state of the portfolio. You end the day with an engineering partner on a tooling gap you identified, a forecasting input that would remove a manual step, and write the one-pager to get it prioritized.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience
- 2+ years of customer-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies experience
- Bachelor's degree in science, technology, engineering, math, business or equivalent
- Experience leading technical and non-technical transformation project teams with a proven ability to work across broad functional teams

Preferred qualifications

- PMP certification, or SCRUM/Agile, SAFe certification
- Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar

title: Program Manager - Devices Beta Team, Amazon Devices Beta
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Devices Beta (ADB) Team is your hall pass to play at work!! We are responsible for the “real world validation” for Kindle eReaders, Fire Tablets, FireTV products, and Emerging products…think, Amazon Smart Oven and Amazon Basics Microwave. How do we do this? By playing with these products every day! We work with product and engineering teams to prepare new product launches, system software and app updates, and marketplace expansions. Our goal is to gather feedback and expose issues and bugs prior to the product launching, so we delight our customers with products beyond their expectations.

Key job responsibilities
The ADB Team needs an experienced Program Manager to help us build and execute programs to validate the customer experience during the product development cycle. You will work with end users and a wide variety of internal teams to develop the strategy and execute the program to confirm from a customer perspective we are ready to launch. You will be a “hands on” contributor to support and troubleshoot issues, resolve problems, and keep the feedback flowing. Along the way, you’ll identify opportunities for improvements and put processes and tools in place to help us scale. You will track, communicate status, and independently drive issues to resolution. Cross-team coordination, program management, and an ability to learn and understand new technologies are essential.

A day in the life
Our programs are global and composed of Amazon employees across the company. We put pre-released devices and/or software in the hands of beta testers who represent our target customer profile ("people all about smart home automation", "people who love to read", or "people who are native speakers of French"). Working with our product team counterparts, we ask testers for “no holds barred” feedback to tell us what works and what needs to be fixed. Our bar is always being raised and we strive to achieve an Amazon 4-Star or better product every time!

About the team
The Amazon Devices Beta Team is responsible pre-launch customer feedback for our products. The team is composed of program managers who love technology and devices. Together with product owners, we plan and execute beta programs focused on gathering early customer feedback to help Amazon ship devices and software that delight customers. Our objective is to leverage the voice of the customer to validate and improve the experience and make an informed decision regarding launch readiness.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Senior Agency Development Manager, UK Agency Sales
descriptionHtml:

Amazon Ads
London

Amazon Ads is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brand advertisers and agencies. Our full funnel ad solutions—including display, video, audio and custom ads—leverage Amazon’s innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage intended audiences throughout their daily journeys. With a range of flexible pricing and buying models, including self-service, managed service, and programmatic ad buying, these solutions help businesses build brand awareness, increase product sales, and more. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do, including advertising. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing team working to build a unique, world-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.

Agency Development Managers (ADM) are single threaded owners responsible for relationships with our largest agency customers. They own the Amazon/Agency HoldCo relationship at the most senior level. ADMs are tasked with accelerating Amazon Ads revenue, increasing Amazon Ads tool adoption and increasing penetration of the total advertiser universe in each agency. Candidates must be excellent communicators, experienced at operating at all levels, strategic thinkers, and able to earn the trust of partners across Amazon and our agency clients. Candidates must make data-driven decisions, set and achieve ambitious goals, and have the ability to “think big.” In addition, candidates should be comfortable with complex data sets and have the ability to invent and simplify for customers.

- Create and execute cross-team project plans.
- Build and manage a detailed engagement strategy.
- Report on program and project progress and status consistently and in a transparent way.
- Work across multiple resources and orchestrate multiple activities at once to get things done

A day in the life
Overseeing key customer meetings, running group presentations, building commercial agreements and joint business plans, escalating blockers at the account level to agency leadership

About the team
Our team build long-lasting partnerships with our agency customers through the development of commercial and servicing plans covering our entire offering. We aim to increase the number of brands using Amazon, and the diversity of products and tools they use to drive revenue growth and advocacy with our agency customers.

title: Commissioning Engineer, AWS Commissioning, AMER-West
descriptionHtml:
Are you experienced in critical infrastructure commissioning and looking for a fast-paced, high-growth environment? As a Data Center Infrastructure Engineer on the Amazon Commissioning team, you will join a creative, efficient group tackling challenging problems as we build and operate Amazon-owned data centers at an accelerating pace. Our fleet is expanding rapidly, and we need skilled engineers who can verify that every power, cooling, and control system in a new facility works correctly before it serves production traffic. You will also get hands-on experience with new data center technologies as the team scales and our designs evolve.

You will support vendors, contractors, and internal teams involved in the construction and commissioning of data center systems including medium and low voltage power distribution, generators, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), heating ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) equipment, chilled water systems, building management systems (BMS), electrical power monitoring systems (EPMS), and hydronic systems. You will review engineering designs, check construction quality against customer requirements, and help deliver infrastructure that directly supports the availability and performance of AWS services used by millions of active customers worldwide.

Physical Requirements:
- Walk job sites in uneven terrain
- Work at heights and from ladders
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl
- Lift and move up to 49 pounds; participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
- Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
- Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration, with potential for night and weekend shifts
- Perform physical tasks throughout the day without becoming overly tired
- Manipulate small wires and objects easily
- Work in noisy environments
- Work in environments that are colder or hotter than a normal office environment

Additional Requirements:
- Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally for up to 80% of the year
- Required to provide personal transportation for meetings and job visits away from the office; mileage is reimbursed


Key job responsibilities
- Review design documents and component submittal packages, then lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT) to confirm that equipment meets engineering specifications before it reaches the site.
- Manage third-party commissioning vendors through onsite pre-functional, functional, and integrated systems testing, auditing activities for compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements.
- Provide multi-discipline input into project scheduling, test script development, and commissioning planning while coordinating across engineering, capacity delivery, and operations teams to resolve technical issues quickly.
- Compile status reports on all active projects and share lessons learned with peers to help improve commissioning processes and program quality over time.
- Troubleshoot equipment and system-level issues during commissioning, identify root causes, and document corrective actions to make sure problems are fixed and do not come back.

A day in the life
You will start your morning reviewing the commissioning schedule and aligning priorities with construction and operations partners. Throughout the day you will move between the site and your desk, witnessing tests on electrical switchgear or mechanical systems, checking vendor work against approved test scripts, and flagging issues that need resolution before turnover milestones. When a risk surfaces, you will coordinate with the right stakeholders to keep the project on track. After site activities wrap up, you will update project trackers and share findings so teammates on parallel builds can benefit from what you learned.

About the team
The Amazon Commissioning team independently reviews and tests data center equipment designs, operational functionality, and construction practices. We make sure every facility we deliver meets strict quality and reliability standards while keeping full transparency with our partners. As our data center fleet grows at a rapid pace, the team is scaling to match and picking up new technologies along the way. This makes it a great time to join, build your technical expertise, and have a direct impact on how quickly and safely we bring new capacity online.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating, which is why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our products and services to power their businesses.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering, installation, or startup/commissioning of electrical and mechanical systems experience
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- NETA or ASHRAE certification or commissioning specific education courses
- Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Experience with the design, construction, operation, or maintenance of mission critical facilities, especially data centers

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region
- Knowledge of commercial or industrial power systems or mechanical systems
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience using a variety of web-based and other software tools for calculation and data processing

Do you want to revolutionize the way people manage and secure vast volumes of data in the cloud? Do you want to have direct and immediate impact on a large number of AWS users? Amazon Opensearch makes it easy to deploy, operate, and scale Opensearch (for log analytics, application monitoring, full-text search, and more! Amazon Opensearch is a fully managed service that delivers Opensearch’s easy-to-use APIs and real-time capabilities along with offering predictable performance and seamless scalability for production workloads.

The OpenSearch team is looking for innovative engineers with a passion for helping develop the next generation of security features to help users (both, opensource community users and AWS customers) secure and manage access to their data, all at cloud scale.

descriptionHtml:
Join the AWS Solutions Architecture team as a Sr Solutions Architect for Software and Technology customers. Our customers are born in the cloud and are leading the industry in AI-Native transformation. You will define and prove technical direction by combining architectural reasoning and strategic advisory with hands-on validation in customer environments. You will build working prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and AI-driven solutions that accelerate customer decisions and remove the gap between architectural recommendation and validated proof.  You operate where the path forward is undefined and must be defined by you. Your customers have business objectives but may not have defined technology strategy or solution design. You create and adapt approaches for situations where established patterns are insufficient, applying contextual judgment about your customers' operational constraints, regulatory environment, and competitive dynamics.  You will be the primary technical partner for your customers. You lead with Agentic AI and AI-assisted development to solve customer problems, and you steer customers away from where hype outpaces practical value for their operational context. You maintain technical currency so customers receive guidance based on current capability, not outdated expertise. You build deep relationships with customers’ senior technical leaders to enable them to be cloud advocates.  You are technically self-sufficient, yet you know when to seek help: you are capable of using AI tools and delivering directly in customer sandbox environments. You drive the architectural decisions that downstream teams (customer engineering, ProServe, partners) build against, and you own the consequences with the customer when those decisions need revisiting.    

Key job responsibilities  

Technical Proof & Validation  
Build working prototypes in customer non-production sandbox environments using AI-augmented development tools (Kiro, Claude Code, Bedrock) to validate architectural recommendations and accelerate customer adoption  
• Implement directly to unblock customer decisions: build PoCs for agentic AI and other use cases proving architectural approaches that conversations alone cannot validate  
• Deploy infrastructure using IaC (CDK, Terraform) in customer sandboxes, demonstrating scalability and security patterns  
• Apply GenAI and agentic systems (multi-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, foundation model integration) where they solve customer problems.   

Architectural Reasoning & Decision Ownership
 • Frame and resolve technical trade-offs involving multiple competing concerns (security vs. cost vs. operational burden vs. time-to-market vs. industry compliance), bringing a clear recommendation with alternatives articulated  
• Make cross-cutting architectural decisions that ensure coherence across systems, teams, and workstreams; flag decisions that are difficult to reverse before the customer commits  
• Diagnose non-obvious architectural issues including resilience gaps, failover weaknesses, scaling bottlenecks, and security vulnerabilities.
• Own the architectural decisions that downstream teams build against and own the consequences with the customer when those decisions need revisiting  
• Stay engaged through implementation to ensure the architecture holds against the reality of the customer's environment; know when accumulated context warrants a revised approach   

Strategic Advisory & Customer Influence  • Own the end-to-end technical strategy for customers, maintaining the current view of their technical landscape, industry context, and competitive dynamics  
• Partner with the sales team, formulate and execute a sales strategy to exceed revenue objectives through the adoption of AWS  
• Influence senior leaders' technology direction by connecting short-term AI and cloud decisions to long-term business outcomes; earn trust through guidance that consistently delivers the outcomes they expected  
• Challenge customer direction when evidence indicates a better path; customers avoid costly rework because you identify risk early and bring considered alternatives  
• Shape AI and cloud strategy for major operators — translating complex capabilities into business-outcome narratives.  

Revenue & Opportunity Acceleration  
• Accelerate customer adoption by removing ambiguity through validated proof points, measurably reducing the time from architectural recommendation to customer commitment  
• Identify new opportunities discovered during customer engagements  
• Increase service adoption through tangible multi-service integration demos  • Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS  
• Identify implementation pathways that benefit from ProServe expertise, creating natural expansion opportunities through demonstrated value   Customer

Relationship & Communication Skills  
• Experience presenting to both large and small audiences (Executives, IT Management, and developers)  
• Experience communicating across internal and external organizations  
• Ability to moderate tone and technical depth based on audience  
• Ability to pick up on non-verbal communication and "un-said" drivers   

Thought Leadership & Product Influence  • Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as blogs and whitepapers.  
• Translate customer feedback into clear, actionable requirements that service teams act on; synthesize evidence across multiple engagements rather than relaying feedback from one. Accelerate development and reduce ambiguity by creating code for a proposed feature to illustrate your requirement that can be reviewed and evaluated for inclusion into product codebase.

title: Amazon Key – B2B Growth marketer, Amazon Key
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Key is building an infrastructure-agnostic access layer for the housing sector that overlays intelligent keyless access onto existing electrical systems for communal entrance without replacing what is already installed. For contractors and staff who work across multiple buildings and portfolios, it replaces fragmented keys, codes and sign-in processes with a single seamless UX on their phone. For property teams, it creates a centralized process, with tamper-proof audit trails that becomes the one system of record for every non-resident entry, every day. For delivery drivers, it grants secure, time-bound access to communal entrances so parcels arrive safely inside the building instead of being left exposed or bounced back as failed deliveries; no keys, fobs or resident buzz-in required. We have a proven product and now we need an engine: a repeatable, instrumented, signal-driven machine that finds the right accounts, reaches the right decision-makers with the right message at the right moment, and hands Sales a warm, qualified, prioritized queue every single day.
We are looking for a B2B Growth marketer to design, build, and own that engine. This is a founding, high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, and Revenue Operations. You will treat go-to-market like software: define the signals that indicate a housing provider is ready to buy, build the enrichment and outbound workflows that act on those signals, wire them into the CRM, measure conversion at every stage.
You will be the technical architect of lead generation, outbound, and signal detection for Amazon Key across the.
This role is highly cross-functional.


Key job responsibilities
• Design the signal layer. Define and codify the buying signals that indicate an housing provider is in-market. Build the pipelines that detect them continuously.
• Build the lead-gen engine end-to-end. Own sourcing → enrichment → scoring → routing → sequencing → attribution as a versioned, monitored system. Turn target-account lists into instrumented outbound programs.
• Automate enrichment and data quality: Build data extraction and scraping flows from scratch. Stand up custom web-scraping and data-extraction pipelines where no clean source exists, feeding them into enrichment so target lists are built, not bought.
• Generate account-specific outreach at scale. Build AI-assisted systems that produce personalized, on-message outreach for named accounts and multi-channel cadences with strong deliverability hygiene.
• Instrument and report conversion. Define the funnel metrics (reply rate, meeting rate, pilot rate, stage conversion, time-to-money) and build the dashboards that feed conversion heartbeat.
• Integrate the GTM stack.
• Run experiments like an engineer. Ship, measure, iterate, and deprecate.
• Read the commercial picture, not just the tech. You understand how a housing deal actually gets won, where demand comes from, how a prospect moves from first touch to signature, and which numbers predict revenue. That lets you decide what to build and what to drop based on impact on the funnel, so the engine is judged by deals closed, not workflows shipped.
• Run your own show end to end. Give you a problem and a goal, not a spec, and you'll scope it, build a first version, put it in front of users, and keep refining until it holds up in production. You chase down what's broken yourself, close your own knowledge gaps, and carry a problem all the way to a working result rather than handing it off half-solved.


A day in the life
The applicable collective agreement for this role is CBA for employees of Telecommunication Sector. The position is classified at level 7 or above, depending on the candidate's skills, competences and experience.

About the team
The Amazon Key team sits within the Amazon Devices team alongside Ring and other Home Security teams. Key is a uniquely cross-functional team within Amazon, and often serves as the connective tissue between Smart Home/Devices, Logistics, Operations, and Retail/Shopping. We are the bridge between device management and physical services, and our team indexes highly on ownership and collaboration. We have lots of stakeholders, and we have relentlessly high standards for our high-visibility programs.

- Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
- Experience using Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data
- Experience defining, refining and implementing sales processes, procedures and policies or equivalent

In this role, you'll tackle problems where the technology strategy isn't yet defined, working backwards from customer needs to architect systems that are scalable, performant, and secure. title: Senior Recruiter, Scholars, Global Specialty Recruiting
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Scholar team sits within the Global Specialty Recruiting (GSR) team. GSR is a highly specialized group focused on hiring exceptional talent for complex, hard-to-fill scientific, design, academic, & executive tech and non-tech roles across Amazon.

What makes our Global Specialty Recruiting team unique is our deep domain expertise and breadth of experience. Our recruiters are embedded within the academic, scientific and technical communities, allowing us to leverage academic and industry connections, innovative sourcing tactics, and a nuanced understanding of specialized skill sets.

As a full life cycle recruiter on the GSR Scholar team, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented peers, influence at the most senior levels, and make a meaningful impact on the growth and success of Amazon Science. You'll be a vital strategic partner to our science leaders, helping to shape our approach and elevate the candidate experience for some of the most sought-after academicians in the world.

If you're passionate about the sciences, driven to find exceptional talent, and eager to work alongside a best-in-class recruiting organization, this is an unparalleled opportunity to grow your career and opportunity for impact.

Critical success factors for this role include:
• Research acumen and creativity - you learn new science domains quickly and understand how to craft effective search strategies within those domains
• Superb communication skills - you're a compelling communicator able to effectively engage the attention of busy, senior executives
• Able to convey complex arguments (without the luxury of complete data) and engage with senior level scientists & executives with conviction and confidence
• Combine tenacity with tact and high judgement; know when to apply the right pressure and when to move on
• Self-assured, not easily thrown, able to think on your feet; you will be leading complex & highly confidential searches with some of our most seasoned leaders
• Inquisitive; a deep sense of learn & be curious


Key job responsibilities
Some of the core components of this role include:

• Strategically engaging best in class academic passive talent to solve some of Amazon’s toughest technical challenges.
• Developing innovative ways to raise the bar on how Amazon connects with the leading Academics in their fields and drives impact while here at Amazon.
• Continually contributing to the knowledge base of both our team and the broader recruiting community by sharing intelligence related to relevant domains and profiles
• Building out academic talent networks and tapping knowledgeable academic sources (both internal and external) to develop strong relationships within the community.
• Owning business and stakeholder relationships (you're the go-to and trusted advisor), providing strategic guidance and coaching in close partnership with executive hiring managers & their teams.
• Conducting informational/exploratory calls, phone screens, & interviews. You'll actively participate in hiring decisions throughout the candidate life cycle.


About the team
The Amazon Scholar Program enables university professors to work on large-scale and high-impact technical challenges at Amazon by joining Amazon as part-time employees or for limited-term engagements without leaving their academic institutions. We believe that Amazon is a unique place to measure the impact of new scientific ideas, given our scale and our ownership of both an information infrastructure and a physical infrastructure. The program gives academics an opportunity to test and apply research methods in practice and innovate in ways that benefit customers and improves Amazon’s ability to hire, develop, and retain world-class talent.

- Bachelor's degree or above
- Experience building and driving talent sourcing initiatives and pipelines
- Experience managing and prioritizing multiple searches, projects and client relationships
- Experience recruiting passive candidates who are the most senior experts in their field
- 5+ years of progressive corporate, start up or executive search firm recruiting work with a focus on passive science/academic candidate generation in a high tech markets

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with recruiting and people-related tools, CRM systems, and complex spreadsheets

title: Installation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Transform network infrastructure by joining our dynamic team! You'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive network stability and scalability, using your technical expertise to create automated systems that power global technological advancement.

Infra Delivery Install Technicians will collaborate with cross-functional teams, troubleshoot complex technical scenarios, and implement strategic solutions that keep our network running seamlessly. Expect to engage in hands-on technical work that requires creativity, precision, and a passion for technological innovation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
- Moving and implementing large enterprise equipment
- Installing Fiber and Copper cabling and patching cabling between equipment
- Ensuring proper safety and security standards are maintained during cabling and rack installation,
- Following well established hardware installation procedures and break-fix activities
- Safely using material handling tools and equipment
- Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided

Physical Requirements:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
- Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
- Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Computer Hardware Repair, Infrastructure Cabling, Network Deployment, or Data Center Operations experience, or experience in similar technical or vocational roles
- High School diploma or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- industry standard certification (CompTIA, CCENT, or Network+)
- Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
- Knowledge of network cabling, optic types, and test equipment

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The starting pay for this position is listed below. Final starting pay will be based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Starting Day 1 of employment, Amazon offers EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, 401(k) matching. Learn more about our benefits at https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits.

title: Program Manager, WWOS Last Mile Solutions - OTR Emerging
descriptionHtml:
The Program Manager leads the strategic design and execution of security programs within E2ESN "End-to-End Security Network ". This role owns a program area end-to-end, identifies problems and opportunities independently, and drives cross-functional alignment to deliver results at scale. This position reports to a Sr. Manager.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and scale loss prevention solutions across expanding last mile delivery methods, transportation modalities, and node types
- Develop and standardize OTR metrics for last mile operations globally, from dispatch to drop-off and return-to-station
- Work to standardize Security and Loss Prevention last mile metrics and benchmark performance
- Identify and tackle intrinsically hard problems - those that are ambiguous, structurally complex, carry business or reputational risk, or have potential for large-scale global impact
- Own program strategy and end-to-end delivery, defining the roadmap, success metrics, and mechanisms for assigned program area
- Drive alignment, collaboration, and accountability across multiple distinct organizations with competing priorities, translating shared objectives into coordinated execution
- Design and maintain structured communication processes that ensure stakeholders receive timely, actionable project intelligence
- Apply rigorous quantitative and qualitative analysis to prioritize investments, influence leadership decisions, and accelerate delivery
- Develop short-term actions and long-term (1-3 year) roadmaps; index on long-term value over short-term results while setting new standards
- Accompany and guide stakeholders through change via structured change management processes to ensure adoption; build sustainable mechanisms for long-term success
- Leverage analysis and high judgment; use quantitative and qualitative data to prioritize and influence, show creativity, experimentation and innovation, and drive projects with urgency in this fast-paced environment
- Conduct current state analysis to identify loss opportunities, key pain points, and inefficiencies; convert opportunities into scalable, automated solutions that decrease supply chain losses
- Identify, assess, and mitigate risks; develop contingency plans to ensure on-time execution while maintaining program documentation that enables seamless handoffs

About the team
Inclusive team culture
 
At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.  
 
Work Life Balance
 
We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.  
 
Mentorship & Career Growth
 
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of program or project management experience
- 2+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 2+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- 2+ years of developing program strategies and plans, diving execution, and influencing senior stakeholders experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Software Engineer II - AI/ML, Neuron Inference, Neuron Inference
descriptionHtml:
The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds the AWS Neuron SDK, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on AWS Trainium machine learning accelerators.

The Neuron Inference organization is at the forefront of optimizing inference performance for a wide range of ML models and model architectures on AWS's custom ML accelerators. We are working across the stack from PyTorch to the hardware-software boundary, our engineers build systematic infrastructure, develop high-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every compute unit is fine-tuned for optimal performance for our customers' demanding workloads. We combine deep hardware knowledge with ML expertise to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI acceleration.

As part of the broader Neuron organization, our team works across multiple technology layers — from frameworks and kernels through to compiler, runtime, and collectives. We not only optimize performance on open weight models but also contribute to future architecture designs and work closely with customers to enable optimal performance on their models. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures, where you'll help shape the future of AI acceleration technology.

As a Software Engineer II - AI/ML, you will design and implement business-critical features and own the performance of models on AWS Trainium end to end. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. It is a very unique learning culture. The team works closely with customers on their model enablement, providing direct support and optimization expertise to ensure their machine learning workloads achieve optimal performance on AWS ML accelerators. The team also collaborates with open source ecosystems to provide seamless integration and bring peak performance at scale for customers and developers.

This role is responsible for development, enablement, and performance tuning of a wide variety of LLM model families, including massive-scale large language models like the GLM, GPT-OSS, Kimi, and beyond. The Model Enablement team works side by side with compiler engineers and runtime engineers to create, build, and tune distributed inference solutions with AWS Trainium.

You can learn more about Neuron:

* https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/compiler/index.html
* https://aws.amazon.com/machine-learning/neuron/
* https://github.com/aws/aws-neuron-sdk
* https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-neuron
* https://www.amazon.science/how-silicon-innovation-became-the-secret-sauce-behind-awss-success

Are you passionate about building software that operates at massive scale and directly impacts millions of customers? As a Software Development Engineer II at Amazon, you will design, build, and maintain systems that solve complex problems while delivering meaningful results. You will contribute across the full software development lifecycle — from working backwards from customer needs to designing, implementing, testing, deploying, and operating production software. This role offers the opportunity to tackle challenging technical problems, collaborate with talented engineers, and grow your skills while making a real impact. If you are a curious, self-motivated engineer who thrives on turning ambiguity into clarity and shipping high-quality code, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
This role contributes to building distributed inference support for PyTorch in the Neuron SDK, and tunes models to ensure the highest performance and maximize efficiency running on AWS Trainium. Strong software development in Python, system-level programming, and ML knowledge are all critical to this role. Our engineers collaborate across compiler, runtime, framework, and hardware teams to optimize machine learning workloads for our global customer base. Working at the intersection of software, hardware, and machine learning systems, you'll bring expertise in low-level optimization, system architecture, and ML model acceleration. In this role, you will:

* Design, develop, and optimize machine learning models and frameworks for deployment on custom ML hardware accelerators.
* Participate in all stages of the ML system development lifecycle, including distributed-computing-based architecture design, implementation, performance profiling, hardware-specific optimizations, testing, and production deployment.
* Build infrastructure to systematically analyze and onboard multiple models with diverse architectures.
* Understand and produce NKI (Neuron Kernel Interface) kernels, and design and implement high-performance kernels and features for ML operations, leveraging the Neuron architecture and programming models.
* Analyze and optimize system-level performance across multiple generations of Neuron hardware, using knowledge of the underlying Trainium hardware architecture to guide optimization decisions.
* Conduct detailed performance analysis using profiling tools to identify and resolve bottlenecks.
* Implement optimizations such as fusion, sharding, tiling, and scheduling.
* Conduct comprehensive testing, including unit and end-to-end model testing with continuous deployment and releases through pipelines.
* Work directly with customers to enable and optimize their ML models on AWS accelerators.
* Collaborate across teams to develop innovative optimization techniques, and share proposals, findings, and learnings with internal developers and external customers via high-quality designs and documentation.


A day in the life
You will collaborate with a cross-functional team of applied scientists, systems engineers, and product managers to deliver state-of-the-art inference capabilities for Generative AI applications. Your work will involve debugging performance issues, optimizing memory usage, and contributing to the future of Neuron's inference stack across Amazon and the Open Source Community. As you design and code solutions to help our team drive efficiencies in software architecture, you'll create metrics, implement automation and other improvements, and resolve the root cause of software defects.

You will also build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base and participate in design discussions and code reviews, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders. You will work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input. You will work in a startup-like development environment, where you're always working on the most important initiative.You will start your day reviewing operational metrics and addressing any alerts from the systems you own. From there, you might dive into designing a new feature, writing and reviewing code, or pairing with a teammate to debug a tricky issue. You will participate in design discussions, contribute to sprint planning, and document your systems so that others can learn from and extend your work. Expect regular collaboration with product and engineering partners as you shape solutions that serve customers at scale.

About the team
The Model Enablement team fosters a builder's culture where experimentation is encouraged and impact is measurable. We emphasize collaboration, technical ownership, and continuous learning. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop their engineering expertise so they feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future. Join us to solve some of the most interesting and impactful infrastructure challenges in AI/ML today.Our team builds and operates software that powers key experiences for Amazon customers. We value technical excellence, collaboration, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Every engineer on the team has a voice in shaping our technical direction and the opportunity to mentor others. We are focused on building reliable, scalable systems while creating an inclusive environment where engineers at all levels can learn, grow, and do their best work. If you want to solve meaningful problems alongside a supportive and motivated group of engineers, this is the place for you.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Knowledge of Python and/or C++ programming

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution
- Knowledge of machine learning model architecture and inference
- Experience with CUDA kernels or ML/low-level kernels
- Knowledge of syntax and tile-level semantics similar to Triton
- Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT or similar platforms in production environments
- Experience with PyTorch, JIT compilation, and AOT tracing

descriptionHtml:

This role requires a self-starter and independent individual with strong financial modeling abilities, problem solving skills, a keen attention to detail, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment with ambiguous situations.
The successful candidate will have shown experience in past roles influencing business leaders and supporting decision-making in rapidly evolving environments. This role also has regular interaction with executives and various business units across Amazon, and therefore requires strong interpersonal and communication skills. In addition, this role requires strong business sense and the capability to independently drive business partnership. This role demands a finance leader who is equal parts strategist and operator. Someone who can deeply understand business nuances and translate that into financial impact.

• Develop financial insights and narratives during all planning, forecasting, and reporting cycles.
• Manage and develop the financial planning and analysis processes, including long range planning, and OP1/OP2 planning processes.
• Partner with finance teams across Advertising to standardize, streamline, and prioritize improvements, remove roadblocks, and increase the reliability and efficiency of reporting.
• Partner with the business teams to drive alignment between financial forecast and business plan of record.
• Support ad-hoc requests and assist in various requests from finance and business executives.
• Assess the impact of AI initiatives on the financial plan
• Assist in the development of new advertising products by evaluating the business, understanding customer needs and value drivers, and crafting high impact growth strategies for the business
• Partner with the Sponsored Product Ads business team to anticipate business requirements, trends, and variances; develop action plans; measure and analyze results; identify and drive growth and improvement opportunities.

- 12+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field

title: Sr. HR Business Partner, AMXL
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The Senior HR Business Partner (Sr. HRBP) is a key strategic partner on the AMXL PXT team, bringing expertise in leadership development, employee experience, culture, and change management. This role balances tactical excellence with strategic insight, leveraging both technology and human judgment to align local leadership, centralized support, and systems in delivering high-quality employee experiences.

The Sr. HRBP contributes to excellence in PXT service delivery through leadership and strategic insight. They support team development and process optimization while upholding high standards and risk management practices. Leveraging data and experience, they inform business decisions and help implement scalable solutions. Their influence extends across the organization, collaborating with leaders to advance key initiatives and deliver solutions that balance immediate needs with long-term objectives.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and develop a diverse team of HR professionals, coaching them to elevate beyond tactical execution to become strategic partners who proactively identify and mitigate organizational risks while delivering exceptional service.

- Drive a culture of proactive risk identification and mitigation by establishing early warning systems, leveraging data insights, and building strong partnerships across functions. Guide your team in developing sound judgment to spot emerging people-related risks before they impact the business.

- Shape the strategic vision for employee experience and organizational health. Challenge status quo thinking and drive innovation in HR practices while ensuring sustainable execution. Enable your team to move beyond immediate problem-solving to address systemic issues and opportunities.

- Partner with business leadership to develop and execute integrated talent strategies that address both current needs and future capability requirements. Coach leaders on effective talent development while building a strong succession pipeline within your own HR organization. Anticipate future talent needs and evolving workforce dynamics to future-proof both operations and HR.

- Lead your team in effective use of analytics and AI tools to uncover hidden patterns, predict emerging risks, and drive data-informed decision making. Translate complex insights into compelling narratives that influence senior stakeholders and drive organizational change.

- Set clear goals for culture transformation with business leaders. Design and implement comprehensive strategies to systematically strengthen organizational health, talent capabilities, and leadership effectiveness. Champion initiatives that measurably enhance diversity, equity and inclusion.

- Drive strategic adoption of HR technology to enable both efficiency and excellence in service delivery. Guide your team to leverage automation while preserving high-touch support for sensitive employee matters requiring human judgment and empathy.

A day in the life
A typical day involves balancing strategic insight with tactical execution. You'll provide expertise in employee relations, coach leaders through performance and development matters, and drive HR functional excellence. Operating with autonomy, you'll partner with leaders at multiple levels to develop forward-looking strategies focused on employee experience and operational objectives.

Through data analytics and AI-enabled tools, you'll identify trends and opportunities while maintaining the human connections essential for building trust. You'll support critical HR processes such as investigations and talent management while leveraging technology to enhance service delivery and decision-making, knowing when automation creates efficiency and when personal interaction remains crucial.
