title: Electrical Integration Leader - Power Distribution & Infrastructure, OMHS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking an Electrical Installation Lead – Power Distribution & Infrastructure to drive the successful installation of electrical power systems for automation and material handling equipment across multiple greenfield and brownfield fulfillment center sites. This role provides field-based electrical installation leadership focused specifically on heavy wire pulls, power distribution infrastructure, conduit and raceway systems, control panel placement, and high-voltage terminations in complex industrial environments. The Electrical Installation Lead – Power Distribution will directly manage installation crews
responsible for all electrical infrastructure that feeds power to MHE systems. This includes
conduit installation from Main Distribution Panels (MDPs) to sub-panels and equipment, cable tray routing, heavy wire pulling (480V 3-phase), control panel placement, disconnect installation, junction box and pull box placement, grounding systems, and wire terminations. You will ensure all power distribution work is executed safely, in compliance
with NEC/NFPA codes, and to Amazon's quality and schedule standards. This role reports to the Site Deployment Manager and works in close coordination with the Low Voltage Devices & Controls lead — your team must complete power infrastructure in each zone before device installation crews can mobilize. This sequencing makes schedule discipline and quality critical to overall project success.

Key job responsibilities
Power Distribution Installation Leadership:
• Lead and manage electrical installation crews focused on power distribution infrastructure for MHE systems across North American facilities
• Oversee conduit and raceway installation from Main Distribution Panels (MDPs) to sub-panels, disconnects, and equipment locations
• Manage heavy wire pulling operations through conduit including 480V 3-phase power feeders, ensuring proper cable sizing, labeling, and termination
• Direct control panel placement and mounting at designated locations per engineering drawings, ensuring proper clearance and accessibility
• Oversee installation of cable tray systems, junction boxes, pull boxes, and wireways
• Manage installation of disconnects, motor starters, overloads, and related power distribution components
• Direct grounding system installation and bonding connections per NEC requirements
• Ensure proper wire terminations with correct torque values, lugging, and labeling at all connection points
• Oversee cable management including wire bundling, cable supports, strain relief,
and routing compliance

Drawing Interpretation & Field Execution:
• Review and interpret electrical drawings including one-line diagrams, panel schedules, conduit schedules, cable schedules, and electrical installation details
• Verify field installation matches engineering drawings and identify conflicts requiring resolution
• Partner with engineering teams to clarify drawings, resolve field conflicts, and validate installation intent
• Maintain accurate field documentation including redlines, punch lists, installation status reports, and turnover documentation
• Coordinate with mechanical installation teams on shared routing paths, penetrations, and structural supports

Quality, Safety & Compliance
• Ensure all electrical power distribution work is completed in accordance with NEC/NFPA codes, project specifications, and Amazon standards
• Perform and oversee quality inspections on conduit installations, wire pulls, terminations, panel connections, and grounding systems
• Verify conduit fill ratios, bend radius compliance, and proper support spacing per code requirements
• Manage electrical punch list identification and repair for all power infrastructure scope
• Drive achievement of safety, timeline, cost, and quality metrics across assigned zones
• Ensure lockout/tagout compliance and electrical safety practices during all installation activities

Coordination & Communication
• Coordinate electrical infrastructure installation with mechanical teams, controls engineering, construction, vendors, and operations stakeholders
• Manage zone handoff sequencing with the Low Voltage Devices & Controls lead — power infrastructure must be complete before device installation begins
• Track electrical installation progress, risks, blockers, and quality issues, escalating when support is needed
• Participate in project-level technical reviews, installation readiness reviews, and punch walks
• Manage relationships with electrical contractors, OEMs, vendors, and internal project stakeholders
• Participate in daily business reviews with installation progress updates
• Support development and continuous improvement of electrical installation standards, field checklists, and scalable deployment processes

A day in the life
Your day starts at the site coordination meeting where you review which zones have completed mechanical steel installation and are ready for electrical infrastructure mobilization. You walk the floor with your conduit crew — verifying raceway runs from MDPs to sub-panels against engineering drawings, checking conduit supports and fill
ratios, and confirming proper routing around obstructions. You oversee wire pulling operations in active zones, ensuring proper cable sizing, bend radius compliance, and pull tension limits are respected. Mid-morning you inspect control panel placements, verifying mounting locations match drawings, checking clearance requirements, and confirming grounding connections. You validate junction box and disconnect installations, review wire terminations for proper torque values and labeling, and address any field conflicts that require engineering clarification. By afternoon, you're tracking installation progress against the schedule, coordinating with the device installation lead on upcoming zone handoffs, and documenting redlines for as-built updates. You close out at the daily business review with progress updates and flag any material or access risks for the next
day.

About the team
The OMHS Installation & Deployment team supports the deployment and integration of automation and material handling systems across Amazon's operations network. The team works cross-functionally with engineering, construction, operations, supply chain, vendors, and field execution partners to deliver safe, scalable, and reliable systems.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in engineering including a supervisory role managing people
- Experience in a fast-paced, automated, industrial, logistics, production or manufacturing environment
- 5+ years of experience in industrial electrical installation, electrical construction,
- power distribution, or a similar technical environment
- Experience leading or supervising electrical installation crews, contractors, or field execution teams
- Experience reading and interpreting electrical drawings including one-line diagrams, panel schedules, conduit schedules, and wiring diagrams
- Experience with industrial power distribution systems including 480V 3-phase, motor control circuits, disconnects, and related infrastructure
- Experience with conduit installation, raceway systems, cable tray, wire pulling, and termination practices
- Experience working in fast-paced industrial, logistics, manufacturing, or construction environments
- Ability to travel up to 50% domestically; travel may exceed 50% in some instances with short notice

Preferred qualifications

- Prior experience managing journeyman electricians, electrical contractors, or industrial electricians on large-scale installation projects
- Prior experience working for a material handling integrator
- Prior experience installing power distribution infrastructure for conveyor or sortation systems
- Experience with 480V 3-phase systems, motor control centers (MCCs), VFD power wiring, and transformer installations
- Journeyman electrician license, master electrician license, or state electrical license
- Knowledge of AutoCAD Electrical, Bluebeam, BIM 360, or equivalent drawing review software
- Experience with NEC/NFPA compliance in industrial or construction environments
- Experience managing third-party electrical contractors and subcontractors
- Experience with punch list management, redlines, installation quality inspections, and turnover documentation
- Lean, Six Sigma, PMP, or related project management certifications

You will apply your expertise in international payroll, employment tax, social security legislation, and cross-border worker regulations to directly impact how Amazon discovers, measures, and resolves payroll compliance risks. If you are detail-oriented, analytical, and motivated to make a tangible difference, this is the role for you.

Key job responsibilities

-Develop and maintain management reporting and metrics using Excel and compliance tools, tracking statutory requirements and ensuring effective monitoring of identified risks across multiple countries.
-Identify new risk areas and potential non-compliance issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive resolution through to full compliance while collaborating with Tax, Accounting, Human Resources, and Global Mobility teams.
-Manage and facilitate audits of operational payroll processes and statutory obligations, including Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance activities, and develop remediation plans to close identified gaps.

descriptionHtml:
アマゾンジャパンは「地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業」として、急速な事業拡大の中でもお客様の利便性を追求してきました。そのサービスを支えるExternal Fulfillment（EF）部門では、Process Engineerを募集しています。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Amazon Japan, striving to be "Earth's most customer-centric company," has relentlessly focused on enhancing customer convenience throughout its rapid growth. This position will be responsible for designing and implementing processes at our fulfillment centers. The role focuses on maximizing safety, quality, and productivity through continuous improvement (Kaizen) initiatives. This is an impactful position offering direct involvement in shaping Amazon's innovative services.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

title: EU - China Vendor Manager, BISS
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Vendor Manager to join the EU Hardlines (HL) team within Amazon Retail, specializing in Chinese vendor on-boarding. Hardlines is one of the largest and fastest-growing product families in Amazon EU, spanning categories such as Home, DIY & Tools, Garden, Automotive, Business, Industrial & Scientific Supplies (BISS), Sports, and more. A significant share of HL selection and growth originates from Chinese brands and manufacturers, and this role owns the pipeline that brings them onto the EU platform and scales them.

We are looking for a leader who can develop deep relationships with strategic Chinese brands and manufacturers, take full P&L ownership of a cross-border vendor cohort, and drive it towards its next phase of selection-led growth. Much of the selection runway in HL sits with manufacturers who do not yet sell directly on Amazon EU; the right candidate will be hungry to close that gap through vendor acquisition, on-boarding, negotiations, and a relentless focus on customer experience.

In this role, you will examine data to identify high-potential Chinese brands and manufacturers to target, including holdout vendors, initiate long-term relationships with their senior management, resolve the operational, logistical, commercial, and cross-border barriers that slow on-boarding, conduct negotiations on Amazon's behalf, and help vendors launch, ramp, and scale on the platform.

You will also work closely with multiple partner teams and senior stakeholders across EU and China, including Category Leaders, Finance, Supply Chain, Catalogue, Compliance, and Global Selling, to deliver projects that meaningfully improve customer experience, selection breadth, and profitability.

This role has a high degree of autonomy for developing, owning and delivering the vendor on-boarding strategy in order to exceed business goals and for managing key vendors both locally and Pan-EU.



Key job responsibilities
- Identify, acquire and onboard new Chinese brands and manufacturers across HL categories
- Build and own a pipeline of high-potential vendors, including strategic holdouts
- Travel to China to attend tradeshows and meet vendors face-to-face
- Develop long-term relationships with vendors' senior management
- Conduct negotiations on Amazon's behalf to drive top- and bottom-line growth
- Own the Retail P&L for your vendor cohort and deliver revenue and margin plans
- Resolve the cross-border barriers — logistics, compliance, catalogue, and payments — that slow vendor onboarding and ramp
- Use data to identify which vendors to target and to prioritise selection addition
- Work with Category Leaders, Finance, Supply Chain, Catalogue, Compliance, and GlobalSelling to improve customer experience, selection, and profitability

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Fluency in Mandarin Chinese (written and verbal)
- Fluency in English (written and verbal)
- Experience in vendor management, account management, buying, merchandising, or a commercial/negotiation role
- Experience with business analysis and P&L management
- Experience using data and metrics to drive decisions, including proficiency in Excel
- Experience negotiating with and managing external partners or vendors

Preferred qualifications

- Experience onboarding or managing cross-border vendors, or working with Chinese brands and manufacturers
- Experience in a cross-functional role working with supply chain, catalogue, compliance, or logistics teams
- Experience managing large, complex vendor negotiations

title: Principal Product Marketing Manager, Ads Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Come build the future with us! What unites all Amazonians (across teams and geographies) is that we are all striving to delight customers and make their lives easier, whoever that customer may be. In pursuit of delighting customers, Amazonians have developed many products and services that transformed the way our customers live their lives and run their businesses. Together, we are building the future, one innovative product, service, and idea at a time.

Amazon Ads is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brand advertisers, agencies, authors, publishers, and entrepreneurs. Our ad solutions—including retail media, display, video, DSP, measurement, and ad tech solutions—leverage Amazon's innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage intended audiences throughout their daily journeys.

We're seeking a strategic and customer-obsessed Product Marketing Manager to join our Ads Product Marketing team. In this role, you'll serve as a critical bridge between product development and go-to-market execution, translating complex advertising solutions into compelling narratives that resonate with advertisers and drive product adoption at scale.

As a Product Marketing Manager, you'll partner closely with Product Management, Go-to-Market, and cross-functional stakeholders to shape product strategy through deep customer insights and competitive intelligence. You'll own the end-to-end marketing lifecycle—from informing the product roadmap through voice-of-customer research to crafting positioning and messaging that differentiates our solutions in market. Your work will directly influence how thousands of advertisers discover, adopt, and maximize value from Amazon Ads products.

The ideal candidate combines analytical rigor with creative storytelling, thrives in ambiguous environments, and has a proven track record of launching products that achieve measurable business impact. You'll need to balance strategic thinking with tactical execution, moving seamlessly from conducting advertiser research to developing sales enablement materials to presenting product vision to senior leadership.

Key job responsibilities
1. Collaborate with Product Managers to align on customer research priorities that will inform the product roadmap.
2. Conduct in-depth research and competitive analysis to identify the most promising opportunities for Amazon Ads products.
3. Communicate the product vision and direction to internal and external stakeholders to drive buy-in and adoption, establishing a regular cadence of stakeholder engagement.
4. Partner with Product Managers to recommend customer feedback prioritization, support effective Alpha/Beta testing, and refine the strategic roadmap.
5. Align GTM strategy to the product roadmap, translate complex product information into simple and clear language, and continue to gather customer feedback post-launch to inform future iterations.
6. Develop single-source-of-truth documentation to enable sales and marketing with positioning, messaging, product availability, best practices, implementation guides, and FAQs.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing the latest campaign performance data and customer feedback, then shift into a working session with product managers to refine messaging for an upcoming launch. After lunch, you could be presenting a go-to-market strategy to senior leaders, gathering input, and aligning on next steps. Later, you'll connect with sales and partner teams to ensure enablement materials are landing effectively. Throughout it all, you're asking the right questions, simplifying complexity, and keeping cross-functional teams moving toward a shared goal.

About the team
The Ads Product Marketing team within Amazon Ads is the strategic connective tissue between product innovation and market impact. We don't just launch products, we shape how advertisers discover, understand, and derive value from Amazon's advertising solutions across the full funnel.

The Commerce pod sits at the heart of this mission, owning product marketing for some of Amazon Ads' core solutions: Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Brand Stores. Together, these products serve millions of advertisers globally from small businesses running their first campaign to the large brands.

This role is part of the Sponsored Products & Sponsored Brands (SPB) product marketing team. We are evolving the PMM function beyond traditional launch communications to earning a seat at the table to directly influence the product roadmap through voice-of-customer research, competitive intelligence, and deep advertiser insights. Our work spans the full marketing lifecycle: from shaping what gets built, to how it's positioned in market, to driving adoption and measuring impact post-launch.

You'll join a collaborative, fast-paced team that partners daily with Product Management, Go-to-Market, Sales Enablement, and cross-functional leadership. We operate with a builder mentality by testing, learning, and iterating to deliver solutions that move the needle for advertisers and for the business. If you're passionate about translating complex ad tech into compelling stories that drive real outcomes, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- 9+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with creating GTM initiatives at scale
- Experience working cross-functionally across marketing, product management, analytics, UX, and research

title: Senior Program Manager, Amazon Scholars, Amazon Scholars
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Scholar team is seeking a Senior Program Manager to support the Amazon Scholar Program. This global, high-impact role supports a program that enables university professors to work on Amazon's most significant scientific and technical challenges without leaving their academic institutions through part-time or limited-term engagements.

The Senior Program Manager is responsible for facilitating key milestones across the Scholar employee lifecycle and for defining and delivering mechanisms and solutions that resolve complex problems, create lasting value and drive broad cross-organizational and cross-regional business impact.

This role supports a global program end-to-end — defining and executing development goals, consulting business and science leaders, developing a communication strategy, and managing all associated workflows. The Senior Program Manager builds internal mechanisms to automate and scale workflows globally and develops sustainable, long-term strategies for academic engagement.


Key job responsibilities
- **Process re-engineering and gap identification:** Identifies gaps and opportunities across regions, processes, and organizations (e.g., workflows, tooling, operating procedures). Serves as the single-threaded owner for a specialty employee model with non-standard lifecycle policies, part-time/limited-term engagement structures, and a unique compensation model. Owns a portfolio of critical workstreams to re-engineer processes, redefine ownership, and drive efficiency requiring cross-functional influence across central People eXperience and Technology (PXT) teams.

- **Mechanism design and adoption:** Creates, optimizes, and drives adoption of the mechanisms that ensure long-term program success. Builds novel mechanisms and artifacts to sustain the Scholar population, force-multiplying through stakeholders and partners while addressing unique use cases.

- **Autonomous leadership in ambiguous domains:** Operates with significant independence in areas where strategy has not yet been defined. Navigates high complexity and ambiguity with customers, stakeholders, and decision-makers that often include Amazon's most senior leadership. The Scholar Program team serves as an overlay across all core PXT functions — requiring strong judgment, backbone, and autonomy to prioritize roadmaps, invest resources, and deliver results.

- **Data-driven business operations:** Supports Business Operations for Scholars Programs, designing reporting to inspect key org goals, KPIs, and insights through MBRs and QBRs. Defines product requirements for dashboards and influences data availability and decision-making in partner teams — for example, working with Finance to enable mechanisms that track Scholar program spend as an input to business planning and ROI evaluation.


About the team
We are a team of strategic recruiters and program managers working to bring the best executive-level academic science talent to Amazon and elevate our reputation in the academic science community as an employer of choice. We believe Amazon is a unique place to measure the impact of new scientific ideas, given our scale and ownership of both an information infrastructure and a physical infrastructure. The Scholars Programs team focuses on three priorities:

1. Creating simple pathways to hire, develop, and retain world-class academic talent.
2. Developing internal and academic partnerships globally to address customer problems and demands.
3. Driving a non-conventional program to facilitate long-term science talent acquisition and retention in specialized domains.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- 5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Knowledge of general AI tools
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Experience building scalable programs and repeatable scalable processes, levering various tools and methods to create scale and efficiency
- Track record of building and scaling complex initiatives within fast-paced technology industry
- Experience with academic institutions or research organizations

descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our tech isn't just a tool, it's your playground. Our engineers work on scalable systems, cloud services, and customer-facing products that operate at global scale. This is an environment where you learn by building. Whether you're creating cloud-native solutions, optimizing machine learning models, or building products that drive experiences for millions of customers around the globe, your work reaches the world, fast. You'll take ownership early, collaborate across teams and disciplines, and grow your skills as you tackle new problems. There's no single path forward here, with a chance to explore different directions and shape your journey as you go. This is where ambition meets opportunity and, where the impact of what you build helps define what comes next, for customers and for you.

What's in it for you? An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You'll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

As a Database Engineering Intern on the Amazon Redshift team, you will have the opportunity to work alongside experienced database and software engineers to solve challenging problems in cloud database technology. You will gain hands-on experience with database systems, data warehousing, performance analysis, automation, and distributed computing while contributing to projects that impact AWS customers.

Joining the Amazon Redshift team gives you the opportunity to:
• Work on a widely used cloud data warehouse product
• Learn about database internals, distributed systems, and data warehousing
• Work with experienced engineers and receive mentorship throughout your internship
• Gain hands-on experience analyzing database workloads and performance
• Develop software and automation tools that improve database engineering processes
• Solve real-world technical problems at cloud scale
• Learn how large-scale data systems are designed, tested, and optimized


Key job responsibilities
As a Database Engineering Intern, you will work with engineers and technical teams to learn and contribute to database engineering projects.

Depending on your experience and interests, you may:
• Assist with database design, data modeling, and SQL development
• Write and optimize SQL queries involving multiple tables and large datasets
• Analyze database workloads and help identify opportunities for performance improvements
• Participate in performance benchmarking and testing of database workloads
• Develop scripts and software tools to automate repetitive engineering tasks
• Learn about distributed database architectures, query processing, and database system internals
• Investigate technical issues and work with engineers to identify and evaluate potential solutions
• Participate in design discussions and technical reviews
• Document technical findings and communicate results clearly to team members
• Collaborate with engineers to build reliable, scalable, and easy-to-use database solutions
You will receive guidance and mentorship from experienced engineers while gaining practical experience working on technologies used by customers around the world.

A day in the life

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and continue to innovate, helping startups, enterprises, and organizations around the world build and operate their businesses in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
At AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences inspire us to continue embracing our uniqueness.

Interns have opportunities to learn from experienced engineers through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and hands-on project work. We provide resources and experiences designed to help you develop your technical skills and grow as a professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home. We strive to create a supportive and flexible working environment where people can do their best work.

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed above, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting or you have gained experience through coursework, personal projects, research, or other non-traditional paths, we want to hear from you.

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides companies of all sizes with an infrastructure web services platform in the cloud. Amazon Redshift is a rapidly growing, fully managed, petabyte-scale cloud data warehouse that enables customers to analyze large volumes of structured and semi-structured data using standard SQL.

The Amazon Redshift team builds innovative cloud data warehouse technology that helps customers analyze data at massive scale. Our engineers work on challenging problems involving distributed systems, database performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud computing.

We value curiosity, learning, and a willingness to take on challenging problems. Interns are encouraged to ask questions, explore new technologies, and contribute ideas while developing their technical skills.

- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in technical support

This role requires expertise in AWS services, system architecture, and cross-functional collaboration with Capacity Management, Hardware Engineering, and Datacenter Operations to manage AI/ML infrastructure.

Key job responsibilities
The Software Development Engineer (SDE II) on the EC2 UltraServer Availability team is responsible for ensuring high availability of customer GB200 and GB300 UltraServers by orchestrating complex repair and recovery workflows. Following are the core responsibilities

System Design & Architecture

* Design and architect solutions that are cross-functional to Capacity Management, Hardware Engineering, and Datacenter Operations
* Work in environments where the technology strategy is defined but the solution design is not
* Build solutions that are stable, logical, testable, and efficient with the ability to independently make trade-off decisions
* Investigate and develop design concepts to frame solution sets at an application and product level

Software Development

* Build cloud-based solutions using AWS native services for scaling infrastructure frameworks

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

title: Site Operations Leader, OneMHS
descriptionHtml:
As a Site Operations Leader within the OneMHS Installation & Deployment (I&D) team, you will serve as the central engineering coordinator for large-scale material handling equipment (MHE) installation projects in greenfield and brownfield Amazon fulfillment environments. You will work directly alongside installation teams on active construction sites, owning the project schedule and coordinating all on-site project teams, sub-team leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver complex MHE systems from equipment receipt through commissioning.

You will independently manage the project schedule, procurement workflows, equipment logistics, and budget administration for MHE installation projects ranging from $50M to $100M+ in scope. Working directly with mechanical installation leads, electrical installation leads, controls engineers, commissioning teams, and external MHE vendors, you will be the single-threaded owner for site-level coordination — ensuring all teams are aligned, resources are sequenced correctly, and the project stays on track.

This is a field-based engineering role embedded within active construction sites. You will operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where you proactively identify schedule risks, resolve inter-team dependencies, and drive continuous improvement in how Amazon deploys MHE systems at scale.


Key job responsibilities
Project Coordination & Schedule Management
• Own and maintain the project schedule for MHE installation across assigned greenfield and brownfield sites
• Coordinate daily activities across all on-site project teams including mechanical installation, electrical installation, controls integration, and commissioning
• Serve as the central point of coordination between sub-team leaders, ensuring work sequences are properly phased and resource conflicts are resolved
• Lead daily site coordination meetings to align all installation teams on priorities, constraints, and upcoming milestones
• Track critical path items across all sub-teams and proactively identify and mitigate schedule risks
• Manage inter-team dependencies — ensuring predecessor work is complete before successor teams mobilize
• Coordinate site access timelines, aligning MHE first access dates with installation and commissioning schedules
• Create and maintain integrated project schedules coordinating engineering, supply chain, construction, and commissioning timelines
• Monitor and report KPIs for schedule adherence, budget performance, and installation progress
Site Logistics & Material Coordination
• Coordinate MHE equipment storage, sequencing, and shipment logistics between manufacturers, third-party storage facilities, and installation sites
• Manage equipment inventory tracking across active construction sites to ensure installation teams have materials staged and ready
• Engineer receiving and staging plans for MHE components including unloading coordination, inventory verification, and sequenced material placement
• Develop and maintain receiving instructions and standard operating procedures for installation crews
• Deploy and manage construction monitoring systems for progress documentation
• Coordinate asset tracking technology deployments to maintain visibility of MHE components through the installation lifecycle
• Ensure compliance with Amazon safety standards and construction site safety requirements during all installation activities
Procurement & Financial Management
• Own procurement workflows including purchase order creation, change order controls, and invoice management via Coupa
• Manage project budgets, tracking spend against approved allocations
• Develop and track financial reporting for assigned projects, providing regular budget status updates to leadership
• Coordinate with Global Procurement Organization (GPO) on vendor work allocation decisions and procurement strategies
• Create financial justification documents for equipment purchases and technology investments
• Support development of procurement and logistics strategies for large-scale multi-site deployments
Vendor Coordination & Management
• Serve as primary operational point of contact for MHE vendors on assigned sites
• Coordinate vendor equipment delivery schedules, milestone tracking, and change request alignment
• Lead vendor schedule review meetings and drive resolution of schedule conflicts between vendor and internal installation teams
• Manage vendor work allocation processes, ensuring clear scope definitions between self-perform and contracted work
• Support cross-vendor coordination for integrated installation projects involving multiple equipment suppliers
• Track and manage vendor change requests, ensuring proper documentation and financial alignment
Technical Documentation & Standards
• Develop and maintain cross-vendor work instructions for MHE installation activities
• Create and manage engineering documentation including receiving instructions, site logistics plans, and installation SOPs
• Support development of installation training materials and engineering standards documentation
• Contribute to drawing standards and layout reviews for MHE installation projects
• Participate in design reviews supporting execution between internal teams and outside vendors
• Maintain project documentation in alignment with I&D engineering team standards and best practices
Reporting & Stakeholder Communication
• Communicate project schedule status, risks, and team coordination updates to engineering leadership
• Participate in Daily Business Reviews (DBRs) providing installation progress updates on safety, job plans, and team readiness
• Support Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) with MHE vendor partners covering risks, schedules, commercials, and capacity
• Contribute to Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) with project-level metrics and milestones
• Provide technical input to leadership for data-driven decision-making
• Produce regular status summaries covering team progress, schedule variance, and resource utilization
• Identify and escalate inter-team conflicts, resource constraints, and schedule risks in a timely manner
• Support achievement of safety, timeline, cost, and quality metrics across assigned sites


A day in the life
A typical day for a Site Operations Leader begins with the daily site coordination meeting,
aligning mechanical, electrical, and controls teams on priorities and resolving any
sequencing conflicts. From there, you're walking the active construction site - verifying
material staging, checking that equipment deliveries match the schedule, and
troubleshooting any gaps holding up installation crews. Mid-day often involves vendor
schedule reviews, Coupa procurement actions, and updating the project schedule with
progress from each sub-team. You close out by flagging risks in the DBR, coordinating nextday
material needs, and ensuring every team has what they need to stay on track.

About the team
OneMHS (One Material Handling Systems) is Amazon's in-house program for designing,
procuring, and installing material handling equipment across its fulfillment network. Rather
than relying solely on external integrators, OneMHS brings the full lifecycle of MHE
deployment under Amazon's direct control - from final engineering and equipment
procurement through mechanical and electrical installation, controls integration, and
commissioning. The program supports both greenfield builds and brownfield retrofits,
deploying conveyor systems, sorters, induction systems, and robotic work cells at scale.
OneMHS enables Amazon to deliver faster, more cost-effective installations while
maintaining higher quality and safety standards.

Team is able to hire anywhere in the USA.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of directly managing and responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 5+ years of Reliability Program Manager experience
- 5+ years of maintenance or engineering experience
- 2+ years of commercial CO2 refrigeration applications experience
- 5+ years of directly managing and being responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 3+ years of in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments experience, or experience in reliability/maintenance environments
- 3+ years of leading cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, and field execution through launch readiness and go-live phases experience
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, Reliability Engineering, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience
- Experience and strong technical background in relevant fields of automated or non-automated material handling equipment
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in engineering, mechanical, operations, supply chain, business administration, or equivalent STEM field
- Master's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration, or Master's degree or above in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics)
- Experience in Lean Management, Six Sigma and other operations engineer tools
- Experience building launch readiness frameworks, standard work, playbooks, and scalable deployment mechanisms across multiple concurrent sites
- Experience with performance metrics such as OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), downtime, throughput, or quality
- Experience in Amazon RME (Reliability, Maintenance, and Engineering), fulfillment operations, or automation deployment environments

title: Sr Program Manager, AI & Data, Global Corporate Communications
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Global Corporate Communications (GCC) is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the data and AI systems that GCC's teams rely on. You'll build the shared foundation beneath GCC's work: making its data usable by AI, delivering the AI systems on top of it, and connecting the work across GCC and its partners.

Today, a lot of GCC's most valuable data is scattered. Research, media coverage, agency reporting, processes, and planning documents live in different places and formats, with different access. That makes it hard for teams to bring it together, and hard for AI to do anything with it. You'll connect those sources, structure them so AI can actually retrieve and reason over the content, and design tools on top of them. The teams who produce the data still own it. You make sure it's structured, accessible, and fits together, so everyone gets more out of it.

A lot of this job comes down to giving people across the team more ownership of their work. That happens two ways. First, by reducing dependencies, the places where people are stuck waiting on a manual step, a handoff, or the one person who knows how something works. Second, by clearing away the rote, repetitive work that fills their days. You'll get to know how GCC operates, find where both of these slow people down, and build what it takes to help. Everyone here is a builder, and your job is to support that.

No two months in this role look the same. The data keeps growing, the tools keep changing, and there's always a new challenge worth taking on. It's a great fit for someone who likes to work independently, dig into complex problems, and see their work make a difference across a team.

- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

title: Partner Solutions Architect, ASEAN APO Partner Solutions Architecture Team
descriptionHtml:
AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders, we try new things, and imagine big dreams. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, testers, and doers. Come join us and work with the latest cloud technologies that enable our customers to adopt cloud-based solutions.

THE ROLE
You will collaborate with a diverse partner community—including distributors, traditional system integrators, born-in-cloud partners, and AI-native partners—alongside other AWS teams to build architectures, proof of concepts, and demonstrations of AWS services by working backwards from their customers' business needs to accelerate the adoption of appropriate AWS technology.
A key focus of this role is accelerating both migration and AI transformation through partners. You will drive large-scale migration initiatives while simultaneously building and scaling an Agentic Platform that empowers partners to deliver AI-driven, autonomous solutions to their customers. You will help shape and design partner solutions covering a spread of domains from migration of core applications and workloads to working with GenAI, Agentic AI, AI/ML, microservices, containers, app development, IoT, and more. Being able to continuously expand your technological knowledge—particularly in migration methodologies and emerging agentic and autonomous AI capabilities—and having an interest in designing industry-applicable architectures that demonstrate business value are essential for this role.
PARTNER COMMUNITY MANAGEMENT
You will be responsible for managing and scaling relationships across multiple partner types to accelerate both migration and AI adoption:
• Distributors: Enable and empower distribution partners to extend AWS reach, providing technical enablement for migration and AI services, go-to-market support, and architectural guidance that cascades through their partner networks
• Traditional System Integrators: Work with established SI partners to modernize their migration practices, integrate AWS services into their delivery models, and help them evolve their capabilities to include AI and agentic solutions alongside traditional migration offerings
• Born-in-Cloud Partners: Engage with cloud-native partners who have built their business models around cloud technologies, helping them scale their AWS migration practices and develop advanced capabilities in emerging AI technologies
• AI Partners: Collaborate with AI-native and specialized AI partners to co-innovate on industry solutions, integrate their technologies with AWS services, and accelerate customer adoption of intelligent, autonomous systems that complement migration journeys
MIGRATION ACCELERATION
You will drive migration velocity and scale through your partner community by:
• Enabling partners to execute large-scale migration programs using AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) and other migration frameworks
• Building partner capabilities in migration assessment, planning, and execution methodologies
• Developing migration-specific reference architectures, tools, and accelerators for partners
• Coaching partners on migration best practices, including the 7Rs (Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, etc.)
• Helping partners integrate AI/ML capabilities into migration workflows to optimize and accelerate customer migrations
• Driving partner-attached migration ARR and ensuring successful migration outcomes
AGENTIC PLATFORM DEVELOPMENT
A critical component of your role is building up an Agentic Platform for partners that enables them to:
• Develop, deploy, and scale autonomous AI agents that can reason, plan, and execute complex tasks
• Integrate agentic capabilities into their existing migration and modernization solutions
• Leverage AWS AI/ML services to create intelligent, self-improving systems that enhance migration and post-migration optimization
• Build partner competencies and certifications around agentic AI technologies
• Create reusable frameworks, reference architectures, and accelerators for agentic solutions that complement migration journeys
TRUSTED TECHNICAL ADVISOR
As a trusted technical advisor, you'll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders—from technical teams to executives—across your partner community. You'll help ensure their short-term technology decisions around migration and AI are aligned with their long-term strategic goals. Helping partners work with customers to accelerate adoption of AWS migration services and AI capabilities will be part of your day-to-day activities.
COMMUNITY EVANGELIST & THOUGHT LEADER
You'll also act as an evangelist in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing whitepapers, blogs, and running workshops focused on partner enablement, migration acceleration, agentic AI, and emerging technologies. You won't just want to be part of an industry movement; you'll want to be leading it.
BUILDER & PRODUCT INFLUENCER
As a Builder, you'll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from partners and their customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams to influence the roadmap of AWS's migration tools, agentic capabilities, and AI services.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 3+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in infrastructure architecture, database architecture, networking and application development, including designing and delivering complex, large-scale enterprise solutions
- Knowledge of enterprise application platforms, middleware, containers, serverless and distributed systems, and their architecture, scalability, security and resiliency needs
- Hands-on experience with modern software development practices, including CI/CD, DevOps, Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, AWS CDK) and API-driven, microservices-based architectures
- Experience working with end-user or developer communities, including building technical content, running workshops and enabling teams to adopt new technologies
- Experience managing relationships with enterprise customers and technology partners (ISVs, Systems Integrators, Consulting Partners) to drive solution design and adoption

- Experience designing and building solutions in domains such as Generative / Agentic AI, data & analytics, and event-driven integration

title: Sr. Partner Integration Manager, Amazon
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about managing the technical partnerships that connect retailers to new ways of selling online? As a Sr. Partner Integration Manager, you will own the relationship with the retailer systems and third-party integrators. Sitting at the intersection of Business Development, Engineering, and our integrator community, you are the trusted technical advisor and two-way translator — shaping the right integration paths for new partners, keeping integrators ahead of API changes, and driving our documentation toward true self-service. This role requires deep understanding of retailer systems and independent judgment about what is operationally critical for a retailer. You must be technically fluent (able to read API specs, reason about data flows, and troubleshoot integrations), excel at navigating ambiguity, and thrive in an entrepreneurial environment, with excellent interpersonal skills. This role offers an exciting opportunity to shape the technical foundation of an emerging category on Amazon. Your insights from working directly with the integrator community will directly influence our APIs, documentation, and marketplace.

Key job responsibilities
1. Partner with the BD team to assess prospective retailer and platform partners’ systems architecture and define the right integration path with Amazon, bringing solutioning expertise into partner conversations.
2. Map IMS/DMS/platform capabilities to our APIs, surface constraints and dependencies early, and apply independent judgment on what is critical for operations (inventory accuracy, transaction flows, data fidelity) to steer integration design.
3. Work closely with Engineering to understand upcoming API updates, deprecations, and new capabilities before they ship.
4. Proactively communicate API changes to the integrator community with enough lead time and clarity for them to plan and execute their own updates.
5. Act as the first line of technical support for integrators — answering questions, troubleshooting integration issues, and escalating to Engineering when needed.
6. Drive the accuracy and currency of API documentation by coordinating with the internal owners of each API surface.
7. Feed real integrator questions and friction points back into the documentation to continuously push it toward true self-service and reduce question volume at the source.
8. Build and manage durable relationships across BD, Engineering, documentation owners, and the external integrator ecosystem, operating with influence.

A day in the life
As a Sr. Partner Integration Manager, you will work cross-functionally with Business Development, Engineering, and Product Management, while building and maintaining relationships with technical stakeholders across our external integrator community. One part of your day may be spent advising BD on a prospective partner’s integration path; another translating an upcoming API change into clear guidance for integrators; another troubleshooting a live integration issue and feeding what you learn back into the documentation. You will be instrumental in defining how integrators build on Amazon, providing valuable technical insights to product and engineering teams, and creating initiatives that scale integrator self-service. This role is based in London with occasional travel to meet with systems partners and integrators.

About the team
This role explores opportunities to innovate in an emerging category on Amazon. Our team aims to raise the bar on the buying experience for end customers, while enabling industry partners and integrators to build and grow efficiently by leveraging Amazon’s capabilities.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
- Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship
- Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
- Experience in a technical partner/customer-facing role (developer relations, technical partner/alliance management, solutions architecture, or sales/integration engineering).
- Direct experience with DMS, inventory/feed systems, CRM, or digital retail/commerce platforms.
- Strong working knowledge of integration patterns; able to read API specs, reason about data flows, and troubleshoot integration issues.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with APIs and technical integrations
- Experience building and managing an external developer/integrator community at scale.
- Comfort operating in ambiguity across international markets.

The Data Center Community is looking for an extraordinary individual with proven and tested leadership and management skills as a leader in our data center operations organization in the Eastern Oregon Region as a Data Center Operations (DCO) Cluster Manager.

Data Center Operations Cluster Manager is one of our most senior management roles in the data center environment. In this role, you will be responsible for leading a large organization, managing managers who own data center infrastructure including the operational availability of network and server systems at scale.

The pace, scale, and growth of Amazon’s data center environment will challenge you. Our uncompromisingly high standards as we continually seek to innovate on behalf of our customers will push you to new levels of creativity. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Associate Advocacy & Cultural Leadership - Serve as a trusted safety advisor and advocate for associate wellbeing, building strong partnerships across all levels of the organization. Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. Develop strong relationships with frontline associates and leadership to drive behavioral changes and ensure safety best practices become natural habits. Transform safety data into compelling narratives that influence positive change and drive engagement in safety initiatives.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- A minimum of 1 year in an Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) related field OR; A Bachelor’s degree in EHS-relevant background OR; 6 months experience performing in a safety-related role within Amazon
- Knowledge of OSHA regulations specifically 29 CFR 1910
- Experience using Microsoft Word and Excel in a professional capacity
- Experience maintaining confidentiality in matter involving security and/or personnel issues in the workplace

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Security Epoxy
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Security operates at a scale few engineers ever get to work at. Epoxy is the team that builds the automation making that coverage possible. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to support the building and operating of the platforms that onboard threat detection, remediate security risk, and accelerate security response across every AWS account.

AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security][ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it.

You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified.

- Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil.

- Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work.

- Participate in the team on-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes.

- Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term maintainability.

- Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers.

- Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices.

A day in the life
You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place.

You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written.

On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur.

You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back.

You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 13, 2026

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility or higher.

A Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to independently design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDE IIs write production-grade software and own delivery of complete AI workstreams end-to-end — from requirements gathering through production deployment — combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes.

FDE IIs are autonomous contributors. They deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle. They design cohesive implementations for ambiguous problems, making design trade-offs with appropriate guidance. They take on projects where the business problem is understood but implementations are not fully fleshed out, balancing constraints and limiting short-term workarounds. They coach others on producing high-quality code and train new team members.


Key job responsibilities
• Embed within customer engineering teams. Work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand the business and customer value of the systems you build. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate customer requirements into technical designs for AI-enabled production systems within your workstream. Requires 30 – 50% travel.
• Build production AI applications. Design and develop production-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost.
• Own production for your workstream. Be a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, operations, and maintenance. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, and application services. Ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved. Implement monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and CI/CD that keep AI systems healthy. Don't settle for the status quo — routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve operations.
• Mentor and uplift. Actively mentors and trains new team members on how systems are constructed, operated, and fit into the bigger picture. Coach others on producing high-quality code through mechanisms such as code review. Be active in the code review process, providing meaningful feedback to others.
• Accelerate customer adoption. Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption within your customer engagement. Codify reusable patterns and accelerators that benefit future customer deployments and feed back into AWS services. Make enhancements that improve your team's software and processes.


A day in the life
An FDE II spends the day building inside the customer's environment: pairing with their engineers on production AI features, translating requirements into designs for their workstream, troubleshooting production issues, and reviewing code. They work autonomously on scoped problems, bringing clarity to ambiguous implementations with appropriate guidance from senior FDEs.

title: Infrastructure Support Engineer, IREO
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Are you a passionate problem solver with a talent for unravelling intricate technical challenges? Do you flourish in an environment that demands innovation, resilience, and the ability to build and maintain robust services? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you within the Infrastructure Reliability Engineering Organisation (IREO) team.

You’ll have the privilege of being a valued member of an exceptional team, thriving in a dynamic and enthusiastic environment that combines dedication and enjoyment. A day in the life of a support engineer looks something like this:
• Dive deep to pinpoint the underlying causes of customer-related issues, providing valuable assistance in escalations when necessary.
• Apply Linux expertise to troubleshoot, innovate solutions, and resolve technical issues.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: System Integration Engineer, SERDES
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs, as part of Amazon, is looking for an Experienced HW SERDES Engineer to join Annapurna’s SPIV (System Platform Interface validation) team. Our products include the most advanced interfaces and technologies and are widely used across AWS data centers as backbone for Nitro  (https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/nitro/), Graviton (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WDKwwFQKfSI) and other services. The candidate will own PCIe SERDES qualification and integration across a range of products from pre-silicon to post deployment debugs.

 

As a member of the SPIV team, you will own End-to-end subset of system PCIe SERDES interfaces across range of products through product life cycle:
1. Validation and qualification
2. Integration 
3. Deployment and post-deployment support
4. Failure analysis
5. Pre silicon activities for new technologies

As owner, you will set the strategy for PCIe SERDES qualification over multiple platforms, ensure the design worked well and drive complex system debugs involving HW and FW components.

You will define NPI practices and engage in pre-silicon efforts to explore new technologies and mitigate integration risks. You will enhance SERDES qualification results with large scale customer performance analysis to discover SERDES life-cycle issues and mitigate them.

This is a fast-paced, intellectually challenging position, and you will work with thought leaders in multiple areas of technology. We are changing industry, and we want individuals who are ready for this challenge and want to reach beyond what is possible today.

Key job responsibilities
- Approve future products PCIe SERDES technologies
- Define new products SERDES qualification and validation strategy and lead the execution
- Engage integrations of Annapurna Labs’ products with other vendors PCIe HW components
- Support ongoing integrations of PCIe SERDES in new products
- Lead triage, PCIe SERDES debug and root cause analysis of systems in AWS data centers 
- Drive and maintain training, quality documentation and collateral to improve in-fleet operation.

Basic qualifications

- B.Sc. in Electrical / Computer Engineering or equivalent.
- 7+ years of HW Design Experience or in Functional or Electrical Integration/Validation/Debug
- 2+ years’ experience working with SERDES design/Integration/Debug
- Knowledge on High speed interfaces such as PCIe/Multi gig Ethernet /USB 4 etc

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of scripting languages (bash, python, etc.)
- Operating PCIe measurement and debug equipment such as scope and analyzers.
- Solid signal integrity knowledge
- Experience with server design and computer systems architecture.

descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. It’s driven by Operations Managers who bring the team together to push excellence in safety, quality and productivity across our sites. At your site, you’ll lead other managers and create the operational plan that helps your teams meet their targets. This role is all about driving operational excellence to create the Amazon of tomorrow.


Key job responsibilities
- Manage and develop a team of Area Managers
- Lead operational teams on a shift, deal with issues, and positively impact site performance
- Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
- Work closely with other support teams, including HR, Finance, Health and Safety, and Security
- Design and deliver initiatives across the sites to improve operational performance

A day in the life
You’ll lead shifts at one of our operational sites. You’ll also be the key link between a number of teams, including finance, safety and operations integration teams. That means you’ll be close to the day-to-day operations at your site but also contribute to new ways to innovate at your site.

A typical day will involve meetings with different areas of the business, deep diving into performance and risk metrics for sites, and looking ahead to prepare for different levels of demand. Every day will also involve mentoring and coaching your team. You’ll be a source of leadership and support your team to be the best managers they can be.

IMPORTANT: Operations Managers and their teams work on-site, and are assigned to shifts that include one weekend day, and a day/night rotation every 4 weeks.

About the team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions.

descriptionHtml:

You’ll be responsible for designing clean sheet conceptual level vehicle configurations and layouts that integrate all subsystems and meet vehicle level requirements. You'll model internal subsystems, major structural elements, and the OML of the vehicle. Your designs will feed into our suite of multi-disciplinary optimization (MDO) tools to help size the vehicle and mature the design. You’ll explore new and novel drone vehicle conceptual designs in both focused and wide open design spaces, with the ultimate goal of meeting our customer requirements. You’ll have the opportunity to prototype vehicle designs and support wind tunnel and other testing of vehicle designs. You will directly support the Office of the Chief Program Engineer, and work closely across all vehicle subsystem teams to ensure integrated designs that meet performance, reliability, operability, manufacturing, and cost requirements.

About the team
How do you get items to customers quickly, cost-effectively, and—most importantly—safely, in less than an hour? And how do you do it in a way that can scale? Our teams of hundreds of scientists, engineers, aerospace professionals, and futurists have been working hard to do just that! We are delivering to customers, and are excited for what’s to come. Check out more information about Prime Air on the About Amazon blog (https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/transportation/amazon-prime-air-delivery-drone-reveal-photos).

- Bachelor's degree in aerospace and mechanical engineering or equivalent

descriptionHtml:

- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross

Amazon is a global leader in e-commerce and cloud computing, headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Since its inception in 1995, Amazon has strived to be the world's most customer-centric company, catering to a global customer base, which includes not only consumers but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). Our platform empowers
world-class retail brands and individual sellers to increase sales and reach new customers.

The Process Associate (Level 3) executes defined workflows in an SOP-driven environment, ensuring tasks are completed accurately, consistently, and within SLA timelines. The role requires strict adherence to standard operating procedures, with a focus on quality, productivity, and compliance.

The role operates in a fast-paced environment and requires a self-starter with strong attention to detail and analytical rigor. The candidate should be able to work effectively across teams, partners, and leadership, using data to drive clear and structured communication. The role also requires the ability to independently identify and resolve issues with minimal guidance.


Key job responsibilities
• Execute tasks in line with defined SOPs, ensuring accuracy and turn around time adherence
• Perform input validations and follow checklists to ensure completeness of outputs
• Identify and flag defects, exceptions, and SOP gaps to relevant stakeholders
• Maintain process compliance and documentation standards
• Support volume spikes and task transitions based on business needs
• Navigate internal tools and use MS Office (especially Excel) to track, analyze, and manage data workflows
• Make sound decisions when handling ambiguous or incomplete information
• Adapt to changing priorities, volume spikes, and task transitions without impacting metrics
• Participate in training and cross-skilling across multiple tasks
• Identify operational challenges and recommend improvements, including automation and process enhancements
• Work in rotational shifts within a 24/7 environment with weekly offs on any two days

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written English communication skills
- 0-5 years of work experience.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to follow structured instructions
- Analytical and problem-solving skills
- Ability to manage repetitive tasks across different workflows with high accuracy

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in operations or SOP-driven environments
- Familiarity with quality metrics and audit processes
- Ability to handle multiple tasks with quick turnaround times
- Technical Skills: Proficiency in MS Excel. Knowledge of VBA, SQL, and Data Warehousing is a plus.
- Key Metrics: Productivity (TPH/Output per hour), Quality/Error Rate, SLA/TAT adherence, SOP compliance
