title: Data Center Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

Data Center Technicians should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to success. In addition to hardware and network repair, candidates will install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix problems within the data center space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, and responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, escalating to senior technicians and management as needed/required
- Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
- Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
- Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
- Helping to train and onboard new team members

Physical requirements:

- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
- Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
- Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
- Work in a noisy environment
- Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Technician professional, you have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while you:
-Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
-Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
-Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting

You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of computer/server hardware troubleshooting or related IT experience
- High school or equivalent diploma
- Work a flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of network design, protocols and Layer 1/2 troubleshooting
- Associate's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Networking Engineering), or experience in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Networking Engineering)
- Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
- Experience in a data center or other critical environment

title: Principal Solutions Architect, Software and Technology, Central and Eastern Europe
descriptionHtml:
Join our AWS Solutions Architecture team in Central and Eastern Europe and empower Software and Technology Companies (aka ISV) to build at speed and scale with cloud technologies. Our customers are born in the cloud and are leading the industry in AI-native transformation.

You will work hand in hand with software and technology companies to help them make the most of the cloud and AI. You will be at the crossroads of business and technology and will engage with organizations at all stages of cloud and AI adoption.

You are a technical leader – for your customers and for the organization. Combining business acumen with technical skills and domain expertise, you work with customers to architect solutions to complex and emergent problems. You start and lead activities such as architecture advisory, proof of concepts, building together with customers, knowledge transfer and education. You will collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, Industry experts, support, service teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.

Internally, you will be the voice of the customer, sharing their needs and wants to shape the roadmap of AWS features.

You will be leading creation of reference architectures, technical content, code samples, developing patterns that others take to production. You will evangelize and educate about AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups and public speaking activities).

Key job responsibilities
- Build technical relationships with AWS strategic customers up to C-level and operate as their trusted advisor. The best interests of the customer shapes the guidance you provide.
- Provide architectural guidance to customers, helping them identify risks, opportunities, and anticipate future needs; build hands-on with them.
- Own the end-to-end technical strategy for customers, maintaining the current view of their technology landscape, business priorities, industry context, and competitive dynamics
- Partner with internal teams (sales, business development, support, engineering) to drive customer success and adoption of AWS
- Lead and own the development, delivery, review, and maintenance of technical content (e.g., sample code, blog posts, presentations, white papers, workshops); speak at industry and customer events.
- Lead customer feedback gathering, decomposing it into business and technical requirements for product and engineering teams, being involved in the early formation of new products and services

About the team
The team works with Software and Technology companies across Central and Eastern Europe. We are open to hire in multiple locations in Europe, including Amsterdam and Munich.

Basic qualifications

- Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing
- Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences and at C-level, including training, workshops, publications
- Experience in cloud architecture and CXO level engagement

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of distributed systems design and implementation or equivalent
- Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers
- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
- Knowledge of database, data warehouse, and data lake technologies; overview of data and AI market

title: Sr. Executive Research Recruiter, Global Speciality Recruiting
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Executive Recruiting team and help us identify and hire the world's most exceptional Principal Engineers. Members of Amazon's Principal Engineering Community are exemplary practitioners and pragmatic visionaries who set the standard for engineering excellence across Amazon. This role offers unparalleled visibility—you'll work across all Amazon businesses, advising senior executives on hiring strategy while building relationships with world-renowned technical leaders.

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Search Design: Develop robust, multi-channel strategies attracting world-class engineers. Map target companies, engage at conferences, generate referral leads. Build talent networks and tap industry sources for ongoing candidate pools.

Executive Advisory: Serve as talent adviser to leaders across Amazon—educating hiring managers about the external Principal Engineer demographic. Provide strategic guidance to executive leadership on top technical talent. Conduct continuous company and talent mapping.

Candidate Development: Develop prospects into candidates through sophisticated engagement. Perform assessment and screening, present to executive leadership. Conduct phone interviews, prepare candidates for technical interviews, coach leaders on talent acquisition at senior levels.

Market Expertise: Serve as expert for engineering recruiting. Contribute to knowledge base with education on industries and talent pools. Learn new domains quickly and craft effective search strategies.

What We're Looking For:

Research acumen: Learn technical domains quickly, craft effective search strategies, excel at candidate identification, engagement, and creative sourcing

Executive presence: Compelling communicator who engages busy executives and renowned engineers, self-assured and quick-thinking

Strategic judgment: Think strategically while executing tactically, relentlessly high standards, results-oriented

Collaboration: Team leader and member who believes individual wins are team wins, inquisitive with strong desire to learn

A day in the life
You'll map technical leadership at target companies, identifying Principal Engineers working on problems similar to Amazon's strategic initiatives. You'll craft multi-channel engagement strategies—attending technical conferences, leveraging networks for warm introductions to passive candidates who would be transformational hires.

You'll advise leaders on search parameters based on market realities, conduct phone screens with renowned engineers assessing technical depth and influence capability, and coach hiring managers on candidate engagement. You'll contribute to the team's knowledge base by documenting insights about emerging talent pools that inform future searches.

About the team
The Principal Engineering Recruiting team is the talent acquisition engine for Amazon's PE Community. We take a multi-channel approach (target company mapping, conference and event engagement, referral and network lead generation) to talent identification, engagement, assessment, and match-making. Our mission: identify, build relationships with, and hire every great Principal Engineer in the world. You'll work with a strong, established team of executive recruiters.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of advising and influencing executive leadership experience
- 5+ years of progressive corporate or search firm recruiting work with a focus on passive engineering candidate generation in a high tech market experience
- 5+ years of recruiting with focus on engineering, technical operations, and product management experience
- Bachelor's degree or above
- Experience in advising and influencing executive leadership
- Experience in progressive corporate or search firm recruiting with a focus on passive engineering candidate generation in a high-tech market
- Experience building and driving talent sourcing initiatives and pipelines
- Experience creating, measuring and scaling workflow among candidates, hiring managers and the recruiting team
- Experience managing and prioritizing multiple searches, projects and client relationships
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of performing team building, coaching and managing experience
- Experience in performing team building, coaching, and managing
- Experience recruiting passive candidates who are the most senior experts in their field
- Experience with executive recruiting in either a blue-chip, global in-house executive search team, or a top executive search firm
- Experience working with recruiting and people-related tools, CRM systems, and complex spreadsheets

title: Software Development Engineer, Bottlerocket
descriptionHtml:
As a Software Development Engineer on the Bottlerocket team, you will design, build, and maintain components of Bottlerocket — AWS's open-source, security-first container OS trusted by thousands of customers to run production workloads at massive scale.

As an SDE2, you'll write Rust and Go in the open on GitHub, shipping systems software that runs on millions of hosts worldwide — spanning OS services, container runtime integrations, update mechanisms, and orchestrator support for EKS and ECS. You'll solve hard problems in Linux internals, security hardening, and performance at unprecedented container density, while building the CI/CD and release tooling that powers safe, rapid OS delivery.

This is a uniquely open team within AWS: real open-source, real community, and real low-level engineering on infrastructure customers trust to run their most important workloads.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, implement, and maintain Rust-based OS components including system services, API servers, and update infrastructure for Bottlerocket
- Own features end-to-end from design through production, operating with high autonomy and delivering results on ambiguous problems
- Contribute to and maintain open-source code on GitHub, participating in public code reviews and community engagement
- Investigate and resolve complex systems issues spanning kernel, userspace, container runtimes, and orchestrator integrations (EKS, ECS)
- Build and improve CI/CD pipelines, release tooling, and automated testing frameworks that ensure safe, rapid OS delivery
- Harden security defaults and implement OS-level protections that reduce customer operational burden without sacrificing flexibility
- Partner cross-functionally with EKS, ECS, and security teams to design integrations and align on container host requirements
- Mentor engineers through code reviews, design feedback, and technical guidance, raising the quality bar across the team
- Participate in on-call rotations and operational excellence practices supporting production container infrastructure at scale
- Write technical design documents, contribute to roadmap planning, and communicate trade-offs clearly to stakeholders

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: EHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Lead daily safety audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments while implementing innovative solutions to prevent injuries. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Associate Advocacy & Cultural Leadership - Serve as a trusted safety advisor and advocate for associate wellbeing, building strong partnerships across all levels of the organization. Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. Develop strong relationships with frontline associates and leadership to drive behavioral changes and ensure safety best practices become natural habits. Transform safety data into compelling narratives that influence positive change and drive engagement in safety initiatives.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
- Must be available to work flexible shifts including days, nights and/or weekends.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

If you are assigned to a site in the jurisdiction of the New York City Fire Department, you may be required to attend training and testing to become and maintain a Certificate of Fitness Holder for building occupancy compliance.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- A minimum of 1 year in an Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) related field OR; A Bachelor’s degree in EHS-relevant background OR; 6 months experience performing in a safety-related role within Amazon
- Knowledge of OSHA regulations specifically 29 CFR 1910
- Experience using Microsoft Word and Excel in a professional capacity
- Experience maintaining confidentiality in matter involving security and/or personnel issues in the workplace

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in a safety related field
- Strong communication, teamwork, analysis, judgment, and customer focus skills
- Experience leading and managing a team, ability to analyze accident data, new processes, and machinery for potential safety concerns, and conduct job hazard and job safety analyses
- Experience in emergency response and currently holds First Aid and CPR certificates
- Experience in workers compensation case management

title: Software Devevelopment Manager, AWS Bill Adjustments, AWS Invoicing
descriptionHtml:
Come and join us in building the next-generation invoicing platform for AWS! As one of the foundational utility services within AWS Billing, our services are used by every AWS service and every AWS customer to turn customer usage into invoices. Our team provides a missionary focus on delivering an invoicing system that are trustworthy, future-proof, and stay well ahead of change curve in the cloud economy through high velocity execution.

Billions of dollars worth of invoices are processed through our platform every month, and the timeliness, accuracy, and detail of the data provided by our products heavily influence customer's financial processes. Our domain is in the "sweet spot" as the intersection of business and technical worlds. Our new features tailor to the unique needs of various customer segments and enable AWS's global expansion, while we use native AWS technologies to provide a highly scalable platform to support AWS's growing business. Our organization has a growth culture with an excellent track record of developing and promoting engineering leaders.

We are seeking an experienced Software Development Manager to lead the AWS Bill Adjustments team. You will own the architecture, development, and operations of the team's software and services; establish its technical standards and engineering practices; and grow engineers across levels. You will balance a steady stream of regulatory-driven country launches against long-term platform investment, keep a demanding live-site operation healthy, and translate technical trade-offs into durable, scalable solutions with measurable business impact. You will partner widely — with product and program management, and with invoicing, marketplace, finance, tax planning, and compliance reporting stakeholders who rely on this team as a source of truth.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and grow the team. Manage, coach, and develop the AWS Bill Adjustments team engineering team. Hire to raise the bar, develop engineers across levels (including growing senior engineers and emerging leads), and manage performance with direct, honest feedback.

- Own technical direction. Set the technical vision, strategy, and roadmap for the tax engine across determination, calculation, and collection/remittance support. Balance near-term regulatory commitments against the long-term health and maintainability of the platform.

- Own operational excellence. Keep business-critical, high-volume services in the billing path healthy — availability, scalability, correctness, auditability, and resilience. Reduce operational load and strengthen operational maturity through better runbooks, automation, and durable fixes.

- Deliver the roadmap. Plan and execute across competing demands: country and regime launches, compliance-driven changes, platform and scaling investment, and the team's AI-native initiatives. Make clear prioritization calls and communicate trade-offs to stakeholders and leadership.

- Deepen domain ownership. Build and retain deep understanding of the team's tax determination and calculation domain, and invest in reducing single-points-of-knowledge across the team.

- Partner across the organization. Work closely with product and program management, partner engineering teams across AWS Invoicing, marketplace, finance, tax planning, and compliance reporting stakeholders to align on requirements, sequencing, and outcomes.

- Advance the AI-native direction. Drive agent-first operations and tooling that reduce operational toil and accelerate how the team builds, delivers, and operates.

About the team
AWS Bill Adjustments team sits within AWS Invoicing. The team owns the Bill Adjustment services in the billing path — a space that blends deep, constantly changing domain complexity with large-scale distributed systems engineering, and spans AWS business expansion and compliance, customer experience.

The team holds a high bar for operational excellence and works in an AI-native way, while putting real weight on how people work together. It is a collaborative environment that welcomes different perspectives and invests in each other's growth — people share ideas openly, learn from one another, and take ownership of their work, supported by mentorship and room to develop.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in cloud computing and helping customers build on AWS? We have a role you might find interesting.

The AWS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to working with customers as they build and grow their businesses on AWS. We're here to make sure they can deploy the best, most scalable, and most secure architectures possible — and that they spend as little time and money as possible doing so.

Key job responsibilities
We are looking for technical builders who love the idea of working with customers to help them succeed. In this role, you'll work directly with a variety of interesting customers and help them make the best (and sometimes the most pragmatic) technical decisions along the way. You'll have a chance to build enduring relationships with these companies and establish yourself as a trusted advisor.

As well as spending time working directly with customers, you'll also get plenty of time to "sharpen the saw" and keep your skills fresh. We have more than 175 services across a range of different categories, and it's important that we can help customers take advantage of the right ones. You'll also play an important role as an advocate with our product teams to make sure we are building the right products for the customers you work with. And for the customers you don't get to work with on a 1:1 basis, you'll get the chance to share your knowledge more broadly by working on technical content and presenting at events.

A day in the life

If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the fastest-growing companies to Global 500 enterprises trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

title: Customer Executive Engagement Leader
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a senior individual contributor who will be responsible for orchestrating and elevating executive customer engagement across AWS India’s highest-priority accounts and strategic partners.
This role is the strategic connector between AWS India’s senior leadership and our key customers and partners. The leader will own the end-to-end executive engagement lifecycle from designing engagement programs and running the Executive Briefing Center (EBC) program for India, to driving follow-through on customer commitments made by the President of AWS India & South Asia. Beyond specific engagement responsibilities, this leader will identify and resolve cross-organizational blockers, maximise the AWS India & SE President’s leverage in customer-facing engagements, and build scalable mechanisms that institutionalize executive engagement across the India business.
Reporting directly into the AWS India & SE President, we are looking for a highly motivated professional who can self-start, cut through ambiguity, work with and through other teams to deliver outcomes, move fast, and roll up their sleeves when needed. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, can scale through influence rather than direct authority, and brings a relentless customer obsession with a bias for action.

Key job responsibilities
• Scale through influence and get things done with and through others without direct reporting line authority.
• Own and drive executive engagement programs, ensuring every interaction creates lasting customer value.
• Serve as the single-threaded owner for customer commitment follow-through including tracking, unblocking, escalating, and closing the loop on behalf of the AWS India & SE President.
• Liaise across Sales, Partner, Marketing, Specialist, Technology, and Global Sales Operations teams, providing the connective tissue to keep customer engagements organised and on track.
• Partner with Field Enablement to coach and elevate sellers on executive engagement, raising the bar across the India sales organisation.
• Champion an “Always-On” engagement model that maintains continuous, value-driven touchpoints with strategic customer executives.
• Represent India in regional and global executive engagement forums, bridging local customer context to APJC and worldwide priorities.
• Be an excellent communicator (both written and verbal) who can influence, respectfully challenge, build credibility, and articulate recommendations to VP-level executives.
• Transition easily from high-level strategic thinking to creative and detailed execution, with an even keel in a highly ambiguous environment.


About the team
This is a high-visibility, high-impact role operating at the nexus of AWS India’s most important customer relationships. You will work across India’s highest-priority accounts spanning enterprise, digital-native, and public sector customers ensuring that every executive interaction creates lasting value.
The role requires exceptional judgment and discretion, as you will regularly handle sensitive customer information and executive commitments. You must be equally comfortable preparing the AWS India & SE President for a Board-level meeting and rolling up your sleeves to chase down a deliverable across cross functional teams.
This position is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, gets energy from connecting people and ideas, and measures their success by the outcomes they enable rather than the authority they hold. If you can influence without authority, navigate complexity with grace, and care deeply about keeping promises to customers we want to talk to you.

- Experience communicating and handling cross-functional programs including project stakeholders, technical program managers, and software development teams
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership, or experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions
- • 10+ years of experience in customer success, executive relationship management, or executing Go-To-Market strategies.
- • Proven ability to drive alignment between diverse stakeholders and deliver outcomes without direct authority

Preferred qualifications

- Experience as a systems administrator, engineer or technical IT/cloud operations support specialist
- Experience relationship building and influencing at the C-level of Fortune 500 customers
- • Experience as part of a cross-functional senior/executive technology leadership team
- • Familiarity with India’s enterprise customer landscape, industry dynamics, and business culture
- • Experience thinking and working creatively to develop unique joint value propositions and product GTM strategy
- • Track record of building scalable mechanisms in a high-growth, fast-paced environment

title: Ingénieur projet maintenance industrielle / Expert Maintenance Support et développement (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Au Cœur du Dispositif Amazon — Rejoignez Notre Équipe RME

Vous êtes-vous déjà demandé ce qui permet à l'un des plus grands réseaux logistiques du monde de fonctionner sans le moindre accroc ? C'est nous.

Notre équipe de Maintenance et Fiabilité des Équipements (RME) est la colonne vertébrale technique des opérations d'Amazon — celles et ceux qui veillent à ce que nos équipements offrent des performances optimales, jour après jour. Nous formons une équipe pointue et analytique, qui allie une solide expertise technique à un véritable esprit d'équipe, encadrée par des ingénieurs expérimentés qui savent tirer le meilleur des machines comme des personnes.

Voici ce qui rend ce poste passionnant :

Travaillez avec des technologies que vous ne trouverez nulle part ailleurs. Des systèmes d'emballage automatisés aux robots de tri avancés, en passant par Amazon Robotics, vous mettrez les mains sur certains des équipements les plus sophistiqués du secteur — dont certains sont exclusifs à Amazon.

Résolvez de vrais problèmes qui comptent. Nous assurons la maintenance, le diagnostic et la réparation d'équipements critiques à travers notre réseau mondial de centres de distribution. Quand quelque chose tombe en panne, c'est nous qui le remettons en marche — et vite.

Garantissez la sécurité de tous. Nous veillons à ce que nos bâtiments respectent les normes réglementaires, protégeant chaque personne sur le site tout en maintenant les opérations à pleine capacité.

Faites évoluer votre carrière. Les possibilités d'évolution sont réelles — au sein de la RME comme à travers tout Amazon. Nombre de nos collaborateurs ont accédé à des postes à responsabilités, encadrant à leur tour la nouvelle génération de techniciens.

Tout ce que nous faisons poursuit un seul objectif : réduire au minimum les temps d'arrêt sur les sites logistiques clés d'Amazon, afin que les clients reçoivent leurs commandes à temps. Cela signifie que nous travaillons souvent en horaires décalés — tôt, tard ou de nuit — pour effectuer la maintenance au moment où elle perturbe le moins l'activité, afin que le réseau ne s'arrête jamais.

Et si vous repérez une façon plus intelligente de faire les choses ? Nous voulons l'entendre. Notre équipe a les compétences — et la liberté — de concevoir et déployer de nouveaux processus et des technologies de pointe.

Si vous êtes curieux techniquement, que vous aimez réparer et que vous voulez que votre travail ait un réel impact, que vous êtes ouvert à des shifts et des déplacements réguliers, cette équipe est faite pour vous.

Key job responsibilities
Appliquer les meilleures pratiques pour l'utilisation sécurisée des équipements et promouvoir une forte culture de sécurité à travers le réseau de maintenance (RME—Reliability, Maintenance, Engineering). Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le personnel technique en poste pour accompagner leur développement et agir en tant que premier point de contact, en fournissant un support à distance pendant les shifts de nuit afin de maintenir les sites opérationnels. Diagnostiquer les problèmes d'équipement — sur site comme à distance — pour minimiser les temps d'arrêt opérationnels, en veillant à ce que les colis puissent être traités le plus rapidement possible.

Soutenir le déploiement de projets à travers le réseau européen, et fournir un support IOQ (Installation, Qualification Opérationnelle) pour l'inspection et la mise en service des nouvelles machines dans le cadre des activités de lancement de site. Contribuer à identifier des moyens d'améliorer continuellement les systèmes et d'harmoniser les processus à travers le réseau EU.

A day in the life
Une journée dans la vie d'un Technicien au sein de la nouvelle équipe

C'est vous qui faites avancer les choses. Quand un problème survient sur le terrain, vous êtes le premier point de contact. Vous diagnostiquez les problèmes d'équipement — que vous soyez juste à côté de la machine ou que vous guidiez un collègue à distance pendant une équipe de nuit — car chaque minute d'arrêt d'une ligne, ce sont des colis en attente. Remettre les choses en route rapidement, c'est le cœur du métier.

La sécurité est le point de départ de tout. Vous appliquerez et défendrez les meilleures pratiques pour l'utilisation sécurisée des équipements, et contribuerez à bâtir une forte culture de sécurité à travers le réseau RME. Ce n'est pas une case à cocher — c'est le socle qui permet à chacun de donner le meilleur de lui-même et de rentrer chez soi en sécurité.

Vous ferez grandir les autres en grandissant vous-même. En travaillant aux côtés du personnel technique sur le terrain, vous accompagnerez leur développement et serez la personne vers qui ils se tournent lorsqu'ils sont bloqués. Parfois cela signifie résoudre un problème ; souvent, cela signifie aider quelqu'un à raisonner pour qu'il soit plus solide la prochaine fois.

Aucune journée ne se ressemble. Au-delà des opérations quotidiennes, vous soutiendrez les déploiements de projets à travers le réseau EU, en apportant des améliorations qui rendent nos sites plus performants. Vous fournirez également un support IOQ (Installation, Qualification Opérationnelle) — en inspectant et en mettant en service des machines flambant neuves dans le cadre du lancement de nouveaux sites. Il y a toujours quelque chose de nouveau à apprendre et à construire.

Vous laisserez les choses dans un meilleur état que vous ne les avez trouvées. En tant que membre de l'équipe SRMET (ALERT), vous cherchez toujours des moyens d'améliorer continuellement les systèmes et d'harmoniser les processus à travers le réseau EU. Vos idées comptent ici — une petite optimisation aujourd'hui, c'est moins de pannes demain.

Ça vous ressemble ? Si vous aimez résoudre des problèmes sous pression, travailler avec vos mains et votre tête, et que vous voulez faire partie d'une équipe où l'on vous fait confiance pour avoir un réel impact — nous serions ravis de vous rencontrer.

About the team
L'équipe SRMET (ALERT) accompagne les équipes techniques locales à travers le réseau RME afin de maintenir le bon déroulement des opérations, de jour comme de nuit.

Lorsqu'un problème d'équipement survient sur le terrain, nous constituons un point d'appui essentiel — en apportant notre soutien sur site comme à distance, y compris en dehors des heures ouvrées pendant les équipes de nuit, afin de contribuer à réduire les temps d'arrêt et à maintenir le flux des colis. La sécurité est au fondement de tout ce que nous faisons : nous promouvons les meilleures pratiques pour l'utilisation sécurisée des équipements et contribuons à renforcer une forte culture de sécurité à travers le réseau.

Nous travaillons également aux côtés du personnel technique en poste pour accompagner leur développement, en étant une ressource de confiance sur laquelle ils peuvent s'appuyer. Au-delà des opérations quotidiennes, nous soutenons les déploiements de projets à travers le réseau EU et fournissons un support IOQ (Installation, Qualification Opérationnelle) — en participant à l'inspection et à la mise en service des nouvelles machines pour accompagner le lancement de nouveaux sites.

Avant tout, nous sommes engagés dans l'amélioration continue des systèmes et l'harmonisation des processus à travers le réseau EU, afin d'aider les équipes locales à travailler de manière plus efficace et fiable dans la durée.

Basic qualifications

- Diplôme technique en électromécanique, maintenance industrielle, génie électrique
- Expérience confirmée en maintenance industrielle, idéalement dans un environnement automatisé à fort volume (logistique, production ou similaire)
- Solides connaissances des systèmes électriques, mécaniques et d'automatisation (automates/API, convoyeurs, trieurs, etc.)
- Capacité à diagnostiquer et dépanner les équipements à distance et à guider les équipes sur site dans les actions correctives
- Aisance avec les outils de GMAO et la lecture de documentation technique (schémas, plans P&ID, manuels)
- Maîtrise du français (langue de travail) et bon niveau d'anglais (pour les processus et outils globaux)
- Permis de conduire valide — le poste nécessite des déplacements à travers la France sur les sites DS lorsque la présence sur place est requise
- Fort sens de l'autonomie et des responsabilités — capacité à organiser et prioriser son travail de manière indépendante, sans supervision quotidienne
- Disponibilité pour des horaires flexibles / travail posté, y compris une couverture pendant les fenêtres opérationnelles

Preferred qualifications

- Expérience en tant qu'ingénieur ou technicien en automatisation, ou expérience significative de travail aux côtés d'équipes d'automatisation
- Maîtrise des automates programmables (API/PLC) — programmation, diagnostic et modification (Siemens, Allen-Bradley/Rockwell, Beckhoff ou équivalent)
- Connaissance des systèmes SCADA, IHM/HMI et des réseaux industriels (Profinet, Profibus, EtherCAT, etc.)
- Expérience avec les systèmes de convoyage et de tri automatisés à grande échelle (environnement logistique ou industriel)
- Familiarité avec les principes de maintenance conditionnelle (CBM) et des outils d'analyse de données associés
- Bon niveau d'anglais technique pour collaborer avec les équipes globales d'automatisation et CBM

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. descriptionHtml:
Transform network infrastructure by joining our dynamic team! You'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive network stability and scalability, using your technical expertise to create automated systems that power global technological advancement.

Infra Delivery Install Technicians will collaborate with cross-functional teams, troubleshoot complex technical scenarios, and implement strategic solutions that keep our network running seamlessly. title: Program Manager I, Transportation Engineering Systems
descriptionHtml:
Join the Transportation Engineering Systems (TESS) team where you'll directly influence how Amazon's transportation network operates at scale. As a Program Manager on the Transportation Engineering Systems (TESS) team, you will learn how Amazon's proprietary transportation systems make decisions to move packages from the fulfillment network to customers. You will manage system configuration changes that control those systems, working directly with business leaders and program teams to create new transportation flows and design configurations that execute at scale. In this role, you will execute network design changes, dive deep into package flows, troubleshoot system errors, identify process improvements, and build automation, analytics, and reporting capabilities leveraging AI. You will lead stakeholder meetings, manage projects, and contribute to doc writings for the team.

Key job responsibilities
-Manage system configuration changes across Amazon's proprietary transportation systems to support new and existing package flows
-Track program milestones and communicate status to business leaders and stakeholders
-Execute network design changes end-to-end, coordinating with business leaders and program teams to ensure timely delivery
-Dive deep into package flow data to troubleshoot system errors, identify root causes, and implement fixes
-Identify process improvement opportunities and build automation to reduce manual effort and increase accuracy
-Develop analytics and reporting capabilities leveraging AI to drive data-driven decision-making
-Proactively identify and mitigate risks in system configurations before they impact customers
-Document processes, standard operating procedures, and configuration playbooks for the team.
-Contribute to additional doc writing such as QBR, MBR, and Lessons Learned.

A day in the life
Your daily execution responsibilities will come via an intake queue which generates work tickets assigned to you. There could be a variety of audit and reporting duties as well. You will review dashboards and metrics that track transportation network performance, identifying opportunities for optimization. Throughout the day, you'll attend or facilitate meetings with cross-functional teams—from operations managers to software engineers—ensuring alignment on priorities and removing roadblocks. You'll work autonomously to solve ambiguous problems, whether that's defining requirements for a new system feature or analyzing why a particular network configuration isn't performing as expected. Your work directly influences decisions about how Amazon moves packages from fulfillment centers to customers' doorsteps.

About the team
The Transportation Engineering Systems (TESS) team sits at the critical intersection of Amazon's business operations and technical infrastructure. We're responsible for configuring and optimizing the transportation network that powers Amazon's logistics operations globally. Our team culture values data-driven decision-making, customer obsession, and innovative problem-solving. We work collaboratively across organizational boundaries, partnering with operations teams, software engineers, and business leaders to deliver solutions that scale. As part of TESS, you'll contribute to systems that impact millions of customer deliveries while working with talented professionals who are passionate about operational excellence.

- 2+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of Computerized Maintenance Management System program experience
- 3+ years of maintenance planner/scheduler in industrial maintenance, manufacturing, or distribution industries experience

- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

- Experience in MS Access and SQL
- Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
- Experience using Microsoft Projects software

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.
We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. The Sr. Global Creator Programs Manager owns the end-to-end execution of Twitch's global scaled creator activation program, a structured system that recruits, develops, and retains creators through community-driven programming and milestone-based progression. You'll build and operate the program's infrastructure, work with a distributed team of regional community leads, and drive creators toward meaningful retention milestones. Working cross-functionally with Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Business Development, and Marketing, you'll deliver against ambitious membership and retention targets, then report program performance to senior leadership.

descriptionHtml:

This is a rare greenfield opportunity: you'll be architecting and building an AI-first product from scratch, not inheriting legacy systems.  We're looking for a Software Development Engineer II who thrives in ambiguity, thinks like a product architect, and brings a builder's mindset to defensive security. You'll be a technical leader on a diverse team of software and security engineers, shaping the architecture of systems that process millions of signals daily and making foundational decisions that will define how Amazon defends itself for years to come.  This isn't a typical "maintain and iterate" role. We need someone who is innovative, adaptive, and culture-first. Someone who gets energized by blank whiteboards, challenges assumptions, and inspires others to raise the bar. descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.
The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager, interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.
Chief Engineer will be responsible for managing small-to-medium large impact projects from conception to completion. These projects can involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.
The Chief Engineer directs, trains and supports EOT’s in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States)

Key job responsibilities

• Troubleshoot and report of facility and data sever-level events within internal SLA

• Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians
• Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff
• Ensure all security procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff
• Utilize internal CMMS to manage building workflows

• Using Microsoft Office suite (Outlook, Excel, PPT, Word) and other computer programs such as PDF, QUIP, and other dashboards and scheduling tooling.

• Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 40 pounds or more

• Reach and stretch to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance
• Bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working

• Push or pull heavy objects into position

title: Data Center Chief Engineer - Nights
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.
The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager, interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.
Chief Engineer will be responsible for managing small-to-medium large impact projects from conception to completion. These projects can involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.
The Chief Engineer directs, trains and supports EOT’s in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States)

Key job responsibilities
• Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in a data center.
• Operate independently with limited direct management
• Act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within the data center, escalating to the Data Center Facility Manager as needed
• Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures
• Troubleshoot and report of facility and data sever-level events within internal SLA
• Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams
• Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians
• Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff
• Ensure all security procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff
• Utilize internal CMMS to manage building workflows
• Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience
• Using Microsoft Office suite (Outlook, Excel, PPT, Word) and other computer programs such as PDF, QUIP, and other dashboards and scheduling tooling.
• Instruct others on scheduling, ticketing, and providing mentorship in developing solutions.

Physical Requirements:
• Walk job sites in uneven terrain
• Work at heights and from ladders
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 40 pounds or more
• Coordinate body movements when using tools or equipment
• Reach and stretch to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance
• Bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working
• Perform physical tasks all day without becoming overly tired
• Use hands to manipulate small wires and objects
• Push or pull heavy objects into position
• Work in a noisy environment
• Work at depths, such as under raised floors

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
Essential Requirements:
• Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
• Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
• Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- 4+ years of administrative experience including Microsoft Office products
- Experience leading technical teams through daily operations, maintenance evolutions, and complex troubleshooting
- 4+ years of data center experience including industrial electrical and mechanical systems

Preferred qualifications

- Associates or higher in engineering field or mechanical or electrical trades
- PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or equivalent certifications
- Training-lead informal training
- Must be able to work in an environment that involves walking, stooping, bending, and climbing to access equipment.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Annapurna ML Systems, Trainium
descriptionHtml:
We're seeking a Sr.Software Development Engineer with deep storage expertise to architect, build, and operate the high-performance storage infrastructure that accelerates silicon development at Annapurna Labs. In this role, you'll own the storage platforms—spanning Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP, FSx for Lustre, and S3—that enable chip design teams to iterate faster, run regressions more efficiently, and bring transformative custom silicon to market.

Key job responsibilities
You will design, deploy, and operate high-performance storage platforms—Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP (Gen1/Gen2) and FSx for Lustre—optimized for EDA and HPC workloads. This includes managing NFS exports, ONTAP SVMs, intelligent tiering (FabricPool), snapshot policies, SnapMirror replication, and quota enforcement across multi-tenant environments. You'll deploy all storage infrastructure using AWS CDK, architect cross-VPC and multi-account solutions via Transit Gateway and Route 53 private hosted zones, enable EFA for high-throughput Lustre access, and manage data synchronization using DataSync and S3 integrations. You'll build a Storage as a Service platform with self-service provisioning, defined SLOs, cost attribution, and automated lifecycle management that enables teams to consume storage without deep specialization.
You will build monitoring and observability for storage health, utilization, and cost trends, and establish incident response processes for storage-related failures. You'll continuously evaluate and adopt new AWS storage features—Gen2 scale-out, NVMe-over-TCP, enhanced backup performance—to keep the platform at the leading edge. You'll profile I/O patterns across EDA workloads, tune file system configurations for optimal performance, and partner with silicon design and verification teams to proactively scale capacity and mentor others on storage best practices.


A day in the life
You might start your day reviewing storage utilization dashboards and tiering efficiency reports, identifying file systems approaching capacity thresholds or workloads that would benefit from tier migration. Mid-morning, you could be collaborating with a verification team to provision a new FSx for Lustre file system optimized for their regression suite—sizing it based on their I/O profiles, enabling EFA access, and deploying it through your CDK pipeline.
In the afternoon, you might be building the next iteration of your Storage as a Service platform—adding automated quota enforcement for a new team onboarding, implementing a snapshot policy that aligns with their project milestones, or extending cross-VPC access to a new account. You'll review pull requests for CDK constructs, investigate a DataSync job that stalled, and discuss FSx ONTAP Gen2 migration plans with your team.
Throughout the day, you'll balance immediate customer needs—expanding a volume for a team blocked on disk space, troubleshooting NFS mount latency—with longer-term platform investments like evaluating intelligent tiering policies or prototyping NVMe-over-TCP access patterns. You'll engage with AWS service teams on feature requests and roadmap alignment, ensuring Annapurna Labs gets the most from the storage platform.


About the team
At Annapurna Labs, your storage infrastructure work directly enables breakthrough innovations in custom silicon that power AWS and transform industries. The EDA Cloud Infrastructure team builds and operates the compute, storage, and networking platforms that hundreds of chip designers and verification engineers depend on daily. We offer the resources and scale of AWS with the innovation culture and technical depth of a focused silicon team.
If you're passionate about storage systems, thrive on building platforms that make complex infrastructure simple for others, and want to see your work accelerate the next generation of AWS silicon—we want to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- 5+ years of relevant hands-on systems engineering and administrative work in networking, storage systems, operating systems experience
- Knowledge of Network protocols/storage protocols: iSCSI, NFS, CIFS, SMB/Understanding of Software Defined Storage (SDS) and Content Delivery Networks
- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or other related discipline
- 3+ years of hands-on experience with NAS/NFS storage systems (NetApp ONTAP, or equivalent enterprise storage platforms)
- 3+ years of experience with AWS cloud services, including storage services (FSx, S3, EBS, EFS)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP (Gen1/Gen2 architectures, SVM management, FabricPool tiering, SnapMirror, snapshot policies)
- Experience with Amazon FSx for Lustre, including EFA-enabled configurations for HPC workloads
- Experience building self-service storage platforms with quota management, automated provisioning, and cost attribution
- Experience with AWS CDK (TypeScript or Python), including building custom L2/L3 constructs
- Experience with cross-VPC and multi-account storage architectures (Transit Gateway, VPC peering, Route 53 private hosted zones)
- Experience with storage observability: CloudWatch metrics, custom dashboards, capacity planning

descriptionHtml:
O Transport Specialist do time de Execution é responsável pelo monitoramento contínuo e em tempo real da malha de transporte (Middle Mile) da Amazon no Brasil, com atuação crítica durante os períodos de PEAK principalmente. Este profissional atua para garantir que nenhuma viagem saia sem monitoramento, antecipa riscos (atrasos, no-shows, quebras mecânicas), escalona situações críticas com contexto completo e assegura uma passagem de turno estruturada. O objetivo central é proteger a experiência do cliente final por meio da estabilidade, previsibilidade e rápida resposta a desvios operacionais nos lanes mais críticas da rede.

Key job responsibilities
1. Monitorar a programação e os aceites das viagens em tempo real.
Checar aceites no portal BRK / Gerenciamento de Risco, garantindo que nenhum veículo saia sem monitoramento. Identificar e sinalizar viagens sem aceite nas próximas 12 horas.

2. Acompanhamento de Cargas
Acompanhar cargas ad hoc e pendências até sua resolução.

3. Gestão de Atrasos
Monitorar atrasos críticos, assegurando que cada ocorrência tenha ETA atualizado e motivo registrado.

4. Gestão de No-Shows
Registrar e acionar rapidamente os no-shows, mobilizando as áreas responsáveis.

5. Quebras Mecânicas
Acompanhar quebras mecânicas e avaliar o impacto operacional na malha.

6. Tipologia & Lanes Críticos
Mapear trocas de tipologia e seus impactos na capacidade.
Monitorar lanes críticos, com foco em DSs de São Paulo e Cajamar.

7. Insights Proativos
Gerar insights proativos ao longo do turno, antecipando riscos antes que se tornem incidentes.

8. Escalonamento
Escalonar situações críticas com contexto completo (o quê, impacto, ação em curso, apoio necessário).

9. Handover Estruturado (Passagem de Turno)
Garantir que toda troca de turno contenha: Status atual · Próximo passo · Responsável · Prazo.

A day in the life
Ao assumir o turno, revisa o handover recebido e valida o status das viagens em curso. Ao longo do turno, monitora continuamente aceites, atrasos, no-shows e quebras no cockpit operacional, acionando rapidamente as áreas responsáveis quando um desvio surge. Você antecipa gargalos nas lanes críticos, gera insights proativos e escalona com contexto completo quando necessário. Ao final, entrega uma passagem de turno estruturada que permite ao próximo turno continuar sem perda de contexto.

About the team
O time 24x7 em Execution é a torre de controle operacional da malha de transporte (Middle Mile) da Amazon no Brasil. Opera de forma ininterrupta — 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana — com atuação especialmente crítica durante o PEAK.

Missão central: Ser os "olhos da rede" em tempo real, garantindo que nenhum veículo saia sem monitoramento e que qualquer desvio operacional (atraso, no-show, quebra) seja detectado e tratado rapidamente — protegendo a estabilidade da operação e a experiência do cliente final.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with Excel
- Experience with SQL
- Bachelor's degree, or Advanced technical degree
- Experience in transportation and supply chain

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in Control Tower or Vehicle Allocation

title: Solutions Architect, Education & Resear
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing its team of Solutions Architects focused on Education and Research customers within the UK Public Sector. In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor, helping universities, research institutions, and other public sector organisations adopt cloud technologies that advance their missions. You will build executive-level technical relationships, serve as the voice of the customer back into AWS, and help these organisations see what is possible with cloud computing.

As our Education and Research customer base expands, we need a Solutions Architect who is genuinely curious about emerging technology and motivated to translate that knowledge into practical, well-architected solutions. You will work alongside a supportive Public Sector team, partnering with sales, business development, and specialist teams to guide customers through their cloud journey — from early exploration through production workloads.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the technical relationship with Education and Research customers, providing recommendations on architecture, security, cost optimisation, performance, reliability, and operational efficiency.
- Build and maintain executive-level technical relationships, understanding each customer's strategic priorities and proactively identifying opportunities where AWS can accelerate their goals.
- Advocate on behalf of customers internally by translating their feedback into technical requirements for AWS engineering teams and contributing to service improvements.
- Design cloud-native reference architectures and create technical content such as white papers, blog posts, code samples, and workshops to share best practices with customers and the broader Solutions Architect community.
- Collaborate with specialist teams across AWS to bring the right expertise into customer engagements and help customers explore new use cases, including generative AI and data analytics.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing a customer's architecture proposal, preparing recommendations that balance performance and cost. By midday, you could be leading a deep-dive session with a customer's engineering team, walking through design patterns for a migration or new workload. In the afternoon, you may join a peer design review with fellow Solutions Architects, share insights from a recent engagement, or contribute to a workshop you are building. You will regularly connect with specialists across AWS to bring the right expertise to each customer conversation.

About the team
This role sits within our UK Public Sector team. The team has continued to grow, and we are proud to have welcomed people from different backgrounds who bring unique experiences to our work and to our customers. Our tenured Solutions Architects act as mentors and share their knowledge and experience across the group. We are all passionate about the impact we have on people across the UK, and we care deeply about our customers' missions. We enjoy working together in an environment that is supportive, inclusive, and fun.

We respect that everyone has responsibilities and interests outside of work. Our roles afford the flexibility to do your best at work and at home.

Basic qualifications

- Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics).
- Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
- Experience in technology/software sales, pre-sales, or consulting

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective
