title: Principal Technical Program Manager, IVR, Labs & Release Amazon Leo, D2D Software
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building a low Earth orbit satellite constellation to bring fast, affordable connectivity to customers around the world. Direct to Device (D2D) extends Leo to standard mobile phones and devices: a fully regenerative fifth-generation (5G) mobile base station on each satellite, delivering service to standard handsets through mobile network operators (MNOs). D2D Software builds the embedded software that flies, the cloud and ground software that runs the service, and the platform that connects them. Our target is under a day from a defect being found to the fix deployed across the entire constellation, achieved by automating everything that a person would otherwise do by hand.

This role leads the program for integration, verification and reliability, labs, and release in Software Delivery & Business Ops, reporting to the Director, Software Delivery & Business Ops. It owns the integrated lab plan, lead times, and fallbacks; the technical program manager for Software Integration, Verification & Reliability; the release train and the six-eyes sign-off process; supplier delivery for lab and test vendors. Before anything is handed on, the bar is: positive float for every lab need-by date; every release with its three sign-offs. It hands off to its customers as follows: integrated lab plan and release calendar to Software Integration, Verification & Reliability, DevOps, and the hardware teams.

What the team needs to achieve
• Positive float for every lab need-by date; every release with its three sign-offs.
• Experience that meet their service level: integrated lab plan and release calendar to Software Integration, Verification & Reliability, DevOps, and the hardware teams.
• Measured, rising capability and efficiency of the team, with manual work falling release over release.

How the team is measured
• Lab readiness float against every gate's need-by date.
• Rig queue wait within its service level.
• Releases shipped with their sign-offs on time.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the integrated lab plan, lead times, and fallbacks; the technical program manager for Software Integration, Verification & Reliability; the release train and the six-eyes sign-off process; supplier delivery for lab and test vendors.
• Meet the bar before every hand-off: positive float for every lab need-by date; every release with its three sign-offs.
• Work directly with engineers in the boundary teams as partners, through agreed contracts and service levels.
• Automate everything a person would otherwise do twice.
• Run the program's mechanisms, metrics, and reviews, and clear blockers with the right people, escalating when needed.
• Identify and mitigate program risks early, build consensus across teams, and mentor other program managers.


This role is the technical program manager for Software Integration, Verification & Reliability. It owns the integrated lab plan for D2D Software (lab and rig lead times, capacity, fallbacks, and escalation), runs the release train and the six-eyes sign-off process, and owns supplier delivery for lab, rig, and test vendors. The sign-offs themselves stay independent: integration and verification, DevOps & Release, and this function each sign for their own part. It matters because embedded software testing depends on scarce rigs, benches, and chambers that take months to build, and because every release needs its sign-offs on time. Without it, labs arrive after the gates need them, releases wait on paperwork, and development and test teams wait for hardware.


Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


About the team
D2D Software is an evolving organization of many teams: Software Architecture & Specifications; Software Delivery & Business Ops; Software Integration, Verification & Reliability; DevOps & Release; Satellite Software Development; Ground Software Development; and Customer Software Engineering & Support. Each Director owns business outcomes: delivering the commitments, and the capability and efficiency of their teams. Teams work as internal customers and suppliers with agreed service levels, interfaces are agreed centrally while designs stay local, and engineers are expected to work directly with engineers across every boundary. Milestones are committed deadlines for delivery with quality, not gates to wait on, and every team runs on one toolchain and one system of record. Every measure is derived from the systems of record, never self-reported, and we improve release over release with a target of perfection.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
- 10+ years of program management experience, including programs across several teams
- Experience building the mechanisms, metrics, and reporting that run a program
- Experience delivering programs end to end where the problem and plan are not fully defined, making trade-offs between short- and long-term needs
- Experience running programs for labs, test facilities, or hardware infrastructure with long lead times
- Experience running a release train or release sign-off process for embedded or hardware-and-software products
- A background in embedded software development
- Experience across the full software development lifecycle, having shipped software and maintained it in production

Preferred qualifications

- Lab or test-facility programs for embedded, radio frequency, or space hardware
- Experience with hardware-in-the-loop test environments
- Release to manufacturing for embedded software
- Experience creating scalable program mechanisms across several organizations and presenting program strategy to senior leaders
- Experience owning a program roadmap or portfolio across the organization, telling one-way from two-way doors, and creating mechanisms that other teams adopt
- A record of writing clear narratives and running data-driven reviews
- Researched and benchmarked lab, test, and release approaches to decide what to build, reuse, or retire

title: Senior Manager, Virtual Environments and Simulation, Amazon Leo, D2D Software
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building a low Earth orbit satellite constellation to bring fast, affordable connectivity to customers around the world. Direct to Device (D2D) extends Leo to standard mobile phones and devices: a fully regenerative fifth-generation (5G) mobile base station on each satellite, delivering service to standard handsets through mobile network operators (MNOs). D2D Software builds the embedded software that flies, the cloud and ground software that runs the service, and the platform that connects them. Our target is under a day from a defect being found to the fix deployed across the entire constellation, achieved by automating everything that a person would otherwise do by hand.

This team builds the virtual fleet: processor and programmable-logic emulators, full-stack virtual environments, and telemetry capture and replay, so embedded software is developed and tested before hardware. It matters because hardware is scarce and late, and most testing must run without it. Without it, development waits for rigs, and defects are found only on hardware.

This role leads virtual environments and simulation in DevOps & Release, reporting to the Director, DevOps & Release. It owns emulation, the virtual fleet, and telemetry capture and replay. Before anything is handed on, the bar is: virtual-to-rig escapes under 5%. It hands off to its customers as follows: virtual fleet and emulators to every team and IVR.

What the team needs to achieve
• Virtual-to-rig escapes under 5%.
• Hand-offs that meet their service level: virtual fleet and emulators to every team and IVR.
• Measured, rising capability and efficiency of the team, with manual work falling release over release.

How the team is measured
• Defects escaping from virtual testing to the rig.
• Share of tests run virtually.

Key job responsibilities
• Own emulation, the virtual fleet, and telemetry capture and replay.
• Meet the bar before every hand-off: virtual-to-rig escapes under 5%.
• Work directly with engineers in the boundary teams as partners, through agreed contracts and service levels.
• Automate everything a person would otherwise do twice.
• Hire, coach, and grow the team, with clear expectations and career development for every engineer.
• Define the team's metrics and service levels, and improve them release over release.
• Make the team's decisions data-driven and its quality measurable, and escalate early when risks cross team boundaries.
• Set the team's roadmap and the structure and mechanisms that deliver it, and negotiate the boundaries of the area with peer teams.
• Build the mechanisms and best practices that make the team's work repeatable, measurable, and improving.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


About the team
D2D Software is an evolving organization of many teams: Software Architecture & Specifications; Software Delivery & Business Ops; Software Integration, Verification & Reliability; DevOps & Release; Satellite Software Development; Ground Software Development; and Customer Software Engineering & Support. Each Director owns business outcomes: delivering the commitments, and the capability and efficiency of their teams. Teams work as internal customers and suppliers with agreed service levels, interfaces are agreed centrally while designs stay local, and engineers are expected to work directly with engineers across every boundary. Milestones are committed deadlines for delivery with quality, not gates to wait on, and every team runs on one toolchain and one system of record. Every measure is derived from the systems of record, never self-reported, and we improve release over release with a target of perfection.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or related technical field
- 5+ years of software development experience
- Experience in management: developing engineers into managers and building teams
- Experience establishing workflows, metrics, and service levels for a team, and making data-driven trade-offs between short- and long-term needs
- Experience leading a team where the problem and strategy are not yet fully defined, working backwards from the customer
- Experience with emulators, simulators, or digital twins for embedded software on real-time operating systems (RTOS) and embedded Linux
- Experience keeping virtual environments faithful to hardware, with measured fidelity
- Experience across the full software development lifecycle, having shipped software and maintained it in production

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with processor or FPGA emulation
- Experience with radio channel or constellation simulation
- Experience managing managers or leading several teams
- Experience setting a multi-year direction for an area, designing the team structure and mechanisms to deliver it, and aligning several teams around it
- Experience setting strategy where the problem, opportunity, and strategy are not defined, telling one-way from two-way doors, and presenting decisions and strategy narratives to senior leaders across the organization
- A record of writing clear narratives and running data-driven reviews

title: Supply Chain Manager (S&OP), INT Supply Chain Grocery Execution
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Supply Chain Managers play a central role in our global business. They keep our complex, international grocery and highly perishable supply chains working seamlessly and efficiently. As a Supply Chain Manager (SCM), you will work closely with multiple stakeholders across Amazon, from Operational teams who are fulfilling customer orders, to Retail teams and everything in between. You’ll help us optimize our supply chains to make our customer experience even better and our business more energy and cost efficient.

Key job responsibilities
- Define our Demand Planning strategy in 5 European countries (UK, IT, ES, DE, FR), across our Fresh Online and Amazon Now (Quick Commerce) Grocery banners.
- Analyse and interpret data to deeply understand regional customer demand patterns and improve demand planning accuracy, helping the business drive efficiency across our end-to-end supply chain (from Inbound to Customer Outbound).
- Partner with ground Operations, Last Mile Delivery and Business teams, incorporating their inputs into our forecasting routine.
- Align complex Demand Planning strategies with Snr Leadership and financial partners.

A day in the life
Being a Supply Chain Manager for Amazon involves lots of problem solving. You’ll work with a number of teams to navigate challenges as and when situations impact our network. You’ll spend time resolving temporary issues and looking at the bigger picture to drive Amazon towards achieving new objectives. This role is both proactive and reactive, and you’ll have the opportunity to shape demand planning strategies for our ever growing groceries business.

As a Supply Chain Manager leading our S&OP vertical, you’ll need to help with both tactical and strategic work. No two days will be the same. You might spend Monday modelling demand scenarios for a new Amazon Fresh dark store launch, and Tuesday partnering with Last Mile Ops to resolve a resource capacity gap impacting our customer delivery speeds, across three International regions. Having so much variety in your role means you’ll be able to learn something new every day.

This role will be carried out from our corporate location in London (LHR16 UK).

About the team
The INT Supply Chain Grocery Execution team breathes life into our newest ideas and incubates them until they grow into sophisticated businesses. We’ve got the energy of an exciting start-up, as our team works on Amazon’s next big project, under the umbrella of one of the world’s biggest companies.

We work behind the scenes to support new areas of the business - like Amazon Now (Quick Commerce) stores and our online grocery service. There are lots of opportunities for every skill set, from operations to supply chain to data management.

SC Execution's goal is to help develop new capabilities within Amazon on behalf of our customers. This entrepreneurial team has a deep understanding of the needs of our customers, employees and partners and helps to develop Amazon businesses of all sizes.

We grow new opportunities that will help Amazon diversify even more, taking them from concepts to mature operations that operate as standalone businesses. This dynamic environment supports our people’s growth and development.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics
- Knowledge of advanced English at CEFR level B2/C1
- Experience in business analytics and reporting or demand forecasting
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership, or experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
- Experience in supply chain such as contracting, demand management and/or planning and procurement, and supply chain operations
- Bachelor's degree, or Master's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading process improvements
- Knowledge of SQL at an intermediate level, including: compile queries, subqueries, aggregation/grouping, data modification, etc.
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools

title: Sr Principal Scientist, EU INTech
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon International Technology (INTech) team owns the discovery and delivery of Amazon's engineering to all the varied customers and cultures of the world. We do this through a combination of partnerships with other Amazon technical teams and innovative new projects. We make sure that each of our websites is a thoughtful combination of Amazon known best practices and unique last-mile engineering driven by each country's customers' needs. The work spans the technology stack from science to front-end customer experience to back-end core services.

INTech Europe is a technology team focused on accelerating the EU business while deploying tech solutions WW wherever applicable.

EU INTech operates at a unique intersection: worldwide-scale science constrained by EU-specific realities — 10+ languages, 10+ marketplaces. Our science problems — localization, customer understanding, multilingual catalogue intelligence or visual content — are core primitives to serve our WW customers.

This role is ideally located in Madrid or Luxembourg, but we will also consider London as an additional location.

Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Principal Scientist, you will shape the definition and vision for science across INTech Europe and beyond. Leveraging your expertise in both theory and practice in Natural Language Processing / Understanding, Machine Learning, and Computer Vision, you will act as a strategic advisor to the EU Stores' leadership team and a scientific leader whose influence reaches across the worldwide International Stores Technology community.

You will:

• Own the science vision and strategy for EU INTech, setting the bar for scientific excellence across a community of scientists spanning Applied Science, Research Science, and Economics, working on GenAI, NLP/NLU, ML, and computer vision applied to e-commerce at scale.

• See around corners and identify business problems that will impact our customers' and selling partners' experience. You will explore problems that are unique and unsolved, proposing and delivering solutions that translate scientific research and business judgment into products that improve the customer and employee experience.

• Drive science as a pillar of EU INTech's biggest bets — where you will shape and prototype reusable science capabilities for multilingual evaluation and locale-specific model customization.

• Set and hold the bar for Responsible AI, ensuring scientific and ethical rigour is embedded as a prerequisite in how we build and launch AI across the organization.

• Lead writing efforts of notable internal and external publications that validate originality, inspire new lines of research, and elevate internal and external science communities.

• Mentor and develop senior scientists, building the next generation of science leadership across the organization.

Basic qualifications

• Demonstrable of experience building machine learning models
• A track record of world-class publication in related disciplines.
• Demonstrated expertise in both theory and practice in Natural Language Processing / Understanding, Machine Learning, and Computer Vision.
• Hands-on experience with a broad range of qualitative and quantitative research methods.

Preferred qualifications

title: Graduate Logistik Manager - Wenden, NRW
descriptionHtml:
Als Nachwuchsführungskraft wirst du in unserem 11-wöchigen internen Onboarding Programm auf deine neue Aufgabe als Führungskraft vorbereitet.
Nach dieser umfangreichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du Führungsverantwortung für dein eigenes Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden Ihre Waren pünktlich und in guter Qualität erhalten. In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.


Key job responsibilities
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
- Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
- Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)
- Planung und Steuerung der innerbetrieblichen Prozesse
- Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
- Effektives Ressourcen- und Workflowmanagement
- Zusammenarbeit mit den vor- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort

A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

About the team
Die Logistikabteilung bei Amazon (AMZL) ist für die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ zuständig – also die Auslieferung unserer Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern. Wir denken kreativ und realisieren Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von physischen Produkten an unsere Kund:innen zu liefern. Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Diese Tätigkeiten werden von zwei Mitarbeitergruppen ausgeführt. Unsere „internen“ Mitarbeitenden bereiten Millionen von Produkten auf den Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor. Unser Team ist menschenorientiert und hilfsbereit. Das ist besonders wichtig, weil viele unserer Mitarbeitenden in Nachtschichten arbeiten. Unser Fokus liegt vorwiegend auf dem operativen Betrieb. An den meisten unserer Standorte wird rund um die Uhr gearbeitet.
Unsere „Außendienst“-Mitarbeitenden arbeiten währenddessen mit Amazon Flex – einem Auftragnehmer-Netzwerk für die Lieferung. Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

- Erfolgreich absolviertes Hochschulstudium (Bachelor- oder Master) vor Arbeitsbeginn
- Fortgeschrittene Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Relevante Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Datenanalysen

Preferred qualifications

- Aktuelles Studium oder kürzlich erworbener Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss im Bereich Logistik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
- Interesse eine Führungsaufgabe und ein eigenes Team mit Mitarbeitenden aus der ganzen Welt zu übernehmen

title: Delivery Trainer, RSR
descriptionHtml:
Since opening our 'virtual' doors in 1995, we’ve been pushing the boundaries of ‘possible’ further and further. Our entire business works hard to delight our customers – from the second an order is placed online to the seamless coordination of that order behind the scenes, we strive to stay agile, fluid and intentional. That can be described in one of our core Leadership Principles, which is Bias for Action. This means that our teams band together, roll up their sleeves, and aren’t content with just standing still. We’re aiming to become the most customer-centric company on Earth.

Rural Super Rural (RSR) is an exciting organization within Amazon dedicated to ensuring our customers receive their deliveries and are satisfied with their service, even in our most remote area. We are a combination of operations and support teams aligned to continually strive to innovate the last mile delivery process while bringing smiles to our customer’s faces.

Amazon is seeking self-motivated Driver Trainers to join our team and help build a network of customer-centric Delivery Associates in the communities where we operate. As a Driver Trainer, you have a passion for mentoring others; you are comfortable teaching and guiding conversations in large groups; and you believe in hands-on training and conducting drive-alongs with Delivery Associates to instill safe practices.

As a Driver Trainer, you are responsible for establishing the right driver training culture in your delivery station, setting up the training experience, and independently instructing training sessions. You educate Delivery Associates on the foundational safety, quality, and productivity aspects that are an important part of the Delivery Associate daily routine. You enable the success of Delivery Associates by adapting to different learning styles and taking a hands-on training approach to demonstrate what good looks like. You exhibit Learn and Be Curious by answering all Delivery Associates’ questions and finding the answers if you are not sure of the correct response.

As a Driver Trainer, you are expected to lead by example and demonstrate the Amazon Leadership Principles at all times. In this position you will play a key role in keeping our commitment to exceed customer expectations by ensuring Delivery Associates are set up for success to deliver customer orders, large or small, on time at the right place.

Due to interstate operating authority commerce regulations, candidates must be at least 21 years or older. Candidate must hold a valid state-appropriate driver’s license, be able to obtain and maintain their Driver Qualification File (DQF), and be eligible to drive in accordance with Department of Transportation (DOT) requirements.


Key job responsibilities
•Facilitate daily training classes for up to 30 people, including in-station classes and drive-alongs
• Partner with Delivery Service Partners (DSPs), Operations Managers, Area Managers, and Learning Teams to coordinate, facilitate, and measure training related activities.
• Have a detailed understanding of processes, expectations, and training requirements for all drivers across the various driver programs in operation.
• Provide timely and accurate reporting on the completion of trainings, compliance, safety, and maintenance duties.
• Execute to the standard, always working to ensure that the content and experience complement the safety, quality, and legal procedures as defined.
• Educate and audit driver safety and compliance standards such as: driver vehicle inspection reports, hours of service, trip planning and safe road driving practices.
• Track and monitor performance including on road ride behinds to measure on-road quality, adherence to standards, and identify re-training and process improvement opportunities.
• Drive, maneuver, and load/unload a truck as scheduled using approved equipment (dolly, etc.), with or without reasonable accommodation.
• Lift up to 49 pounds, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach, with or without reasonable accommodation.
• Work outside and drive different motor vehicles over the road.
• Drive in accordance with DOT requirements.
• Stay connected to the operation by participating in on-road processes on a regular basis
• Be a resource to the delivery station for driver training-related questions
• Work as a peer trainer on an as needed basis to support the business.
• Motivate, coach, and provide feedback to Delivery Associates during Training
• Travel to multiple sites within 50 miles of the home station and have reliable transportation
• Operate and navigate a 26,000 pounds or less vehicle
• Track performance and provide identified retraining and process improvement opportunities to further develop non-CDL driver, DOT regulated training.
• Effectively operate a GPS
• Associate may be required to gain DOT Regulation Qualification as a condition of the role
• Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- High school or equivalent
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required

- Are 21 years of age or older

- Eligible to drive in accordance with DOT requirements

- Ability to communicate effectively (written and verbal) across various levels of an organization

title: Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, DSL
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company. To achieve this goal, we strive to exceed expectations by innovating and providing best-in-class customer support as we expand our logistics products and services including improving how we fulfill and deliver customer orders. We’re making history and the good news is that we’ve only just begun. At Amazon you get to Work with smart, passionate people who are building new products and services every day on behalf of our customers.

As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will help improve the customer experience by providing in station real-time, hands-on support to ensure our customers receive their packages on time, as promised. The role will also help connect customers with experts who can provide them the most accurate and up-to-date information about their packages. The work is beyond fulfilling and delivering customer orders; it’s making sure we put smiles on customer’s faces.


Key job responsibilities
As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will be responsible for:
- Communicating with customers directly in-person, in addition to communicating via phone and email
- Empathizing with and prioritizing customer needs
- Upholding company values and respecting every customer
- Resolving issues and setting appropriate expectations with customers
- Clearly understanding and responding appropriately to the issues that customers present
- Consistently composing grammatically correct, concise, and accurate written responses to customer issues
- Approaching problems logically and with good judgment to ensure the appropriate customer outcome
- Making quick and effective decisions on behalf of the customer
- Working a flexible Full-Time (40+ hours per week) schedule

Performing the following tasks, with or without reasonable accommodation:
- Carry, lift, push and pull up to 49 pounds

- Stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours

A day in the life

As orders are dispatched and delivered, you’ll be in contact with our warehouse, associates, delivery partners and customers when they need guidance. Where a customer needs to reschedule a delivery, you’ll be informing our delivery partners. Where you notice a delivery issue, you’ll get to work resolving it straight away, so that our customers get a great experience every time without having to contact Amazon.

Operating at the heart of Amazon’s logistics, you’ll develop logistical and customer expertise that sets Amazon apart. You’ll connect with our customers every day, using your in-depth understanding of our supply chain and local knowledge of delivery connections and warehouses.


About the team
Our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, and few departments have as direct an impact on that mission as our Customer Service team. We're an inclusive team who empower and look after our people, so they have the time and energy to focus on our customers’ happiness. Our goal is to reduce customer effort every way we can, helping them get the best results quickly and efficiently. We support our self-service channels to offer expert insights into our customers’ most complex issues.

Within Customer Service, there are opportunities in process improvement, customer experience, data analysis and customer retention. The CS team is always looking for ways to make Amazon’s customer service even better, and we need excellent people to make that happen.

title: Refrigeration Specialist (AMOC), Amazon Maintenance Operation Center
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Operations sits at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. We look after everything from the moment a customer clicks buy, to the moment their product is delivered, from desktop to doorstep.
Across the globe we have more than a thousand Fulfilment Centres, thousands of Delivery Stations, tens of thousands of machines, and hundreds of thousands of employees, all working together in harmony to make sure the right product gets delivered to the right person, in the right place, at the right time.
Working in Amazon Operations is for people who like to be active and give their all. We work in a busy, dynamic environment and are part of a bigger team delivering on the expectations of millions of customers every single day. We are open, inclusive and welcome individuality and diversity. The culture in our Operation is built on the way teams bond and the work ethic that enables our business to run like clockwork. Our teams take pride in a job well done, looking out for one another, ensuring the highest safety standards and playing their part in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for around the world.
Join us in the Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team. We maintain and optimize technologies in the Global Amazon Warehouse & Delivery Network.

Purpose of Job

We are seeking a Refrigeration Specialist who will support the safety, performance, and operational continuity of refrigeration systems across the Amazon portfolio. This role focuses on monitoring, first level triage, work order accuracy, documentation, and coordination with local engineering teams and vendors.
The Refrigeration Specialist will help ensure timely responses to alarms, high quality work order management, and adherence to refrigeration processes and compliance standards.
We are seeking a junior specialist with solid technical fundamentals in refrigeration or HVAC and the ambition to grow into a more advanced Refrigeration role over time.


Key job responsibilities
- Vendor and Ticket Management Ensure end to end accuracy of refrigeration work orders by validating asset selection, severity, and technical descriptions. Coordinate vendor dispatches according to established SOPs, follow up on ETAs and on site presence, and track service notes and FGAS documentation. Support the creation and progression of PRs/POs to facilitate repairs.
- Remote Monitoring and Alarm Resolution Monitor refrigeration alarms and temperature data through BMS and monitoring platforms. Identify anomalies and escalate following established triage SOPs. Support data collection and basic reporting to help senior engineers identify recurring issues and optimize system reliability.
- Documentation Maintenance Contribute to refrigeration documentation by adding case studies, SOP updates, workflows, and troubleshooting learnings to support AMOC and RME teams.
- Metrics Support Help prepare and validate refrigeration KPIs and dashboards, flagging data gaps and recurring issues for senior team members.
- Team Capability Share refrigeration knowledge to support shift handovers and team discussions. Help onboard new team members and reinforce correct triage and work order processes across shifts.
- Process and SOP Adherence Follow established refrigeration workflows and provide feedback to improve alarm handling, work order processes, and documentation.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of generic mechanical room infrastructure such as chillers, cooler units, and fan controls
- Experience communicating technical details verbally and in writing
- Knowledge of MS-Office tools including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio
- Technical diploma, vocational certification, or equivalent qualification in refrigeration, HVAC, cooling systems, or a related technical field.
- Ability to read dashboards and flag basic trends related to system performance.
- Ability to work shifts in a 24/7 environment.

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of FGAS regulations and compliance requirements.
- Familiarity with natural refrigerant solutions (e.g., CO2, R290) and their safety, performance, and maintenance considerations.
- Hands on experience working with refrigeration, HVAC, or building maintenance systems.
- Proficiency in an additional language relevant to AMOC's operational footprint (e.g., Italian, German, French, Spanish).
